     │ def build_consumers(network: Network) -> ConsumerArrays:                │
     │     parts: dict[str, list[np.ndarray]] = {k: [] for k in (              │
     │         "dt_index", "arch", "tier", "scale", "node", "life", "prop",    │
     │ "flex", "solar", "channel", "lang")}                                    │
     │     ids: list[str] = []                                                 │
     │     slices: list[slice] = []                                            │
     │     offset = 0                                                          │
     │     arch_tier = np.array(c.ARCH_TIER, dtype=np.int8)                    │
     │     arch_flex = np.array(c.ARCH_FLEX_SHARE, dtype=np.float32)           │
     │     for i, dt in enumerate(network.transformers):                       │
     │         rng = np.random.default_rng(dt.seed)                            │
     │         n = dt.n_consumers                                              │
     │         arch = rng.choice(len(c.ARCHETYPES), size=n,                    │
     │ p=c.BAND_MIX[dt.income_band]).astype(np.int8)                           │
     │         tier = arch_tier[arch]                                          │
     │         scale = rng.lognormal(0.0, 0.35, n).astype(np.float32)          │
     │         node = rng.integers(1, len(dt.lv.parent), n).astype(np.int16)   │
     │         life = (tier == 1) & (rng.random(n) < 0.005)                    │
     │         if i == 0 and not life.any():                                   │
     │             life[int(np.argmax(tier == 1))] = True  # the network       │
     │ always has at least one                                                 │
     │         prop = rng.beta(2.0, 5.0, n).astype(np.float32)                 │
     │         solar = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float32)                           │
     │         eligible = np.flatnonzero((arch == 1) | (arch == 2))            │
     │         if dt.solar_kw > 0 and len(eligible) > 0:                       │
     │             k = max(1, int(round(len(eligible) * 0.08)))                │
     │             chosen = rng.choice(eligible, size=min(k, len(eligible)),   │
     │ replace=False)                                                          │
     │             solar[chosen] = dt.solar_kw / len(chosen)                   │
     │         low = arch == 0                                                 │
     │         channel = np.where(low, rng.choice(3, n, p=(0.35, 0.55, 0.10)), │
     │ rng.choice(3, n, p=(0.80, 0.15, 0.05))).astype(np.int8)                 │
     │         lang = (rng.random(n) < 0.12).astype(np.int8)                   │
     │         code = dt.id.removeprefix("dt_")                                │
     │         ids.extend(f"c_{code}_{j + 1:04d}" for j in range(n))           │
     │         slices.append(slice(offset, offset + n))                        │
     │         offset += n                                                     │
     │         for key, arr in (("dt_index", np.full(n, i, np.int32)),         │
     │ ("arch", arch), ("tier", tier), ("scale", scale),                       │
     │                          ("node", node), ("life", life), ("prop",       │
     │ prop), ("flex", arch_flex[arch]),                                       │
     │                          ("solar", solar), ("channel", channel),        │
     │ ("lang", lang)):                                                        │
     │             parts[key].append(arr)                                      │
     │     cat = {k: np.concatenate(v) for k, v in parts.items()}              │
     │     return ConsumerArrays(                                              │
     │         n=offset, ids=ids, dt_index=cat["dt_index"], arch=cat["arch"],  │
     │ tier=cat["tier"], scale=cat["scale"],                                   │
     │         node=cat["node"], life_support=cat["life"],                     │
     │ propensity=cat["prop"], flex_share=cat["flex"],                         │
     │         solar_kw=cat["solar"], channel=cat["channel"],                  │
     │ language=cat["lang"], low_income=cat["arch"] == 0,                      │
     │         dt_slices=slices,                                               │
     │     )                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │

     │ def synthetic_network(seed: int = 7, dts_per_subdivision: int | None =  │
     │ None, centres: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] | None = None) ->         │
     │ Network:                                                                │
     │     """Builds the whole network deterministically.                      │
     │ `dts_per_subdivision` shrinks it for tests.                             │
     │     DT ratings here are provisional (100 kVA); scripts/build_network.py │
     │ sizes them from the load model."""                                      │
     │     discoms = [Discom(id="discom_mvvnl", name="Madhyanchal Vidyut       │
     │ Vitran Nigam Ltd", short="MVVNL"),                                      │
     │                Discom(id="discom_dvvnl", name="Dakshinanchal Vidyut     │

     │ [], [], [], [], [], [], [], []                                          │
     │     for sid, name, name_hi, code, town_id, discom_id, kind, lat, lng,   │
     │ n_dts, n_feeders in SUBDIVISION_TABLE:                                  │
     │         if centres and sid in centres:                                  │
     │             lat, lng = centres[sid]                                     │
     │         n = dts_per_subdivision or n_dts                                │
     │         rng = np.random.default_rng(stable_seed(seed, sid))             │
     │         bbox = (lng - HALF_LNG, lat - HALF_LAT, lng + HALF_LNG, lat +   │

     │ town_id=town_id, discom_id=discom_id,                                   │

     │ alloc_kw=0.0)                                                           │
     │         ss = Substation(id=f"ss_{code.lower()}", name=f"33/11 kV        │
     │ {name}", subdivision_id=sid,                                            │
     │                         lat=lat + HALF_LAT * 0.2, lng=lng - HALF_LNG *  │
     │ 0.2, capacity_mva=10.0)                                                 │
     │         pts = scatter_points(rng, bbox, n)                              │
     │         angle = np.arctan2(pts[:, 1] - ss.lat, pts[:, 0] - ss.lng)      │
     │         order = np.argsort(angle)                                       │
     │         k_feeders = min(n_feeders, n)                                   │
     │         groups = np.array_split(order, k_feeders)                       │
     │         sd_dts: list[Transformer] = []                                  │
     │         for j in range(n):                                              │
     │             band = c.INCOME_BANDS[int(rng.choice(3,                     │
     │ p=c.KIND_BAND_P[kind]))]                                                │
     │             n_cons = int(rng.integers(90, 221))                         │
     │             solar_per = {"low": 0.005, "mixed": 0.03, "mid":            │
     │ 0.08}[band]                                                             │
     │             did = f"dt_{code.lower()}_{j + 1:02d}"                      │
     │             sd_dts.append(Transformer(                                  │
     │                 id=did, name=f"DT-{code}-{j + 1:02d}",                  │
     │ subdivision_id=sid, feeder_id="", rating_kva=100,                       │
     │                 lat=round(float(pts[j, 1]), 6), lng=round(float(pts[j,  │
     │ 0]), 6), income_band=band,                                              │
     │                 n_consumers=n_cons,                                     │
     │ year_installed=int(rng.integers(2004, 2023)),                           │
     │                 solar_kw=round(solar_per * n_cons *                     │
     │ float(rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5)), 2), lv=random_lv(rng),                    │
     │                 seed=stable_seed(seed, did)))                           │
     │         for g, idx in enumerate(groups):                                │
     │             letter = "abcd"[g]                                          │
     │             fid = f"fdr_{code.lower()}_{letter}"                        │
     │             members = sorted(idx.tolist(), key=lambda q: (pts[q, 0] -   │
     │ ss.lng) ** 2 + (pts[q, 1] - ss.lat) ** 2)                               │
     │             for q in members:                                           │
     │                 sd_dts[q].feeder_id = fid                               │
     │             far = members[-1]                                           │
     │             length = 111.0 * float(np.hypot(pts[far, 0] - ss.lng,       │
     │ pts[far, 1] - ss.lat)) * 1.35                                           │
     │             feeders.append(Feeder(id=fid, name=f"11 kV                  │
     │ {name}-{letter.upper()}", subdivision_id=sid,                           │

     │ def service_areas_geojson(network: Network) -> dict:                    │
     │     features = []                                                       │
     │     for sd in network.subdivisions:                                     │
     │         dts = [d for d in network.transformers if d.subdivision_id ==   │
     │ sd.id]                                                                  │

     │ dts]), sd.bbox)                                                         │
     │         for d, poly in zip(dts, cells, strict=True):                    │
     │             ring = [[round(float(x), 6), round(float(y), 6)] for x, y   │
     │ in poly]                                                                │
     │             ring.append(ring[0])                                        │
     │             features.append({"type": "Feature", "properties": {"dt_id": │
     │ d.id, "name": d.name, "subdivision_id": sd.id},                         │
     │                              "geometry": {"type": "Polygon",            │
     │ "coordinates": [ring]}})                                                │
     │     return {"type": "FeatureCollection", "attribution": ATTRIBUTION,    │
     │ "features": features}                                                   │

     │                                                                         │
     │ Run from backend/:  .venv/Scripts/python scripts/geocode_localities.py  │

     │ import time                                                             │
     │ import urllib.parse                                                     │
     │ import urllib.request                                                   │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]                              │
     │ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid.network import SUBDIVISION_TABLE                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ QUERIES = {                                                             │
     │     "sd_subhashnagar": "Subhash Nagar, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India", │
     │     "sd_izzatnagar": "Izatnagar, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India",       │
     │     "sd_faridpur": "Faridpur, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India",          │
     │     "sd_krishnanagar": "Krishna Nagar, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India",  │
     │     "sd_kosikalan": "Kosi Kalan, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India",        │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │ URL =                                                                   │
     │ "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&limit=1&q={q}"  │
     │ UA = "LifelineGrid-geocode/1.0 (hackathon prototype)"                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def main() -> int:                                                      │
     │     out = {}                                                            │
     │     for row in SUBDIVISION_TABLE:                                       │
     │         sid, lat, lng = row[0], row[7], row[8]                          │
     │         source = "fallback"                                             │
     │         try:                                                            │
     │             req =                                                       │
     │ urllib.request.Request(URL.format(q=urllib.parse.quote(QUERIES[sid])),  │
     │ headers={"User-Agent": UA})                                             │
     │             with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:       │
     │                 hits = json.loads(resp.read())                          │
     │             if hits:                                                    │
     │                 glat, glng = float(hits[0]["lat"]),                     │
     │ float(hits[0]["lon"])                                                   │
     │                 if abs(glat - lat) < 0.15 and abs(glng - lng) < 0.15:   │
     │ # sanity: within about 15 km                                            │
     │                     lat, lng, source = glat, glng, "nominatim"          │
     │         except Exception as exc:  # network failure keeps the fallback  │
     │             print(f"{sid}: geocode failed ({exc}); using fallback")     │
     │         out[sid] = {"lat": round(lat, 6), "lng": round(lng, 6),         │
     │ "source": source}                                                       │
     │         print(sid, out[sid])                                            │
     │         time.sleep(1.1)                                                 │
     │     (ROOT / "data" / "localities.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,      │
     │ indent=2), encoding="utf-8")                                            │
     │     return 0                                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ if __name__ == "__main__":                                              │
     │     raise SystemExit(main())                                            │

     │ """Weather for the simulation: archived Open-Meteo series replayed      │
     │ against the sim clock,                                                  │
     │ with a synthetic fallback so nothing depends on the network or on data  │
     │ files."""                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │ from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta                           │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │ from pydantic import BaseModel                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.network import stable_seed                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ KEYS = ("temp_c", "cloud_pct", "ghi", "rh", "wind100")                  │
     │ PLACE_OF_TOWN = {"town_bareilly": "bareilly", "town_mathura":           │
     │ "mathura"}                                                              │
     │ SOLAR_BELT = "solarbelt"                                                │
     │ STEP = timedelta(minutes=c.INTERVAL_MIN)                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class Scenario(BaseModel):                                              │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     label: str                                                          │
     │     description: str                                                    │
     │     weather_start: str  # ISO UTC of the first replayed weather sample  │
     │     days: int                                                           │
     │     re_share: float                                                     │
     │     grid_storage_frac: float                                            │
     │     rooftop_multiplier: float = 1.0                                     │
     │     ev_multiplier: float = 1.0                                          │
     │     source: str = "synthetic weather"                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ BUILTIN_SCENARIOS: dict[str, Scenario] = {                              │
     │     "heatwave_evening": Scenario(                                       │
     │         id="heatwave_evening", label="Heatwave week", days=7,           │
     │ re_share=0.40, grid_storage_frac=0.05,                                  │
     │         description="Hottest week of the season. Evening demand peaks   │
     │ as solar output falls to zero.",                                        │
     │         weather_start="2025-06-08T00:30:00Z"),                          │
     │     "monsoon_cloud": Scenario(                                          │
     │         id="monsoon_cloud", label="Monsoon cloud week", days=7,         │
     │ re_share=0.40, grid_storage_frac=0.05,                                  │
     │         description="Heavy cloud cuts daytime solar output; humid       │
     │ nights keep demand high.",                                              │
     │         weather_start="2025-07-20T00:30:00Z"),                          │
     │     "solar_noon": Scenario(                                             │
     │         id="solar_noon", label="Rooftop solar noon", days=7,            │
     │ re_share=0.40, grid_storage_frac=0.05,                                  │
     │         rooftop_multiplier=4.0,                                         │
     │         description="Clear mild week with four times today's rooftop    │
     │ solar: noon over-voltage, evening ramp.",                               │
     │         weather_start="2025-04-06T00:30:00Z"),                          │
     │     "re_2047": Scenario(                                                │
     │         id="re_2047", label="2047 renewable share", days=7,             │
     │ re_share=0.70, grid_storage_frac=0.12,                                  │
     │         ev_multiplier=2.0,                                              │
     │         description="The heatwave week with a 70 percent renewable      │
     │ share and twice the EV charging.",                                      │
     │         weather_start="2025-06-08T00:30:00Z"),                          │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class WeatherSeries:                                                    │
     │     place: str                                                          │
     │     start: datetime                                                     │
     │     temp_c: np.ndarray                                                  │
     │     cloud_pct: np.ndarray                                               │
     │     ghi: np.ndarray                                                     │
     │     rh: np.ndarray                                                      │
     │     wind100: np.ndarray                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def __len__(self) -> int:                                           │
     │         return len(self.temp_c)                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _ist_hours(start: datetime, n: int) -> np.ndarray:                  │
     │     first = start.astimezone(UTC).hour + start.minute / 60 + 5.5        │
     │     return (first + np.arange(n) * c.DT_H) % 24                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def synthetic_series(place: str, start: datetime, days: int, t_max:     │
     │ float = 41.0, t_min: float = 29.0,                                      │
     │                      cloud: float = 20.0, wind: float = 5.0, seed: int  │
     │ = 0) -> WeatherSeries:                                                  │
     │     n = days * c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                                          │
     │     h = _ist_hours(start, n)                                            │
     │     rng = np.random.default_rng(stable_seed("weather", place, seed))    │
     │     day = np.arange(n) // c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                               │
     │     day_bias = rng.normal(0.0, 1.2, days)[day]                          │
     │     temp = t_min + (t_max - t_min) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos((h - 15.0) /   │
     │ 24 * 2 * np.pi)) + day_bias                                             │
     │     cloud_arr = np.clip(cloud + rng.normal(0, 12, days)[day] +          │
     │ rng.normal(0, 4, n), 0, 100)                                            │
     │     sun = np.clip(np.sin((h - 5.5) / 13.0 * np.pi), 0, None)            │
     │     sun[(h < 5.5) | (h > 18.5)] = 0.0                                   │
     │     ghi = 950.0 * sun * (1 - 0.75 * (cloud_arr / 100.0) ** 2)           │
     │     rh = np.clip(45 - 0.8 * (temp - 30) + 0.2 * cloud_arr, 10, 98)      │
     │     wind_arr = np.clip(wind + rng.normal(0, 1.5, days)[day] + 1.5 *     │
     │ np.sin((h - 3) / 24 * 2 * np.pi), 0.5, 20)                              │
     │     return WeatherSeries(place, start, temp, cloud_arr, ghi, rh,        │
     │ wind_arr)                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class WeatherProvider:                                                  │
     │     def __init__(self, series: dict[str, WeatherSeries], scenario:      │
     │ Scenario, sim_start: datetime):                                         │
     │         self.series = series                                            │
     │         self.scenario = scenario                                        │
     │         self.sim_start = sim_start                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _index(self, place: str, when: datetime, slots: int) ->         │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │         offset = int(round((when - self.sim_start) / STEP))             │
     │         return (offset + np.arange(slots)) % len(self.series[place])    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def actual(self, place: str, start: datetime, slots: int) ->        │
     │ dict[str, np.ndarray]:                                                  │
     │         s = self.series[place]                                          │
     │         idx = self._index(place, start, slots)                          │
     │         return {k: getattr(s, k)[idx].astype(float) for k in KEYS}      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def forecast(self, place: str, issued_at: datetime, start:          │
     │ datetime, slots: int) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:                         │
     │         """Actual weather plus an error that grows with lead time.      │
     │ Seeded by place and issue hour,                                         │
     │         so re-issuing at the same hour gives the same forecast."""      │
     │         out = self.actual(place, start, slots)                          │
     │         lead_h = np.maximum(0.0, (start - issued_at).total_seconds() /  │
     │ 3600 + np.arange(slots) * c.DT_H)                                       │
     │         rng = np.random.default_rng(stable_seed("fc", place,            │
     │ issued_at.strftime("%Y%m%d%H")))                                        │
     │         growth = np.sqrt(lead_h / 24.0)                                 │
     │         walk = np.cumsum(rng.normal(0, 1, slots)) /                     │
     │ np.sqrt(np.arange(1, slots + 1))                                        │
     │         out["temp_c"] = out["temp_c"] + 1.2 * growth * walk             │
     │         out["cloud_pct"] = np.clip(out["cloud_pct"] + 18.0 * growth *   │
     │ rng.normal(0, 1, slots), 0, 100)                                        │
     │         out["ghi"] = np.clip(out["ghi"] * (1 + 0.20 * growth *          │
     │ rng.normal(0, 1, slots)), 0, None)                                      │
     │         out["wind100"] = np.clip(out["wind100"] + 1.5 * growth *        │
     │ rng.normal(0, 1, slots), 0, None)                                       │
     │         return out                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _read_series(path: Path) -> WeatherSeries:                          │
     │     raw = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))                  │
     │     start = datetime.fromisoformat(raw["start"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) │
     │     return WeatherSeries(raw["place"], start, *(np.array(raw[k],        │
     │ dtype=float) for k in KEYS))                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def load_weather_provider(data_dir: Path, scenario_id: str, sim_start:  │
     │ datetime) -> WeatherProvider:                                           │
     │     scen_path = data_dir / "scenarios" / f"{scenario_id}.json"          │
     │     scenario =                                                          │
     │ (Scenario.model_validate_json(scen_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if │
     │ scen_path.exists()                                                      │
     │                 else BUILTIN_SCENARIOS.get(scenario_id,                 │
     │ BUILTIN_SCENARIOS["heatwave_evening"]))                                 │
     │     w_start =                                                           │
     │ datetime.fromisoformat(scenario.weather_start.replace("Z", "+00:00"))   │
     │     series: dict[str, WeatherSeries] = {}                               │
     │     for place in ("bareilly", "mathura", SOLAR_BELT):                   │
     │         path = data_dir / "weather" / f"{place}.json"                   │
     │         if path.exists():                                               │
     │             full = _read_series(path)                                   │
     │             first = int(round((w_start - full.start) / STEP))           │
     │             n = scenario.days * c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                         │
     │             if 0 <= first and first + n <= len(full):                   │
     │                 sl = slice(first, first + n)                            │
     │                 series[place] = WeatherSeries(place, w_start,           │
     │ full.temp_c[sl], full.cloud_pct[sl], full.ghi[sl],                      │
     │                                               full.rh[sl],              │
     │ full.wind100[sl])                                                       │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │         params = {"monsoon_cloud": dict(t_max=34.0, t_min=27.0,         │
     │ cloud=75.0),                                                            │
     │                   "solar_noon": dict(t_max=35.0, t_min=21.0,            │
     │ cloud=8.0)}.get(scenario.id, {})                                        │
     │         series[place] = synthetic_series(place, w_start, scenario.days, │
     │ seed=1, **params)                                                       │
     │     return WeatherProvider(series, scenario, sim_start)                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Run .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/test_weather.py  │

     │ - [ ] Step 5: Write backend/scripts/fetch_weather.py                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Downloads archived hourly weather from Open-Meteo (free, no key) for │
     │ Bareilly, Mathura and a                                                 │
     │ Rajasthan solar-belt point, interpolates to 15 minutes and writes       │
     │ data/weather/*.json. Then picks                                         │
     │ the scenario weeks from the data and writes data/scenarios/*.json.      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Open-Meteo archive variables used: temperature_2m,                      │
     │ relative_humidity_2m, cloud_cover,                                      │
     │ shortwave_radiation, wind_speed_100m. Attribution: Weather data by      │
     │ Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Run from backend/:  .venv/Scripts/python scripts/fetch_weather.py       │
     │ """                                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import sys                                                              │
     │ import urllib.request                                                   │
     │ from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta                           │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]                              │
     │ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid.weather import BUILTIN_SCENARIOS                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ PLACES = {"bareilly": (28.367, 79.430), "mathura": (27.492, 77.674),    │
     │ "solarbelt": (27.54, 71.92)}  # Bhadla                                  │
     │ START_DATE, END_DATE = "2025-03-15", "2025-09-30"                       │
     │ URL = ("https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude={lat}&lo │
     │ ngitude={lng}"                                                          │
     │        "&start_date={s}&end_date={e}&hourly=temperature_2m,relative_hum │
     │ idity_2m,cloud_cover,"                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ "shortwave_radiation,wind_speed_100m&wind_speed_unit=ms&timezone=UTC")  │
     │ MAP = {"temp_c": "temperature_2m", "rh": "relative_humidity_2m",        │
     │ "cloud_pct": "cloud_cover",                                             │
     │        "ghi": "shortwave_radiation", "wind100": "wind_speed_100m"}      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def fetch(place: str, lat: float, lng: float) -> dict:                  │
     │     url = URL.format(lat=lat, lng=lng, s=START_DATE, e=END_DATE)        │
     │     req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":            │
     │ "LifelineGrid-weather/1.0"})                                            │
     │     with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:               │
     │         hourly = json.loads(resp.read())["hourly"]                      │
     │     n = len(hourly["time"])                                             │
     │     x_h, x_q = np.arange(n), np.arange((n - 1) * 4 + 1) / 4.0           │
     │     out = {"place": place, "lat": lat, "lng": lng, "start":             │
     │ hourly["time"][0] + ":00Z", "step_min": 15,                             │
     │            "attribution": "Weather data by Open-Meteo.com"}             │
     │     for key, var in MAP.items():                                        │
     │         raw = np.array([np.nan if v is None else v for v in             │
     │ hourly[var]], dtype=float)                                              │
     │         good = ~np.isnan(raw)                                           │
     │         raw = np.interp(x_h, x_h[good], raw[good])                      │
     │         out[key] = np.round(np.interp(x_q, x_h, raw), 2).tolist()       │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def best_week(series: dict, months: tuple[int, ...], score) ->          │
     │ datetime:                                                               │
     │     start = datetime.fromisoformat(series["start"].replace("Z",         │
     │ "+00:00"))                                                              │
     │     temp, cloud = np.array(series["temp_c"]),                           │
     │ np.array(series["cloud_pct"])                                           │
     │     days = len(temp) // 96                                              │
     │     best, best_day = -1e18, 0                                           │
     │     for d in range(days - 7):                                           │
     │         day0 = start + timedelta(days=d)                                │
     │         if day0.month not in months:                                    │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         sl = slice(d * 96, (d + 7) * 96)                                │
     │         s = score(temp[sl].reshape(7, 96), cloud[sl].reshape(7, 96))    │
     │         if s > best:                                                    │
     │             best, best_day = s, d                                       │
     │     day = start + timedelta(days=best_day)                              │
     │     return day.replace(hour=0, minute=30, tzinfo=UTC)  # 06:00 IST      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def main() -> int:                                                      │
     │     out_dir = ROOT / "data" / "weather"                                 │
     │     out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                          │
     │     data = {}                                                           │
     │     for place, (lat, lng) in PLACES.items():                            │
     │         data[place] = fetch(place, lat, lng)                            │
     │         (out_dir / f"{place}.json").write_text(json.dumps(data[place]), │
     │ encoding="utf-8")                                                       │
     │         print(place, len(data[place]["temp_c"]), "samples from",        │
     │ data[place]["start"])                                                   │
     │     b = data["bareilly"]                                                │
     │     weeks = {                                                           │
     │         "heatwave_evening": best_week(b, (4, 5, 6), lambda t, c:        │
     │ t.max(axis=1).mean()),                                                  │
     │         "monsoon_cloud": best_week(b, (7, 8), lambda t, c: c.mean()),   │
     │         "solar_noon": best_week(b, (3, 4), lambda t, c: -c.mean() -     │
     │ abs(t.max(axis=1).mean() - 34)),                                        │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │     weeks["re_2047"] = weeks["heatwave_evening"]                        │
     │     scen_dir = ROOT / "data" / "scenarios"                              │
     │     scen_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                         │
     │     for sid, when in weeks.items():                                     │
     │         sc = BUILTIN_SCENARIOS[sid].model_copy(update={                 │
     │             "weather_start": when.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),       │
     │             "source": f"Open-Meteo archive, week of {when:%d %b %Y}"})  │
     │         (scen_dir /                                                     │
     │ f"{sid}.json").write_text(sc.model_dump_json(indent=1),                 │
     │ encoding="utf-8")                                                       │
     │         print(sid, "->", sc.weather_start)                              │
     │     return 0                                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ if __name__ == "__main__":                                              │
     │     raise SystemExit(main())                                            │

     │ """Bottom-up demand: one profile per consumer from an archetype shape,  │
     │ a scale, a cooling term                                                 │
     │ and noise; plus the profiles of shared assets (chargers, pumps, towers, │

     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │ from datetime import UTC, datetime                                      │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.models import Network                                     │
     │ from app.grid.network import ConsumerArrays                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # Hourly weights, index 0 = 00:00 IST. Each list peaks at 1.0.          │
     │ SHAPES_24: dict[str, list[float]] = {                                   │
     │     "res_low": [.55, .50, .48, .46, .46, .50, .62, .70, .60, .50, .45,  │
     │ .45, .50, .52, .50, .48, .50, .58, .74, .90, 1.0, 1.0, .88, .68],       │
     │     "res_mid": [.78, .72, .68, .64, .60, .58, .62, .70, .66, .60, .56,  │
     │ .56, .60, .64, .64, .62, .62, .66, .78, .90, .98, 1.0, .98, .88],       │
     │     "res_high": [.88, .84, .80, .76, .70, .60, .55, .58, .56, .52, .50, │
     │ .52, .58, .64, .66, .64, .62, .64, .74, .86, .95, 1.0, 1.0, .95],       │
     │     "shop": [.25, .25, .25, .25, .25, .25, .30, .40, .60, .85, .95,     │
     │ 1.0, 1.0, .90, .90, .95, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, .95, .75, .45, .30],       │
     │     "workshop": [.10, .10, .10, .10, .10, .10, .10, .10, .50, .90, 1.0, │
     │ 1.0, .90, .60, .90, 1.0, 1.0, .90, .60, .30, .15, .10, .10, .10],       │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │ HUB_24 = [.85, .80, .70, .50, .30, .15, .05, .05, .10, .15, .20, .25,   │
     │ .30, .30, .25, .20, .20, .30, .55, .80, .95, 1.0, 1.0, .95]             │
     │ PV_PERFORMANCE_RATIO = 0.80                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def interp96(v: list[float] | np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:                │
     │     arr = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)                                    │
     │     return np.interp(np.arange(c.SLOTS_PER_DAY) / 4.0, np.arange(25),   │
     │ np.append(arr, arr[0]))                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def design_day_temperature(t_max: float = 42.0, t_min: float = 30.0) -> │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │     hours = np.arange(c.SLOTS_PER_DAY) / 4.0                            │
     │     return t_min + (t_max - t_min) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.cos((hours - 15.0) │
     │ / 24 * 2 * np.pi))                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def ist_slot(when: datetime) -> int:                                    │
     │     minutes = (when.astimezone(UTC).hour * 60 + when.minute + 330) %    │
     │ 1440                                                                    │
     │     return minutes // c.INTERVAL_MIN                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def load_shapes(data_dir: Path) -> dict[str, np.ndarray] | None:        │
     │     path = data_dir / "load_shapes.json"                                │
     │     if not path.exists():                                               │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │     raw = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))                  │
     │     return {k: np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for k, v in                   │
     │ raw["shapes"].items() if k in SHAPES_24}                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class LoadModel:                                                        │
     │     def __init__(self, consumers: ConsumerArrays, shapes: dict[str,     │
     │ np.ndarray] | None = None, seed: int = 0):                              │
     │         self.consumers = consumers                                      │
     │         self.seed = seed                                                │
     │         base = {k: interp96(v) for k, v in SHAPES_24.items()}           │
     │         self.shape_source = "built-in archetypes"                       │
     │         if shapes:                                                      │
     │             base.update(shapes)                                         │
     │             self.shape_source = "CEEW smart-meter data"                 │
     │         self._shape = np.stack([base[a] for a in c.ARCHETYPES])  # (5,  │
     │ 96)                                                                     │
     │         self._peak = np.array(c.ARCH_PEAK_KW)                           │
     │         self._cool = np.array(c.ARCH_COOL_PER_C)                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def expected_day(self, temp96: np.ndarray, dow: int) -> np.ndarray: │
     │         """`temp96` is (96,) for one temperature everywhere, or (N, 96) │
     │ for a row per consumer."""                                              │
     │         a = self.consumers.arch                                         │
     │         t = np.asarray(temp96, dtype=float)                             │
     │         t = t[None, :] if t.ndim == 1 else t                            │
     │         cooling = 1.0 + self._cool[a][:, None] * np.maximum(0.0, t -    │
     │ c.COOLING_BASE_C)                                                       │
     │         day = self._peak[a][:, None] * self.consumers.scale[:, None] *  │
     │ self._shape[a] * cooling                                                │
     │         if dow == 6:  # Sunday: shops and workshops quieter, homes      │
     │ slightly busier                                                         │
     │             factor = np.where(self.consumers.tier == 2, 0.6, 1.04)      │
     │             day = day * factor[:, None]                                 │
     │         return day                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def realise_day(self, day_index: int, temp96: np.ndarray, dow: int) │
     │ -> np.ndarray:                                                          │
     │         rng = np.random.default_rng([self.seed, day_index])             │
     │         n = self.consumers.n                                            │
     │         daily = rng.lognormal(-0.01125, 0.15, n)  # mean 1              │
     │         slot = rng.lognormal(-0.02, 0.20, (n, c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))  # mean │
     │ 1                                                                       │
     │         return self.expected_day(temp96, dow) * daily[:, None] * slot   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def dt_totals(self, per_consumer: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:        │
     │         d = len(self.consumers.dt_slices)                               │
     │         out = np.zeros((d, per_consumer.shape[1]))                      │
     │         for i, sl in enumerate(self.consumers.dt_slices):               │
     │             out[i] = per_consumer[sl].sum(axis=0)                       │
     │         return out                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class AssetProfiles:                                                    │
     │     dt_kw: np.ndarray  # (D, 96) all asset load per DT (chargers,       │
     │ pumps, towers, lights, PHC, school)                                     │
     │     hub_kw: np.ndarray  # (H, 96)                                       │
     │     shift_kw: np.ndarray  # (R, 96) scheduled draw of each shiftable    │
     │ load                                                                    │
     │     facility_kw: np.ndarray  # (F, 96)                                  │
     │     pv_kw: np.ndarray  # (D, 96) rooftop generation                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _facility_profile(kind: str, load_kw: float, dow: int) ->           │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │     hours = np.arange(c.SLOTS_PER_DAY) / 4.0                            │
     │     if kind == "water_pump":                                            │
     │         on = ((hours >= 5) & (hours < 8)) | ((hours >= 17) & (hours <   │
     │ 20))                                                                    │
     │     elif kind == "street_light":                                        │
     │         on = (hours >= 18.5) | (hours < 5.5)                            │
     │     elif kind == "school":                                              │
     │         on = (hours >= 8) & (hours < 14) & (dow < 6)                    │
     │     else:  # phc, telecom_tower: continuous                             │
     │         on = np.ones(c.SLOTS_PER_DAY, dtype=bool)                       │
     │     return np.where(on, load_kw, 0.0)                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def asset_profiles(network: Network, temp_c: np.ndarray, ghi:           │
     │ np.ndarray, dow: int,                                                   │
     │                    ev_multiplier: float = 1.0, rooftop_multiplier:      │
     │ float = 1.0) -> AssetProfiles:                                          │
     │     dt_pos = {d.id: i for i, d in enumerate(network.transformers)}      │
     │     d = len(network.transformers)                                       │
     │     dt_kw = np.zeros((d, c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))                              │
     │     hub_shape = interp96(HUB_24)                                        │
     │     hub_kw = np.stack([h.max_kw * ev_multiplier * hub_shape for h in    │
     │ network.charger_hubs]) if network.charger_hubs else np.zeros((0,        │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))                                                       │
     │     for k, h in enumerate(network.charger_hubs):                        │
     │         dt_kw[dt_pos[h.dt_id]] += hub_kw[k]                             │
     │     facility_kw = np.stack([_facility_profile(f.kind, f.load_kw, dow)   │
     │ for f in network.critical_facilities])                                  │
     │     fac_pos = {f.id: k for k, f in                                      │
     │ enumerate(network.critical_facilities)}                                 │
     │     for k, f in enumerate(network.critical_facilities):                 │
     │         dt_kw[dt_pos[f.dt_id]] += facility_kw[k]                        │
     │     shift_kw = np.stack([facility_kw[fac_pos[s.critical_facility_id]]   │
     │ for s in network.shiftable_loads]) if network.shiftable_loads else      │
     │ np.zeros((0, c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))                                          │
     │     # temp_c and ghi are (96,) for one weather everywhere, or (D, 96)   │
     │ for a row per DT.                                                       │
     │     temp = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(temp_c, dtype=float), (d,         │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))                                                       │
     │     sun = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(ghi, dtype=float), (d,             │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))                                                       │
     │     derate = 1.0 - 0.004 * np.maximum(0.0, temp - 25.0)                 │
     │     pv_unit = PV_PERFORMANCE_RATIO * np.clip(sun / 1000.0, 0, 1.2) *    │
     │ derate                                                                  │
     │     solar = np.array([dt.solar_kw for dt in network.transformers])      │
     │     pv_kw = solar[:, None] * rooftop_multiplier * pv_unit               │
     │     return AssetProfiles(dt_kw=dt_kw, hub_kw=hub_kw, shift_kw=shift_kw, │
     │ facility_kw=facility_kw, pv_kw=pv_kw)                                   │

     │ """Sizes a network from the load model: DT ratings, feeder capacities,  │
     │ sub-division allocations."""                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.loadgen import LoadModel, asset_profiles,                 │

     │                                                                         │
     │ def design_day_gross(repo: NetworkRepository, seed: int) -> np.ndarray: │
     │     """(D, 96) expected consumer plus asset load on the design day,     │
     │ with no solar."""                                                       │
     │     temp = design_day_temperature()                                     │
     │     model = LoadModel(repo.consumers, seed=seed)                        │
     │     assets = asset_profiles(repo.network, temp_c=temp,                  │
     │ ghi=np.zeros(c.SLOTS_PER_DAY), dow=2)                                   │
     │     return model.dt_totals(model.expected_day(temp, dow=2)) +           │
     │ assets.dt_kw                                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def size_network(network: Network, seed: int, target: tuple[float,      │
     │ float] = (0.62, 1.18)) -> Network:                                      │
     │     """Rating = the standard rating nearest to peak / target loading,   │
     │ target drawn per DT.                                                    │
     │     Feeder capacity = 1.25 x its design-day peak. alloc_kw =            │
     │ sub-division design-day peak plus HT loss."""                           │
     │     repo = NetworkRepository(network)                                   │
     │     gross = design_day_gross(repo, seed)                                │
     │     ratings = np.array(c.DT_RATINGS_KVA)                                │
     │     for i, dt in enumerate(network.transformers):                       │
     │         rng = np.random.default_rng(stable_seed(seed, dt.id, "rating")) │
     │         want = float(gross[i].max()) / float(rng.uniform(*target))      │
     │         dt.rating_kva = int(ratings[np.argmin(np.abs(ratings *          │
     │ c.POWER_FACTOR - want))])                                               │
     │     for f in network.feeders:                                           │
     │         idx = [repo.dt_index(d) for d in f.dt_ids]                      │
     │         f.capacity_kw = round(float(gross[idx].sum(axis=0).max()) *     │
     │ 1.25, 1)                                                                │
     │     for sd in network.subdivisions:                                     │
     │         idx = repo.dts_of(sd.id)                                        │
     │         sd.alloc_kw = round(float(gross[idx].sum(axis=0).max()) * (1 +  │
     │ c.HT_LOSS_FRAC), 1)                                                     │
     │     return network                                                      │
     │                                                                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 5: Write backend/scripts/calibrate_ceew.py (optional         │
     │ calibration; the product works without it)                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Derives normalised residential day shapes from the CEEW smart-meter  │
     │ dataset                                                                 │
     │ ("High frequency smart meter data from two districts in India (Mathura  │
     │ and Bareilly)",                                                         │
     │ Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/GOCHJH) and writes                   │
     │ data/load_shapes.json.                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ The dataset is large, so this script downloads ONE data file. Steps:    │
     │   1. List files:  GET https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/datasets/:persi │
     │ stentId/?persistentId=doi:10.7910/DVN/GOCHJH                            │
     │   2. Pick the first tabular file whose name contains "Bareilly" and     │
     │ "2020"; download                                                        │
     │      GET                                                                │
     │ https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/access/datafile/{id}?format=original  │
     │   3. Print the header row. Identify the timestamp, meter id and energy  │
     │ (kWh per 3 minutes) columns.                                            │
     │      Column names differ between files, so match case-insensitively on: │
     │ time/date, meter, kwh/energy.                                           │
     │   4. Keep April to September rows. Convert 3-minute kWh to kW (kWh *    │
     │ 20). Resample each meter to                                             │
     │      15-minute mean kW, indexed in IST.                                 │
     │   5. For each meter compute mean daily kWh. Split meters into terciles: │
     │ low, mid, high.                                                         │
     │   6. For each tercile average the 96-slot day profile across meters and │
     │ days and divide by its max.                                             │
     │   7. Write {"source": "...", "meters": n, "shapes": {"res_low":         │
     │ [...96...], "res_mid": [...], "res_high": [...]}}.                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ If any step fails (network, format), exit 1 without writing; the        │
     │ built-in shapes are used and                                            │
     │ LoadModel.shape_source reports "built-in archetypes".                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Run from backend/:  .venv/Scripts/python scripts/calibrate_ceew.py      │
     │ """                                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import io                                                               │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import sys                                                              │
     │ import urllib.request                                                   │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │ import pandas as pd                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]                              │
     │ DOI = "doi:10.7910/DVN/GOCHJH"                                          │
     │ LIST_URL = f"https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/datasets/:persistentId/? │
     │ persistentId={DOI}"                                                     │
     │ FILE_URL = "https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/access/datafile/{id}?form │
     │ at=original"                                                            │
     │ UA = {"User-Agent": "LifelineGrid-calibration/1.0"}                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _get(url: str) -> bytes:                                            │
     │     with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,             │
     │ headers=UA), timeout=300) as resp:                                      │
     │         return resp.read()                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _pick(cols: list[str], *needles: str) -> str:                       │
     │     for col in cols:                                                    │
     │         if any(n in col.lower() for n in needles):                      │
     │             return col                                                  │
     │     raise KeyError(f"no column matching {needles} in {cols}")           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def main() -> int:                                                      │
     │     try:                                                                │
     │         files =                                                         │
     │ json.loads(_get(LIST_URL))["data"]["latestVersion"]["files"]            │
     │         names = [(f["dataFile"]["id"], f["dataFile"]["filename"]) for f │
     │ in files]                                                               │
     │         fid, fname = next((i, n) for i, n in names if "bareilly" in     │
     │ n.lower() and "2020" in n)                                              │
     │         print("downloading", fname)                                     │
     │         df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(_get(FILE_URL.format(id=fid))),     │
     │ sep=None, engine="python")                                              │
     │         print("columns:", list(df.columns))                             │
     │         t_col = _pick(list(df.columns), "time", "date")                 │
     │         m_col = _pick(list(df.columns), "meter")                        │
     │         e_col = _pick(list(df.columns), "kwh", "energy")                │
     │         df[t_col] = pd.to_datetime(df[t_col], errors="coerce")          │
     │         df = df.dropna(subset=[t_col, e_col])                           │
     │         df = df[df[t_col].dt.month.between(4, 9)]                       │
     │         df["kw"] = df[e_col].astype(float) * 20.0                       │
     │         profiles, daily = {}, {}                                        │
     │         for meter, g in df.groupby(m_col):                              │
     │             s =                                                         │
     │ g.set_index(t_col)["kw"].resample("15min").mean().dropna()              │
     │             if len(s) < 96 * 20:                                        │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             slot = s.index.hour * 4 + s.index.minute // 15              │
     │             prof =                                                      │
     │ s.groupby(slot).mean().reindex(range(96)).interpolate().to_numpy()      │
     │             profiles[meter] = prof                                      │
     │             daily[meter] = float(prof.sum() * 0.25)                     │
     │         meters = sorted(daily, key=daily.get)                           │
     │         thirds = np.array_split(meters, 3)                              │
     │         shapes = {}                                                     │
     │         for key, group in zip(("res_low", "res_mid", "res_high"),       │
     │ thirds, strict=True):                                                   │
     │             mean = np.mean([profiles[m] for m in group], axis=0)        │
     │             shapes[key] = np.round(mean / mean.max(), 4).tolist()       │
     │         out = {"source": f"CEEW smart-meter data, {fname}, {DOI}",      │
     │ "meters": len(meters), "shapes": shapes}                                │
     │         (ROOT / "data" /                                                │
     │ "load_shapes.json").write_text(json.dumps(out), encoding="utf-8")       │
     │         print("wrote load_shapes.json from", len(meters), "meters")     │
     │         return 0                                                        │
     │     except Exception as exc:                                            │
     │         print("calibration skipped:", exc, file=sys.stderr)             │
     │         return 1                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ if __name__ == "__main__":                                              │
     │     raise SystemExit(main())                                            │
     │                                                                         │

     │ Task A6: Transformer thermal model                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/thermal.py                                   │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_thermal.py                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Produces: ThermalParams, DEFAULT_THERMAL, top_oil_rise_ultimate(k,    │
     │ p), hot_spot_rise(k, p), step_top_oil(prev_rise, k, dt_h, p),           │
     │ hot_spot_temp(theta_amb, to_rise, k, p), ageing_factor(theta_h, p),     │

     │ rating. Verified reference values: at k = 1, ambient 30 °C the hot-spot │
     │ is exactly 110.0 °C and the ageing factor is 1.0; at k = 1.2, ambient   │
     │ 42 °C the hot-spot is 146.1 °C and the ageing factor is about 29.       │

     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/thermal.py                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Transformer thermal model after IEEE C57.91 Clause 7, for ONAN       │
     │ distribution transformers.                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ k is the load in per unit of rating. Temperatures are deg C, rises are  │
     │ kelvin over ambient.                                                    │
     │ Parameters are typical values for a 65 K-rise oil-immersed unit; verify │
     │ against the DISCOM's                                                    │
     │ IS 1180 test certificates before a pilot."""                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import math                                                             │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass(frozen=True)                                                 │
     │ class ThermalParams:                                                    │
     │     d_theta_to_r: float = 55.0  # top-oil rise over ambient at rated    │
     │ load                                                                    │
     │     d_theta_hs_r: float = 25.0  # hot-spot rise over top oil at rated   │
     │ load                                                                    │
     │     ratio_r: float = 5.0  # load loss / no-load loss at rated load      │
     │     n: float = 0.8  # oil exponent, ONAN                                │
     │     m: float = 0.8  # winding exponent, ONAN                            │
     │     tau_to_h: float = 3.0  # top-oil time constant, hours               │
     │     theta_ref: float = 110.0  # reference hot-spot for unit ageing      │
     │     normal_life_h: float = 180_000.0                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ DEFAULT_THERMAL = ThermalParams()                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def top_oil_rise_ultimate(k, p: ThermalParams = DEFAULT_THERMAL):       │
     │     return p.d_theta_to_r * ((np.square(k) * p.ratio_r + 1.0) /         │
     │ (p.ratio_r + 1.0)) ** p.n                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def hot_spot_rise(k, p: ThermalParams = DEFAULT_THERMAL):               │
     │     return p.d_theta_hs_r * np.power(np.maximum(k, 0.0), 2.0 * p.m)     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def step_top_oil(prev_rise, k, dt_h: float = c.DT_H, p: ThermalParams = │
     │ DEFAULT_THERMAL):                                                       │
     │     """Top-oil rise one interval later. The winding time constant       │
     │ (minutes) is treated as instant."""                                     │
     │     ultimate = top_oil_rise_ultimate(k, p)                              │
     │     return ultimate + (prev_rise - ultimate) * math.exp(-dt_h /         │
     │ p.tau_to_h)                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def hot_spot_temp(theta_amb, to_rise, k, p: ThermalParams =             │
     │ DEFAULT_THERMAL):                                                       │
     │     return theta_amb + to_rise + hot_spot_rise(k, p)                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def ageing_factor(theta_h, p: ThermalParams = DEFAULT_THERMAL):         │
     │     """Ageing acceleration factor F_AA. 1.0 at the reference hot-spot;  │
     │ roughly doubles every 6 to 7 K."""                                      │
     │     return np.exp(15000.0 / (p.theta_ref + 273.0) - 15000.0 /           │
     │ (np.asarray(theta_h, dtype=float) + 273.0))                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def loss_of_life_pct(faa, dt_h: float = c.DT_H, p: ThermalParams =      │
     │ DEFAULT_THERMAL):                                                       │
     │     return 100.0 * faa * dt_h / p.normal_life_h                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def max_k_for_hotspot(theta_amb: float, limit: float =                  │
     │ c.HOTSPOT_LIMIT_C, p: ThermalParams = DEFAULT_THERMAL) -> float:        │
     │     """Largest steady load (per unit) that keeps the hot-spot at or     │
     │ below `limit`. Bisection."""                                            │
     │     lo, hi = 0.0, 2.5                                                   │
     │     for _ in range(40):                                                 │
     │         mid = (lo + hi) / 2                                             │
     │         if hot_spot_temp(theta_amb, top_oil_rise_ultimate(mid, p), mid, │
     │ p) > limit:                                                             │
     │             hi = mid                                                    │
     │         else:                                                           │
     │             lo = mid                                                    │
     │     return lo                                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ _TABLE_T = np.arange(0.0, 61.0, 1.0)                                    │
     │ _TABLES: dict[float, np.ndarray] = {}                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def dynamic_limit_pu(temp_c: np.ndarray, limit: float =                 │
     │ c.HOTSPOT_LIMIT_C) -> np.ndarray:                                       │
     │     """Dynamic thermal rating: allowed load per unit for each ambient   │
     │ temperature."""                                                         │
     │     if limit not in _TABLES:                                            │
     │         _TABLES[limit] = np.array([max_k_for_hotspot(float(t), limit)   │
     │ for t in _TABLE_T])                                                     │
     │     return np.interp(np.asarray(temp_c, dtype=float), _TABLE_T,         │
     │ _TABLES[limit])                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Run .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/test_thermal.py  │
     │ -q → Expected: 7 passed.                                                │
     │ - [ ] Step 5: Commit git add -A && git commit -m "feat(grid): IEEE      │
     │ C57.91 transformer thermal model"                                       │

     │ ---                                                                     │
     │ Task A7: LV power flow                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/powerflow.py                                 │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_powerflow.py                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - PowerFlowResult dataclass: v_pu: np.ndarray, v_min: float, v_max:   │
     │ float, loss_kw: float, edge_amps: np.ndarray, iterations: int,          │
     │ converged: bool                                                         │
     │   - bfs_powerflow(parent, r_ohm, x_ohm, p_kw, q_kvar, v0=V_NOMINAL,     │
     │ tol=1e-4, max_iter=30) -> PowerFlowResult                               │
     │   - dt_powerflow(lv: LvNetwork, node_load_kw: np.ndarray, node_gen_kw:  │
     │ np.ndarray | None = None, source_pu: float = 1.0) -> PowerFlowResult    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ The solver is a backward/forward sweep on a radial tree, balanced       │
     │ three-phase, per-phase equivalent. Node 0 is the DT's LV bus. Verified: │
     │ a two-bus case (10 kW, 0.5 Ω) gives 0.96743 pu, equal to the closed     │
     │ form (V0 + sqrt(V0² − 4RP/3)) / 2.                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests backend/tests/test_powerflow.py   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import math                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │

     │                                                                         │
