     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 2: Run → Expected: FAIL, module not found.                   │
     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/powerflow.py                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Backward/forward sweep power flow for one radial LV network          │
     │ (balanced, per-phase equivalent)."""                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import math                                                             │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.models import LvNetwork                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ TAN_PHI = math.tan(math.acos(c.POWER_FACTOR))                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class PowerFlowResult:                                                  │
     │     v_pu: np.ndarray                                                    │
     │     v_min: float                                                        │
     │     v_max: float                                                        │
     │     loss_kw: float                                                      │
     │     edge_amps: np.ndarray                                               │
     │     iterations: int                                                     │
     │     converged: bool                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def bfs_powerflow(parent, r_ohm, x_ohm, p_kw, q_kvar, v0: float =       │
     │ c.V_NOMINAL, tol: float = 1e-4,                                         │
     │                   max_iter: int = 30) -> PowerFlowResult:               │
     │     """`parent[i] < i` for every node i > 0, so a reverse scan visits   │
     │ children before parents.                                                │
     │     p_kw and q_kvar are three-phase totals per node; negative p is      │
     │ generation."""                                                          │
     │     n = len(parent)                                                     │
     │     z = np.asarray(r_ohm, dtype=float) + 1j * np.asarray(x_ohm,         │
     │ dtype=float)                                                            │
     │     s = (np.asarray(p_kw, dtype=float) + 1j * np.asarray(q_kvar,        │
     │ dtype=float)) * 1000.0 / 3.0                                            │
     │     v = np.full(n, v0, dtype=complex)                                   │
     │     i_edge = np.zeros(n, dtype=complex)                                 │
     │     converged = False                                                   │
     │     iterations = 0                                                      │
     │     for iterations in range(1, max_iter + 1):                           │
     │         i_edge = np.conj(s / v)                                         │
     │         for k in range(n - 1, 0, -1):                                   │
     │             i_edge[parent[k]] += i_edge[k]                              │
     │         v_new = v.copy()                                                │
     │         v_new[0] = v0                                                   │
     │         for k in range(1, n):                                           │
     │             v_new[k] = v_new[parent[k]] - i_edge[k] * z[k]              │
     │         if np.abs(v_new).min() < 0.3 * v0:  # voltage collapse: stop    │
     │ and report failure                                                      │
     │             v = v_new                                                   │
     │             break                                                       │
     │         err = float(np.max(np.abs(v_new - v)))                          │
     │         v = v_new                                                       │
     │         if err < tol:                                                   │
     │             converged = True                                            │
     │             break                                                       │
     │     amps = np.abs(i_edge)                                               │
     │     loss_kw = 3.0 * float(np.sum(amps[1:] ** 2 * z.real[1:])) / 1000.0  │
     │     v_pu = np.abs(v) / c.V_NOMINAL                                      │
     │     return PowerFlowResult(v_pu, float(v_pu.min()), float(v_pu.max()),  │
     │ loss_kw, amps, iterations, converged)                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def dt_powerflow(lv: LvNetwork, node_load_kw: np.ndarray, node_gen_kw:  │
     │ np.ndarray | None = None,                                               │
     │                  source_pu: float = 1.0) -> PowerFlowResult:            │
     │     """Loads draw reactive power at the standard power factor; rooftop  │
     │ generation is at unity."""                                              │
     │     length = np.asarray(lv.length_km, dtype=float)                      │
     │     load = np.asarray(node_load_kw, dtype=float)                        │
     │     gen = np.zeros_like(load) if node_gen_kw is None else               │
     │ np.asarray(node_gen_kw, dtype=float)                                    │
     │     return bfs_powerflow(lv.parent, lv.r_ohm_per_km * length,           │
     │ lv.x_ohm_per_km * length, load - gen,                                   │
     │                          load * TAN_PHI, v0=c.V_NOMINAL * source_pu)    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Run .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest                        │
     │ tests/test_powerflow.py -q → Expected: 6 passed.                        │
     │ - [ ] Step 5: Commit git add -A && git commit -m "feat(grid):           │
     │ backward/forward sweep LV power flow"                                   │

     │ ---                                                                     │
     │ Task A8: Supply availability model                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/supply.py                                    │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_supply.py                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Consumes: WeatherProvider, Network, SOLAR_BELT.                       │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - wind_cf(ws100) -> np.ndarray, re_capacity_factor(ghi, wind100) ->   │
     │ np.ndarray                                                              │
     │   - firm_share(base: float, re_share: float) -> float                   │
     │   - supply_fraction(re_cf, ist_hours, firm, re_share,                   │
     │ grid_storage_frac) -> np.ndarray (values in 0..1)                       │
     │   - DEFAULT_FIRM = {"district_hq": 0.80, "nta": 0.70}                   │
     │   - load_calibration(data_dir: Path) -> dict[str, float]                │
     │   - SupplyModel(network, weather, firm_base: dict[str, float] | None =  │
     │ None) with fraction(kind, start, slots, issued_at=None) -> np.ndarray   │
     │ and available_kw(sd_id, start, slots, issued_at=None) -> np.ndarray.    │
     │ With issued_at it uses forecast weather; without, actual weather.       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ The stylised supply model (state it exactly like this in the docs). A   │
     │ sub-division is allocated its design-day peak. The share of that        │
     │ allocation actually available in a slot is                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ supply_fraction = min(1, firm + re_share × (0.6 × solar_cf + 0.4 ×      │
     │ wind_cf) / 0.45 + grid_storage × evening)                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ where solar_cf = clip(GHI / 900, 0, 1) and wind_cf = clip(((ws − 3) /   │
     │ 9)³, 0, 1) come from real weather at a Rajasthan solar-belt point,      │
     │ evening is 1 from 18:00 to 23:00 IST, and firm falls by 1.1667 points   │
     │ for every point of renewable share above 40 percent. firm per           │
     │ sub-division kind is calibrated in Task B5 so the shadow baseline       │
     │ reproduces the CEEW-measured outage hours. This is a scenario model of  │
     │ an RE-heavy grid, not a DISCOM's real allocation; label it "stylised"   │
     │ wherever it is shown.                                                   │
     │                                                                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/supply.py                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Stylised upstream supply: how much of a sub-division's allocation is │
     │ available each slot."""                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ from datetime import UTC, datetime                                      │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.models import Network                                     │
     │ from app.grid.weather import SOLAR_BELT, WeatherProvider                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ DEFAULT_FIRM = {"district_hq": 0.80, "nta": 0.70}                       │
     │ REFERENCE_RE_SHARE = 0.40                                               │
     │ FIRM_SLOPE = 1.1667                                                     │
     │ RE_CF_REF = 0.45                                                        │
     │ EVENING_START_H, EVENING_END_H = 18.0, 23.0                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def wind_cf(ws100) -> np.ndarray:                                       │
     │     return np.clip(((np.asarray(ws100, dtype=float) - 3.0) / 9.0) ** 3, │
     │ 0.0, 1.0)                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def re_capacity_factor(ghi, wind100) -> np.ndarray:                     │
     │     return 0.6 * np.clip(np.asarray(ghi, dtype=float) / 900.0, 0.0,     │
     │ 1.0) + 0.4 * wind_cf(wind100)                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def firm_share(base: float, re_share: float) -> float:                  │
     │     return max(0.2, base - FIRM_SLOPE * (re_share -                     │
     │ REFERENCE_RE_SHARE))                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def supply_fraction(re_cf, ist_hours, firm: float, re_share: float,     │
     │ grid_storage_frac: float) -> np.ndarray:                                │
     │     hours = np.asarray(ist_hours, dtype=float)                          │
     │     evening = ((hours >= EVENING_START_H) & (hours <                    │
     │ EVENING_END_H)).astype(float)                                           │
     │     return np.minimum(1.0, firm + re_share * np.asarray(re_cf) /        │
     │ RE_CF_REF + grid_storage_frac * evening)                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def ist_hours_from(start: datetime, slots: int) -> np.ndarray:          │
     │     first = start.astimezone(UTC).hour + start.minute / 60 + 5.5        │
     │     return (first + np.arange(slots) * c.DT_H) % 24                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def load_calibration(data_dir: Path) -> dict[str, float]:               │
     │     path = data_dir / "calibration.json"                                │
     │     if not path.exists():                                               │
     │         return dict(DEFAULT_FIRM)                                       │
     │     return {**DEFAULT_FIRM,                                             │
     │ **json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("firm_share", {})}   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class SupplyModel:                                                      │
     │     def __init__(self, network: Network, weather: WeatherProvider,      │
     │ firm_base: dict[str, float] | None = None):                             │
     │         self.network = network                                          │
     │         self.weather = weather                                          │
     │         self.firm_base = {**DEFAULT_FIRM, **(firm_base or {})}          │
     │         self._sd = {s.id: s for s in network.subdivisions}              │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def fraction(self, kind: str, start: datetime, slots: int,          │
     │ issued_at: datetime | None = None) -> np.ndarray:                       │
     │         sc = self.weather.scenario                                      │
     │         w = (self.weather.forecast(SOLAR_BELT, issued_at, start, slots) │
     │ if issued_at is not None                                                │
     │              else self.weather.actual(SOLAR_BELT, start, slots))        │
     │         return supply_fraction(re_capacity_factor(w["ghi"],             │
     │ w["wind100"]), ist_hours_from(start, slots),                            │
     │                                firm_share(self.firm_base[kind],         │
     │ sc.re_share), sc.re_share, sc.grid_storage_frac)                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def available_kw(self, sd_id: str, start: datetime, slots: int,     │
     │ issued_at: datetime | None = None) -> np.ndarray:                       │
     │         sd = self._sd[sd_id]                                            │
     │         return sd.alloc_kw * self.fraction(sd.kind, start, slots,       │
     │ issued_at)                                                              │
     │                                                                         │

     │ ---                                                                     │
     │ Task A9: Day builder, quantile forecaster and training script           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/daydata.py, backend/app/grid/forecaster.py,  │
     │ backend/scripts/train_forecaster.py                                     │
     │ - Create (generated, committed): backend/data/models/{netload_q10.txt,n │
     │ etload_q50.txt,netload_q90.txt,model_meta.json,backtest.json}           │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_daydata.py, backend/tests/test_forecaster.py │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Produces (daydata.py):                                                │
     │   - DayData dataclass: date: datetime.date (IST calendar date),         │
     │ day_index: int, dow: int (Monday 0), temp_dt, cloud_dt, ghi_dt:         │
     │ np.ndarray (D, 96), demand: np.ndarray (N, 96) float32 realised natural │
     │ demand, assets: AssetProfiles, gross_dt: np.ndarray (D, 96) consumer    │
     │ plus asset load, no solar                                               │
     │   - DayBuilder(repo, load_model, weather, base_date: date, cache_days:  │
     │ int = 3) with                                                           │
     │       - ist_midnight_utc(d: date) -> datetime                           │
     │     - ist_date(when: datetime) -> date                                  │
     │     - weather_dt(d: date, issued_at: datetime | None = None) ->         │
     │ dict[str, np.ndarray] each (D, 96)                                      │
     │     - get(d: date) -> DayData                                           │
     │     - gross_only(d: date) -> np.ndarray (D, 96) (same numbers as        │
     │ get(d).gross_dt, without caching the big demand array)                  │
     │     - expected(d: date, issued_at: datetime) -> tuple[np.ndarray,       │
     │ AssetProfiles] expected (noise-free) per-consumer demand (N, 96) and    │
     │ assets under forecast weather                                           │
     │ - Produces (forecaster.py):                                             │
     │   - FEATURES: tuple[str, ...] (13 names, order fixed), QUANTILES =      │
     │ (0.1, 0.5, 0.9)                                                         │
     │   - DtStatic dataclass and dt_static(repo, seed) -> DtStatic            │
     │   - build_features(slot, dow, temp_c, cloud_pct, temp_max_24h, lag_96,  │
     │ lag_672, mean_96, static, dt_idx) -> np.ndarray (n, 13)                 │
     │   - Forecaster(model_dir: Path | None = None) with .mode ("lightgbm" or │
     │ "seasonal_naive"), .meta: dict, predict_pu(X) -> np.ndarray (n, 3)      │
     │ (columns P10, P50, P90, non-negative, non-crossing)                     │
     │   - forecast_horizon(forecaster, static, history_pu, slot0, dow0, temp, │
     │ cloud, horizon) -> np.ndarray (D, horizon, 3) in per unit of            │
     │ static.rating_kw                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Model definition. One global LightGBM model per quantile predicts each  │
     │ DT's gross demand in per unit of its rating. Net load is that forecast  │
     │ minus a physical rooftop-PV forecast (irradiance × capacity), so the ML │
     │ model never has to learn solar. Split conformal calibration widens the  │
     │ P10 to P90 band until it covers 80 percent of a held-out calibration    │
     │ set.                                                                    │
     │                                                                         │

     │     assert np.allclose(out[:, 96:, 1], out[:, :48, 1], atol=1e-9)  #    │
     │ hours 24 to 36 reuse the model's own forecast                           │

     │ """One IST calendar day of world inputs: weather per DT, realised       │

     │                                                                         │

     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │ from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta                     │

     │                                                                         │

     │         self.cache_days = cache_days                                    │

     │ repo.network.subdivisions}                                              │

     │ for d in repo.network.transformers]                                     │

     │         self.rows_of_place = {p: np.array([i for i, q in                │
     │ enumerate(self.place_of_dt) if q == p]) for p in self.places}           │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @staticmethod                                                       │
     │     def ist_midnight_utc(d: date) -> datetime:                          │
     │         return datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day, tzinfo=UTC) -           │
     │ IST_OFFSET                                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @staticmethod                                                       │
     │     def ist_date(when: datetime) -> date:                               │
     │         return (when.astimezone(UTC) + IST_OFFSET).date()               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def weather_dt(self, d: date, issued_at: datetime | None = None) -> │
     │ dict[str, np.ndarray]:                                                  │
     │         start = self.ist_midnight_utc(d)                                │
     │         n = len(self.place_of_dt)                                       │
     │         out = {k: np.zeros((n, c.SLOTS_PER_DAY)) for k in ("temp_c",    │
     │ "cloud_pct", "ghi")}                                                    │
     │         for place in self.places:                                       │
     │             w = (self.weather.forecast(place, issued_at, start,         │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY) if issued_at is not None                               │
     │                  else self.weather.actual(place, start,                 │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))                                                       │
     │             for k in out:                                               │
     │                 out[k][self.rows_of_place[place]] = w[k]                │
     │         return out                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _assets(self, w: dict[str, np.ndarray], dow: int) ->            │
     │ AssetProfiles:                                                          │
     │         sc = self.weather.scenario                                      │
     │         return asset_profiles(self.repo.network, w["temp_c"], w["ghi"], │
     │ dow, ev_multiplier=sc.ev_multiplier,                                    │
     │                               rooftop_multiplier=sc.rooftop_multiplier) │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _build(self, d: date) -> DayData:                               │
     │         idx = (d - self.base_date).days                                 │
     │         if idx < 0:                                                     │
     │             raise ValueError(f"{d} is before the base date              │
     │ {self.base_date}")                                                      │
     │         w = self.weather_dt(d)                                          │
     │         dow = d.weekday()                                               │
     │         temp_cons = w["temp_c"][self.repo.consumers.dt_index]           │
     │         demand = self.load_model.realise_day(idx, temp_cons,            │
     │ dow).astype(np.float32)                                                 │
     │         assets = self._assets(w, dow)                                   │
     │         gross = self.load_model.dt_totals(demand) + assets.dt_kw        │
     │         return DayData(d, idx, dow, w["temp_c"], w["cloud_pct"],        │
     │ w["ghi"], demand, assets, gross)                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get(self, d: date) -> DayData:                                  │
     │         if d in self._cache:                                            │
     │             self._cache.move_to_end(d)                                  │
     │             return self._cache[d]                                       │
     │         day = self._build(d)                                            │
     │         self._cache[d] = day                                            │
     │         while len(self._cache) > self.cache_days:                       │
     │             self._cache.popitem(last=False)                             │
     │         return day                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def gross_only(self, d: date) -> np.ndarray:                        │
     │         return self._cache[d].gross_dt if d in self._cache else         │
     │ self._build(d).gross_dt                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def expected(self, d: date, issued_at: datetime) ->                 │
     │ tuple[np.ndarray, AssetProfiles]:                                       │
     │         w = self.weather_dt(d, issued_at)                               │
     │         dow = d.weekday()                                               │
     │         return                                                          │
     │ self.load_model.expected_day(w["temp_c"][self.repo.consumers.dt_index], │
     │ dow), self._assets(w, dow)                                              │

     │ - [ ] Step 4: Write backend/app/grid/forecaster.py                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Net-load forecasting: global LightGBM quantile models on per-unit DT │
     │ demand, with split                                                      │
     │ conformal calibration; a seasonal-naive fallback keeps the product      │
     │ alive without model files."""                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import logging                                                          │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.loadgen import asset_profiles, design_day_temperature     │
     │ from app.grid.network import NetworkRepository                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ logger = logging.getLogger("lifelinegrid")                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ FEATURES = ("slot", "dow", "is_weekend", "temp_c", "cloud_pct",         │
     │ "temp_max_24h", "lag_96", "lag_672", "mean_96",                         │
     │             "n_consumers", "share_low", "share_high", "asset_share")    │
     │ QUANTILES = (0.1, 0.5, 0.9)                                             │
     │ MODEL_FILES = ("netload_q10.txt", "netload_q50.txt", "netload_q90.txt") │
     │ HISTORY_SLOTS = 8 * c.SLOTS_PER_DAY  # the forecaster needs at least 7  │
     │ days of history                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class DtStatic:                                                         │
     │     n_consumers: np.ndarray                                             │
     │     share_low: np.ndarray                                               │
     │     share_high: np.ndarray                                              │
     │     asset_share: np.ndarray                                             │
     │     rating_kw: np.ndarray                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def dt_static(repo: NetworkRepository, seed: int) -> DtStatic:          │
     │     cons = repo.consumers                                               │
     │     low = np.array([(cons.arch[sl] == 0).mean() for sl in               │
     │ cons.dt_slices])                                                        │
     │     high = np.array([(cons.arch[sl] == 2).mean() for sl in              │
     │ cons.dt_slices])                                                        │
     │     assets = asset_profiles(repo.network, design_day_temperature(),     │
     │ np.zeros(c.SLOTS_PER_DAY), dow=2)                                       │
     │     return DtStatic(n_consumers=np.array([d.n_consumers for d in        │
     │ repo.network.transformers], dtype=float),                               │
     │                     share_low=low, share_high=high,                     │
     │ asset_share=assets.dt_kw.max(axis=1) / repo.rating_kw,                  │
     │                     rating_kw=repo.rating_kw.copy())                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def build_features(slot, dow, temp_c, cloud_pct, temp_max_24h, lag_96,  │
     │ lag_672, mean_96, static: DtStatic,                                     │
     │                    dt_idx) -> np.ndarray:                               │
     │     dow = np.asarray(dow)                                               │
     │     dt_idx = np.asarray(dt_idx, dtype=int)                              │
     │     return np.column_stack([                                            │
     │         slot, dow, (dow >= 5).astype(float), temp_c, cloud_pct,         │
     │ temp_max_24h, lag_96, lag_672, mean_96,                                 │
     │         static.n_consumers[dt_idx], static.share_low[dt_idx],           │
     │ static.share_high[dt_idx], static.asset_share[dt_idx],                  │
     │     ]).astype(float)                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class Forecaster:                                                       │
     │     def __init__(self, model_dir: Path | None = None):                  │
     │         self.mode = "seasonal_naive"                                    │
     │         self.meta: dict = {}                                            │
     │         self.q_hat = 0.0                                                │
     │         self._boosters: list = []                                       │
     │         if model_dir is None or not all((model_dir / f).exists() for f  │
     │ in MODEL_FILES):                                                        │
     │             return                                                      │
     │         try:                                                            │
     │             import lightgbm as lgb                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │             self._boosters = [lgb.Booster(model_file=str(model_dir /    │
     │ f)) for f in MODEL_FILES]                                               │
     │             meta_path = model_dir / "model_meta.json"                   │
     │             if meta_path.exists():                                      │
     │                 self.meta =                                             │
     │ json.loads(meta_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))                       │
     │             if tuple(self.meta.get("features", FEATURES)) != FEATURES:  │
     │                 raise ValueError("model feature list does not match the │
     │ code")                                                                  │
     │             self.q_hat = float(self.meta.get("conformal_q_hat", 0.0))   │
     │             self.mode = "lightgbm"                                      │
     │         except Exception:                                               │
     │             logger.exception("Could not load the LightGBM models; using │
     │ the seasonal-naive forecaster")                                         │
     │             self._boosters = []                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def predict_pu(self, X: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:                  │
     │         if self.mode == "lightgbm":                                     │
     │             P = np.column_stack([b.predict(X) for b in self._boosters]) │
     │             P.sort(axis=1)  # quantile models can cross; sorting        │
     │ restores the order                                                      │
     │             P[:, 0] -= self.q_hat                                       │
     │             P[:, 2] += self.q_hat                                       │
     │         else:                                                           │
     │             p50 = 0.7 * X[:, 6] + 0.3 * X[:, 7]                         │
     │             P = np.column_stack([0.88 * p50, p50, 1.12 * p50])          │
     │         return np.maximum(P, 0.0)                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def forecast_horizon(forecaster: Forecaster, static: DtStatic,          │
     │ history_pu: np.ndarray, slot0: int, dow0: int,                          │
     │                      temp: np.ndarray, cloud: np.ndarray, horizon: int  │
     │ = c.FORECAST_HORIZON_SLOTS) -> np.ndarray:                              │
     │     """Forecast `horizon` slots for every DT.                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │     history_pu: (D, H >= 672) past gross demand in per unit, the last   │
     │ column is the slot just ended.                                          │
     │     slot0, dow0: IST slot (0..95) and weekday (Monday 0) of the first   │
     │ forecast slot.                                                          │
     │     temp: (D, 96 + horizon): the past 96 actual temperatures, then the  │
     │ forecast temperatures.                                                  │
     │     cloud: (D, horizon) forecast cloud cover.                           │
     │     Lags beyond 24 hours ahead use the model's own P50 (recursive)."""  │
     │     D, H = history_pu.shape                                             │
     │     ext = np.concatenate([history_pu, np.zeros((D, horizon))], axis=1)  │
     │     mean_96 = history_pu[:, -c.SLOTS_PER_DAY:].mean(axis=1)             │
     │     out = np.zeros((D, horizon, 3))                                     │
     │     for b0 in range(0, horizon, c.SLOTS_PER_DAY):                       │
     │         hs = np.arange(b0, min(horizon, b0 + c.SLOTS_PER_DAY))          │
     │         n = len(hs)                                                     │
     │         slot = (slot0 + hs) % c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                           │
     │         dow = (dow0 + (slot0 + hs) // c.SLOTS_PER_DAY) % 7              │
     │         t_max = np.stack([temp[:, h + 1:h + c.SLOTS_PER_DAY +           │
     │ 1].max(axis=1) for h in hs], axis=1)                                    │
     │         X = build_features(                                             │
     │             np.tile(slot, D), np.tile(dow, D), temp[:, c.SLOTS_PER_DAY  │
     │ + hs].ravel(), cloud[:, hs].ravel(),                                    │
     │             t_max.ravel(), ext[:, H + hs - c.SLOTS_PER_DAY].ravel(),    │
     │ ext[:, H + hs - 7 * c.SLOTS_PER_DAY].ravel(),                           │
     │             np.repeat(mean_96, n), static, np.repeat(np.arange(D), n))  │
     │         P = forecaster.predict_pu(X).reshape(D, n, 3)                   │
     │         out[:, hs, :] = P                                               │
     │         ext[:, H + hs] = P[:, :, 1]                                     │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 6: Write backend/scripts/train_forecaster.py                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Trains the three quantile models on simulated meter history and      │
     │ writes them with a backtest.                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ History: 120 IST days of natural gross demand per DT from the load      │
     │ model, driven by the weather                                            │
     │ files (or synthetic weather if they are absent). Split by time: train,  │
     │ then 10 days for conformal                                              │
     │ calibration, then the last 14 days as the held-out test. Honest label   │
     │ for every surface that shows                                            │
     │ these numbers: "trained on simulated meter history calibrated to public │
     │ Indian load shapes".                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Run from backend/:  .venv/Scripts/python scripts/train_forecaster.py    │
     │ """                                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import sys                                                              │
     │ from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta                     │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import lightgbm as lgb                                                  │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]                              │
     │ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.daydata import DayBuilder                                 │
     │ from app.grid.forecaster import FEATURES, MODEL_FILES, QUANTILES,       │
     │ build_features, dt_static                                               │
     │ from app.grid.loadgen import LoadModel, load_shapes                     │
     │ from app.grid.network import get_network_repository                     │
     │ from app.grid.weather import BUILTIN_SCENARIOS, WeatherProvider,        │
     │ _read_series, synthetic_series                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ DAYS, CAL_DAYS, TEST_DAYS = 120, 10, 14                                 │
     │ BASE = date(2025, 4, 1)                                                 │
     │ PARAMS = {"objective": "quantile", "learning_rate": 0.06, "num_leaves": │
     │ 31, "min_data_in_leaf": 40,                                             │
     │           "feature_fraction": 0.9, "bagging_fraction": 0.8,             │
     │ "bagging_freq": 1, "verbose": -1, "seed": 7}                            │
     │ ROUNDS = 400                                                            │
     │ S = c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def weather_provider() -> tuple[WeatherProvider, str]:                  │
     │     start = DayBuilder.ist_midnight_utc(BASE)                           │
     │     series, source = {}, "Open-Meteo archive"                           │
     │     for place in ("bareilly", "mathura", "solarbelt"):                  │
     │         path = ROOT / "data" / "weather" / f"{place}.json"              │
     │         if path.exists():                                               │
     │             full = _read_series(path)                                   │
     │             first = int(round((start - full.start) /                    │
     │ timedelta(minutes=15)))                                                 │
     │             if first >= 0 and first + DAYS * S <= len(full):            │
     │                 sl = slice(first, first + DAYS * S)                     │
     │                 series[place] = type(full)(place, start,                │
     │ full.temp_c[sl], full.cloud_pct[sl], full.ghi[sl], full.rh[sl],         │
     │ full.wind100[sl])                                                       │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │         series[place] = synthetic_series(place, start, DAYS, seed=2)    │
     │         source = "synthetic weather"                                    │
     │     return WeatherProvider(series,                                      │
     │ BUILTIN_SCENARIOS["heatwave_evening"], start), source                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def pinball(y, pred, q) -> float:                                       │
     │     d = y - pred                                                        │
     │     return float(np.mean(np.maximum(q * d, (q - 1) * d)))               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def main() -> int:                                                      │
     │     repo = get_network_repository()                                     │
     │     seed = repo.network.seed                                            │
     │     weather, source = weather_provider()                                │
     │     model = LoadModel(repo.consumers, shapes=load_shapes(ROOT /         │
     │ "data"), seed=seed)                                                     │
     │     builder = DayBuilder(repo, model, weather, base_date=BASE,          │
     │ cache_days=1)                                                           │
     │     static = dt_static(repo, seed)                                      │
     │     D = len(repo.dt_ids)                                                │
     │     gross = np.zeros((D, DAYS * S))                                     │
     │     temp = np.zeros((D, DAYS * S))                                      │
     │     cloud = np.zeros((D, DAYS * S))                                     │
     │     for k in range(DAYS):                                               │
     │         d = BASE + timedelta(days=k)                                    │
     │         w = builder.weather_dt(d)                                       │
     │         gross[:, k * S:(k + 1) * S] = builder.gross_only(d)             │
     │         temp[:, k * S:(k + 1) * S] = w["temp_c"]                        │
     │         cloud[:, k * S:(k + 1) * S] = w["cloud_pct"]                    │
     │     pu = gross / static.rating_kw[:, None]                              │
     │     ts = np.arange(7 * S, DAYS * S)  # targets that have a week of lags │
     │     n = len(ts)                                                         │
     │     slot, dow = ts % S, ((BASE.weekday() + ts // S) % 7)                │
     │     t_max = np.stack([temp[:, t - S + 1:t + 1].max(axis=1) for t in     │
     │ ts], axis=1)                                                            │
     │     mean_96 = np.stack([pu[:, t - S:t].mean(axis=1) for t in ts],       │
     │ axis=1)  # rolling day mean, as at runtime                              │
     │     X = build_features(np.tile(slot, D), np.tile(dow, D), temp[:,       │
     │ ts].ravel(), cloud[:, ts].ravel(), t_max.ravel(),                       │
     │                        pu[:, ts - S].ravel(), pu[:, ts - 7 *            │
     │ S].ravel(), mean_96.ravel(), static, np.repeat(np.arange(D), n))        │
     │     y = pu[:, ts].ravel()                                               │
     │     t_of_row = np.tile(ts, D)                                           │
     │     test_from, cal_from = (DAYS - TEST_DAYS) * S, (DAYS - TEST_DAYS -   │
     │ CAL_DAYS) * S                                                           │
     │     tr, ca, te = t_of_row < cal_from, (t_of_row >= cal_from) &          │
     │ (t_of_row < test_from), t_of_row >= test_from                           │
     │     boosters = []                                                       │
     │     for q in QUANTILES:                                                 │
     │         ds = lgb.Dataset(X[tr], y[tr], feature_name=list(FEATURES))     │
     │         boosters.append(lgb.train({**PARAMS, "alpha": q}, ds,           │
     │ num_boost_round=ROUNDS))                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def predict(mask):                                                  │
     │         P = np.column_stack([b.predict(X[mask]) for b in boosters])     │
     │         P.sort(axis=1)                                                  │
     │         return P                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     Pc = predict(ca)                                                    │
     │     scores = np.maximum(Pc[:, 0] - y[ca], y[ca] - Pc[:, 2])             │
     │     q_hat = float(np.quantile(scores, min(1.0, 0.8 * (1 + 1 /           │
     │ len(scores)))))                                                         │
     │     Pt = predict(te)                                                    │
     │     yt = y[te]                                                          │

     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/deficits.py                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Turns forecasts into deficit windows."""                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import hashlib                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.thermal import dynamic_limit_pu                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def find_windows(gap_kw, min_kw: float = c.MIN_GAP_KW, merge: int =     │
     │ c.MERGE_GAP_SLOTS,                                                      │
     │                  max_slots: int = c.MAX_WINDOW_SLOTS) ->                │
     │ list[tuple[int, int]]:                                                  │
     │     active = np.asarray(gap_kw, dtype=float) > min_kw                   │
     │     runs: list[list[int]] = []                                          │
     │     start = None                                                        │
     │     for i, on in enumerate(active):                                     │
     │         if on and start is None:                                        │
     │             start = i                                                   │
     │         elif not on and start is not None:                              │
     │             runs.append([start, i])                                     │
     │             start = None                                                │
     │     if start is not None:                                               │
     │         runs.append([start, len(active)])                               │
     │     merged: list[list[int]] = []                                        │
     │     for run in runs:                                                    │
     │         if merged and run[0] - merged[-1][1] <= merge:                  │
     │             merged[-1][1] = run[1]                                      │
     │         else:                                                           │
     │             merged.append(run)                                          │
     │     out: list[tuple[int, int]] = []                                     │
     │     for s, e in merged:                                                 │
     │         while e - s > max_slots:                                        │
     │             out.append((s, s + max_slots))                              │
     │             s += max_slots                                              │
     │         out.append((s, e))                                              │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def planning_load(p50, p90, risk: float = 0.5) -> np.ndarray:           │
     │     """The load level a plan must cover: P50 plus a share of the        │
     │ upside. risk 0 = P50, 1 = P90."""                                       │
     │     return np.asarray(p50) + risk * (np.asarray(p90) - np.asarray(p50)) │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def subdivision_gap(dt_net_kw: np.ndarray, avail_kw: np.ndarray) ->     │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │     return np.maximum(0.0, dt_net_kw.sum(axis=0) * (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC) │
     │ - np.asarray(avail_kw))                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def dt_limits_kw(rating_kw: np.ndarray, temp_dt: np.ndarray) ->         │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │     return np.asarray(rating_kw)[:, None] * dynamic_limit_pu(temp_dt)   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def need_series(gap_kw: np.ndarray, over_kw: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray: │
     │     """Relief needed per slot: the supply gap, or the summed DT         │
     │ overload where that is larger."""                                       │
     │     return np.maximum(np.asarray(gap_kw),                               │
     │ np.asarray(over_kw).sum(axis=0))                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def classify_cause(gap_kwh: float, overload_kwh: float) -> str:         │
     │     if gap_kwh > 0 and overload_kwh > 0:                                │
     │         return "both"                                                   │
     │     return "dt_overload" if overload_kwh > 0 else "supply_shortfall"    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def window_confidence(p10, p50, p90, peak_gap_kw: float) -> int:        │
     │     """Narrow forecast bands and gaps that are large against peak       │
     │ demand both raise confidence."""                                        │
     │     p50 = np.asarray(p50, dtype=float)                                  │
     │     spread = float((np.asarray(p90) - np.asarray(p10)).sum() /          │
     │ max(1e-6, p50.sum()))                                                   │
     │     margin = min(1.0, peak_gap_kw / max(1e-6, 0.05 * float(p50.max()))) │
     │     return int(min(98, max(40, round(95 - 100 * spread + 15 *           │
     │ margin))))                                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def window_id(sd_id: str, start_iso: str) -> str:                       │
     │     return "dw_" +                                                      │
     │ hashlib.sha1(f"{sd_id}|{start_iso}".encode()).hexdigest()[:8]           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Write backend/app/grid/levers.py                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """How much relief each lever can give. Pure functions over             │
     │ per-consumer expected demand."""                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def cap_vector_kw(tier: np.ndarray, level: int) -> np.ndarray:          │
     │     lv = c.CAP_LEVELS[level]                                            │
     │     if lv.t1_w is None:                                                 │
     │         return np.full(len(tier), np.inf)                               │
     │     return np.where(np.asarray(tier) == 1, lv.t1_w, lv.t2_w) / 1000.0   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def cap_reduction(expected_kw: np.ndarray, tier: np.ndarray, exempt:    │
     │ np.ndarray, level: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int]:                      │
     │     """(kW reduction per slot, consumers whose demand would exceed the  │
     │ cap at least once).                                                     │
     │     Exempt consumers (life support) are never counted and never         │
     │ reduced."""                                                             │
     │     cap = cap_vector_kw(tier, level)                                    │
     │     red = np.maximum(0.0, expected_kw - cap[:, None])                   │
     │     red[np.asarray(exempt, dtype=bool)] = 0.0                           │
     │     return red.sum(axis=0), int((red.max(axis=1) > 0).sum()) if         │
     │ red.size else 0                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def dr_expected_kw(expected_kw: np.ndarray, flex_share: np.ndarray,     │
     │ rate: np.ndarray, exempt: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:                    │
     │     keep = ~np.asarray(exempt, dtype=bool)                              │
     │     weight = (np.asarray(flex_share) * np.asarray(rate) *               │
     │ c.DR_FLEX_REALISED)[keep]                                               │
     │     return (expected_kw[keep] * weight[:, None]).sum(axis=0)            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def shift_reduction(sched_kw: np.ndarray, max_shift_slots: int) ->      │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │     """A shiftable load can be held off for at most `max_shift_slots`   │
     │ of its scheduled slots."""                                              │
     │     out = np.zeros_like(np.asarray(sched_kw, dtype=float))              │
     │     used = 0                                                            │
     │     for t, kw in enumerate(sched_kw):                                   │
     │         if kw > 0 and used < max_shift_slots:                           │
     │             out[t] = kw                                                 │
     │             used += 1                                                   │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def hub_recover_kwh(max_kw: float, sched_after_kw: np.ndarray) ->       │
     │ float:                                                                  │
     │     """Energy a charger hub can make up after the window: its spare     │
     │ capacity until 06:00."""                                                │
     │     return float(np.maximum(0.0, max_kw - np.asarray(sched_after_kw,    │
     │ dtype=float)).sum() * c.DT_H)                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def storage_usable_kwh(energy_kwh: float, soc: float, soc_min: float)   │
     │ -> float:                                                               │
     │     return max(0.0, (soc - soc_min) * energy_kwh)                       │
     │                                                                         │

     │ Task A11: Flex Plan optimiser (MILP with greedy fallback)               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/optimizer.py                                 │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_optimizer.py                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - Dataclasses HubInput(id, dt_index, sched_kw, recover_kwh),          │
     │ StoreInput(id, dt_index, p_max_kw, usable_kwh, eff=0.92),               │
     │ ShiftInput(id, dt_index, red_kw)                                        │
     │   - PlanInputs(dt_ids, gap_kw (T,), load_kw (D,T), limit_kw (D,T),      │
     │ cap_red_kw (D,L,T), cap_households (D,L), fair_w (D,), hubs, stores,    │
     │ shifts, level_allowed (D,L) bool | None)                                │
     │   - PlanSolution(levels: list[int], charger_frac (H,T), storage_kw      │
     │ (S,T), shift_on: list[bool], unserved_kw (T,), overload_kw (D,T),       │
     │ objective: float, solver: str, solve_ms: float)                         │
     │   - solve_milp(inp, time_limit_s=5.0) -> PlanSolution | None (None if   │
     │ HiGHS returns no solution)                                              │
     │   - solve_greedy(inp) -> PlanSolution                                   │
     │   - solve(inp) -> PlanSolution (MILP, falling back to greedy)           │
     │   - objective_value(inp, sol) -> float and weights W_LEVEL, W_CHARGE,   │
     │ W_STORAGE, W_SHIFT, W_HOUSEHOLD, M_UNSERVED, M_OVERLOAD                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Formulation. One cap level per DT for the whole window (no flicker).    │
     │ Variables: binary y[d,l], continuous c[h,t] ∈ [0,1] (share of scheduled │
     │ charging curtailed), continuous g[s,t] ∈ [0, P_s] (storage discharge),  │
     │ binary q[r] (shift load r), slack u[t] ≥ 0 (unserved relief, which      │
     │ becomes rotational shedding), slack o[d,t] ≥ 0 (DT overload).           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ minimise   Σ_d Σ_l y[d,l] · (W_LEVEL[l] · fair_w[d] · Σ_t R[d,l,t]·Δt + │
     │ W_HOUSEHOLD · H[d,l])                                                   │
     │          + Σ_h Σ_t W_CHARGE · C[h,t]·Δt · c[h,t]  +  Σ_s Σ_t W_STORAGE  │
     │ · Δt · g[s,t]                                                           │
     │          + Σ_r W_SHIFT · Σ_t Q[r,t]·Δt · q[r]  +  M_UNSERVED · Σ_t      │
     │ u[t]·Δt  +  M_OVERLOAD · Σ_d Σ_t o[d,t]·Δt                              │
     │ subject to                                                              │
     │   Σ_l y[d,l] = 1                                                   for  │
     │ every DT d                                                              │
     │   Σ_d Σ_l R[d,l,t]·y[d,l] + Σ_h C[h,t]·c[h,t] + Σ_s g[s,t] + Σ_r        │
     │ Q[r,t]·q[r] + u[t] ≥ gap[t]      for every slot t                       │
     │   Σ_l R[d,l,t]·y[d,l] + (same terms for assets on DT d) + o[d,t] ≥      │
     │ load[d,t] − limit[d,t]        for every d, t                            │
     │   Σ_t C[h,t]·Δt·c[h,t] ≤ recover_kwh[h]                           for   │
     │ every hub h                                                             │
     │   Σ_t g[s,t]·Δt / eff[s] ≤ usable_kwh[s]                           for  │
     │ every store s                                                           │
     │   y[d,l] = 0 where level_allowed[d,l] is false                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ R[d,l,t] is the cap relief (kW), H[d,l] the households affected, C      │
     │ scheduled charging, Q shiftable draw. Verified on a 10-DT, 16-slot      │
     │ case: 266 variables, 189 rows, optimal in about 60 ms.                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests backend/tests/test_optimizer.py   │
     │                                                                         │
