     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/optimizer.py                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Flex Plan optimiser: a mixed-integer linear programme solved with    │
     │ HiGHS through                                                           │
     │ scipy.optimize.milp, with a greedy merit-order fallback that needs no   │
     │ solver."""                                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import time                                                             │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass, field                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │ from scipy.optimize import Bounds, LinearConstraint, milp               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ W_LEVEL = (0.0, 1.0, 1.6, 2.6)  # discomfort cost per curtailed kWh at  │
     │ each cap level                                                          │
     │ W_CHARGE = 0.25  # per kWh of charging deferred                         │
     │ W_STORAGE = 0.10  # per kWh discharged (battery wear)                   │
     │ W_SHIFT = 0.20  # per kWh of a pump or tower shifted                    │
     │ W_HOUSEHOLD = 0.02  # per household that feels a cap                    │
     │ M_UNSERVED = 50.0  # per kWh left to rotational shedding                │
     │ M_OVERLOAD = 30.0  # per kWh of DT loading above its thermal limit      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class HubInput:                                                         │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     dt_index: int                                                       │
     │     sched_kw: np.ndarray  # (T,) scheduled charging in the window       │
     │     recover_kwh: float  # energy the hub can make up afterwards         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class StoreInput:                                                       │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     dt_index: int                                                       │
     │     p_max_kw: float                                                     │
     │     usable_kwh: float                                                   │
     │     eff: float = 0.92                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class ShiftInput:                                                       │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     dt_index: int                                                       │
     │     red_kw: np.ndarray  # (T,) relief if this load is shifted           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class PlanInputs:                                                       │
     │     dt_ids: list[str]                                                   │
     │     gap_kw: np.ndarray  # (T,)                                          │
     │     load_kw: np.ndarray  # (D, T) planning load after voluntary DR      │
     │     limit_kw: np.ndarray  # (D, T) thermal limit                        │
     │     cap_red_kw: np.ndarray  # (D, L, T) relief at each cap level; level │
     │ 0 is zeros                                                              │
     │     cap_households: np.ndarray  # (D, L)                                │
     │     fair_w: np.ndarray  # (D,) >= 1; higher means this DT has carried   │
     │ more burden                                                             │
     │     hubs: list[HubInput] = field(default_factory=list)                  │
     │     stores: list[StoreInput] = field(default_factory=list)              │
     │     shifts: list[ShiftInput] = field(default_factory=list)              │
     │     level_allowed: np.ndarray | None = None  # (D, L) bool              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class PlanSolution:                                                     │
     │     levels: list[int]                                                   │
     │     charger_frac: np.ndarray  # (H, T)                                  │
     │     storage_kw: np.ndarray  # (S, T)                                    │
     │     shift_on: list[bool]                                                │
     │     unserved_kw: np.ndarray  # (T,)                                     │
     │     overload_kw: np.ndarray  # (D, T)                                   │
     │     objective: float                                                    │
     │     solver: str                                                         │
     │     solve_ms: float                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _allowed(inp: PlanInputs) -> np.ndarray:                            │
     │     D, L, _ = inp.cap_red_kw.shape                                      │
     │     allowed = np.ones((D, L), dtype=bool) if inp.level_allowed is None  │
     │ else inp.level_allowed.copy()                                           │
     │     allowed[:, 0] = True  # "no cap" is always available, so the        │
     │ problem is always feasible                                              │
     │     return allowed                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def objective_value(inp: PlanInputs, sol: PlanSolution) -> float:       │
     │     D = len(inp.dt_ids)                                                 │
     │     total = sum(W_LEVEL[sol.levels[d]] * inp.fair_w[d] *                │
     │ inp.cap_red_kw[d, sol.levels[d]].sum() * c.DT_H                         │
     │                 + W_HOUSEHOLD * inp.cap_households[d, sol.levels[d]]    │
     │ for d in range(D))                                                      │
     │     total += sum(W_CHARGE * (sol.charger_frac[h] * hub.sched_kw).sum()  │
     │ * c.DT_H for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs))                             │
     │     total += W_STORAGE * sol.storage_kw.sum() * c.DT_H                  │
     │     total += sum(W_SHIFT * sh.red_kw.sum() * c.DT_H for r, sh in        │
     │ enumerate(inp.shifts) if sol.shift_on[r])                               │
     │     total += M_UNSERVED * sol.unserved_kw.sum() * c.DT_H + M_OVERLOAD * │
     │ sol.overload_kw.sum() * c.DT_H                                          │
     │     return float(total)                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def solve_milp(inp: PlanInputs, time_limit_s: float = 5.0) ->           │
     │ PlanSolution | None:                                                    │
     │     D, L, T = inp.cap_red_kw.shape                                      │
     │     H, S, R = len(inp.hubs), len(inp.stores), len(inp.shifts)           │
     │     allowed = _allowed(inp)                                             │
     │     oy, oc = 0, D * L                                                   │
     │     og = oc + H * T                                                     │
     │     oq = og + S * T                                                     │
     │     ou = oq + R                                                         │
     │     oo = ou + T                                                         │
     │     n = oo + D * T                                                      │
     │     cost = np.zeros(n)                                                  │
     │     lb = np.zeros(n)                                                    │
     │     ub = np.full(n, np.inf)                                             │
     │     integrality = np.zeros(n)                                           │
     │     for d in range(D):                                                  │
     │         for lvl in range(L):                                            │
     │             j = oy + d * L + lvl                                        │
     │             cost[j] = W_LEVEL[lvl] * inp.fair_w[d] * inp.cap_red_kw[d,  │
     │ lvl].sum() * c.DT_H + W_HOUSEHOLD * inp.cap_households[d, lvl]          │
     │             ub[j] = 1.0 if allowed[d, lvl] else 0.0                     │
     │             integrality[j] = 1                                          │
     │     for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs):                                  │
     │         cost[oc + h * T:oc + h * T + T] = W_CHARGE * hub.sched_kw *     │
     │ c.DT_H                                                                  │
     │         ub[oc + h * T:oc + h * T + T] = 1.0                             │
     │     for s, st in enumerate(inp.stores):                                 │
     │         cost[og + s * T:og + s * T + T] = W_STORAGE * c.DT_H            │
     │         ub[og + s * T:og + s * T + T] = st.p_max_kw                     │
     │     for r, sh in enumerate(inp.shifts):                                 │
     │         cost[oq + r] = W_SHIFT * sh.red_kw.sum() * c.DT_H               │
     │         ub[oq + r] = 1.0                                                │
     │         integrality[oq + r] = 1                                         │
     │     cost[ou:ou + T] = M_UNSERVED * c.DT_H                               │
     │     cost[oo:oo + D * T] = M_OVERLOAD * c.DT_H                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │     rows: list[np.ndarray] = []                                         │
     │     lo: list[float] = []                                                │
     │     hi: list[float] = []                                                │
     │     for d in range(D):  # exactly one level per DT                      │
     │         a = np.zeros(n)                                                 │
     │         a[oy + d * L:oy + d * L + L] = 1.0                              │
     │         rows.append(a)                                                  │
     │         lo.append(1.0)                                                  │
     │         hi.append(1.0)                                                  │
     │     for t in range(T):  # sub-division relief                           │
     │         a = np.zeros(n)                                                 │
     │         for d in range(D):                                              │
     │             a[oy + d * L:oy + d * L + L] = inp.cap_red_kw[d, :, t]      │
     │         for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs):                              │
     │             a[oc + h * T + t] = hub.sched_kw[t]                         │
     │         for s in range(S):                                              │
     │             a[og + s * T + t] = 1.0                                     │
     │         for r, sh in enumerate(inp.shifts):                             │
     │             a[oq + r] = sh.red_kw[t]                                    │
     │         a[ou + t] = 1.0                                                 │
     │         rows.append(a)                                                  │
     │         lo.append(float(inp.gap_kw[t]))                                 │
     │         hi.append(np.inf)                                               │
     │     for d in range(D):  # DT thermal limit, soft                        │
     │         for t in range(T):                                              │
     │             a = np.zeros(n)                                             │
     │             a[oy + d * L:oy + d * L + L] = inp.cap_red_kw[d, :, t]      │
     │             for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs):                          │
     │                 if hub.dt_index == d:                                   │
     │                     a[oc + h * T + t] = hub.sched_kw[t]                 │
     │             for s, st in enumerate(inp.stores):                         │
     │                 if st.dt_index == d:                                    │
     │                     a[og + s * T + t] = 1.0                             │
     │             for r, sh in enumerate(inp.shifts):                         │
     │                 if sh.dt_index == d:                                    │
     │                     a[oq + r] = sh.red_kw[t]                            │
     │             a[oo + d * T + t] = 1.0                                     │
     │             rows.append(a)                                              │
     │             lo.append(float(inp.load_kw[d, t] - inp.limit_kw[d, t]))    │
     │             hi.append(np.inf)                                           │
     │     for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs):  # deferred charging must be     │
     │ recoverable                                                             │
     │         a = np.zeros(n)                                                 │
     │         a[oc + h * T:oc + h * T + T] = hub.sched_kw * c.DT_H            │
     │         rows.append(a)                                                  │
     │         lo.append(-np.inf)                                              │
     │         hi.append(float(hub.recover_kwh))                               │
     │     for s, st in enumerate(inp.stores):  # storage energy               │
     │         a = np.zeros(n)                                                 │
     │         a[og + s * T:og + s * T + T] = c.DT_H / st.eff                  │
     │         rows.append(a)                                                  │
     │         lo.append(-np.inf)                                              │
     │         hi.append(float(st.usable_kwh))                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     started = time.perf_counter()                                       │
     │     res = milp(cost, constraints=LinearConstraint(np.array(rows),       │
     │ np.array(lo), np.array(hi)),                                            │
     │                integrality=integrality, bounds=Bounds(lb, ub),          │
     │                options={"time_limit": time_limit_s, "mip_rel_gap":      │
     │ 1e-4})                                                                  │
     │     ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000                         │
     │     if res.x is None:                                                   │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │     x = res.x                                                           │
     │     levels = [int(np.argmax(x[oy + d * L:oy + d * L + L])) for d in     │
     │ range(D)]                                                               │
     │     sol = PlanSolution(                                                 │
     │         levels=levels,                                                  │
     │         charger_frac=np.clip(x[oc:oc + H * T].reshape(H, T), 0, 1),     │
     │         storage_kw=np.maximum(0, x[og:og + S * T].reshape(S, T)),       │
     │         shift_on=[bool(round(v)) for v in x[oq:oq + R]],                │
     │         unserved_kw=np.maximum(0, x[ou:ou + T]),                        │
     │         overload_kw=np.maximum(0, x[oo:oo + D * T].reshape(D, T)),      │
     │         objective=float(res.fun), solver="highs-milp", solve_ms=ms)     │
     │     return sol                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def solve_greedy(inp: PlanInputs) -> PlanSolution:                      │
     │     """Merit order: shifts, chargers, storage, then raise cap levels    │
     │ where each step buys the most                                           │
     │     useful relief per unit of weighted discomfort. Always feasible."""  │
     │     D, L, T = inp.cap_red_kw.shape                                      │
     │     started = time.perf_counter()                                       │
     │     allowed = _allowed(inp)                                             │
     │     rem = inp.gap_kw.astype(float).copy()                               │
     │     over0 = np.maximum(0.0, inp.load_kw - inp.limit_kw)                 │
     │     need_any = rem.sum() > 1e-9 or over0.sum() > 1e-9                   │
     │     levels = [0] * D                                                    │
     │     cf = np.zeros((len(inp.hubs), T))                                   │
     │     sk = np.zeros((len(inp.stores), T))                                 │
     │     on = [False] * len(inp.shifts)                                      │
     │     red_dt = np.zeros((D, T))                                           │
     │     if need_any:                                                        │
     │         for r, sh in enumerate(inp.shifts):                             │
     │             helps_gap = (np.minimum(sh.red_kw, rem) > 1e-9).any()       │
     │             helps_dt = (np.minimum(sh.red_kw, over0[sh.dt_index] -      │
     │ red_dt[sh.dt_index]) > 1e-9).any()                                      │
     │             if helps_gap or helps_dt:                                   │
     │                 on[r] = True                                            │
     │                 rem = np.maximum(0.0, rem - sh.red_kw)                  │
     │                 red_dt[sh.dt_index] += sh.red_kw                        │
     │         for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs):                              │
     │             budget = hub.recover_kwh                                    │
     │             for t in range(T):                                          │
     │                 want = max(rem[t], over0[hub.dt_index, t] -             │
     │ red_dt[hub.dt_index, t])                                                │
     │                 if want <= 1e-9 or hub.sched_kw[t] <= 0:                │
     │                     continue                                            │
     │                 take = min(hub.sched_kw[t], want, budget / c.DT_H)      │
     │                 cf[h, t] = take / hub.sched_kw[t]                       │
     │                 budget -= take * c.DT_H                                 │
     │                 rem[t] = max(0.0, rem[t] - take)                        │
     │                 red_dt[hub.dt_index, t] += take                         │
     │         for s, st in enumerate(inp.stores):                             │
     │             budget = st.usable_kwh * st.eff                             │
     │             for t in np.argsort(-rem):                                  │
     │                 if rem[t] <= 1e-9:                                      │
     │                     break                                               │
     │                 take = min(st.p_max_kw, rem[t], budget / c.DT_H)        │
     │                 sk[s, t] = take                                         │
     │                 budget -= take * c.DT_H                                 │
     │                 rem[t] -= take                                          │
     │                 red_dt[st.dt_index, t] += take                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def next_level(d: int) -> int | None:                               │
     │         for lvl in range(levels[d] + 1, L):                             │
     │             if allowed[d, lvl]:                                         │
     │                 return lvl                                              │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     for d in range(D):  # local overloads first                         │
     │         while ((inp.load_kw[d] - red_dt[d] - inp.cap_red_kw[d,          │
     │ levels[d]]) > inp.limit_kw[d] + 1e-6).any():                            │
     │             nxt = next_level(d)                                         │
     │             if nxt is None:                                             │
     │                 break                                                   │
     │             levels[d] = nxt                                             │
     │     rem = np.maximum(0.0, rem - np.array([inp.cap_red_kw[d, levels[d]]  │
     │ for d in range(D)]).sum(axis=0))                                        │
     │     while rem.sum() > 1e-6:                                             │
     │         best, best_score, best_level = None, 0.0, 0                     │
     │         for d in range(D):                                              │
     │             nxt = next_level(d)                                         │
     │             if nxt is None:                                             │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             extra = inp.cap_red_kw[d, nxt] - inp.cap_red_kw[d,          │
     │ levels[d]]                                                              │
     │             useful = np.minimum(extra, rem).sum() * c.DT_H              │
     │             added = (W_LEVEL[nxt] * inp.cap_red_kw[d, nxt].sum() -      │
     │ W_LEVEL[levels[d]] * inp.cap_red_kw[d, levels[d]].sum()) * c.DT_H *     │
     │ inp.fair_w[d]                                                           │
     │             score = useful / (added + 1e-9)                             │
     │             if useful > 1e-9 and score > best_score:                    │
     │                 best, best_score, best_level = d, score, nxt            │
     │         if best is None:                                                │
     │             break                                                       │
     │         rem = np.maximum(0.0, rem - (inp.cap_red_kw[best, best_level] - │
     │ inp.cap_red_kw[best, levels[best]]))                                    │
     │         levels[best] = best_level                                       │
     │     cap_now = np.array([inp.cap_red_kw[d, levels[d]] for d in           │
     │ range(D)])                                                              │
     │     sol = PlanSolution(levels, cf, sk, on, rem, np.maximum(0.0,         │
     │ inp.load_kw - red_dt - cap_now - inp.limit_kw),                         │
     │                        0.0, "greedy", 0.0)                              │
     │     sol.objective = objective_value(inp, sol)                           │
     │     sol.solve_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000               │
     │     return sol                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def solve(inp: PlanInputs) -> PlanSolution:                             │
     │     try:                                                                │
     │         sol = solve_milp(inp)                                           │
     │     except Exception:                                                   │
     │         sol = None                                                      │
     │     return sol if sol is not None else solve_greedy(inp)                │
     │                                                                         │

     │ Task A12: Baseline roster, metrics, fairness, risk and DR learning      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/baseline.py, backend/app/grid/metrics.py,    │
     │ backend/app/grid/fairness.py, backend/app/grid/risk.py,                 │
     │ backend/app/grid/dr_model.py                                            │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_baseline.py, backend/tests/test_metrics.py,  │
     │ backend/tests/test_fairness.py, backend/tests/test_risk.py,             │
     │ backend/tests/test_dr_model.py                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - baseline.py: RosterState(pointer: dict[str, int], off_until:          │
     │ dict[str, int]); roster_step(state, sd_id, feeder_ids, feeder_kw:       │
     │ dict[str, float], gap_kw: float, abs_slot: int) -> set[str]             │
     │ - metrics.py: Metrics dataclass (fields below) with hoh, saidi_min(n),  │
     │ saifi(n), outage_h_per_consumer_day(n), lifeline_availability_pct,      │
     │ critical_availability_pct, loss_pct, add(other), to_dict(n_consumers),  │
     │ from_dict(d)                                                            │
     │ - fairness.py: jain(x) -> float, served_fraction(burden_kwh,            │
     │ entitled_kwh) -> np.ndarray, gini(x) -> float, lorenz_points(x,         │
     │ points=21) -> list[tuple[float, float]],                                │
     │ fairness_weights(dt_burden_ratio, beta=1.0) -> np.ndarray               │
     │ - risk.py: dt_risk_index(peak_loading_pct, hotspot_peak_c, v_min_pu,    │
     │ deficit_slots, hosts_critical) -> np.ndarray (ints 0 to 100),           │
     │ risk_level(index: float) -> str, subdivision_risk_index(dt_index:       │
     │ np.ndarray, urgent_pending: int) -> int, RISK_THRESHOLDS = (25, 45, 65) │
     │ - dr_model.py: DrModel with rate() -> np.ndarray (5,),                  │
     │ consumer_rate(arch) -> np.ndarray, update(arch, accepted), to_state(),  │
     │ from_state(d); true_acceptance(propensity, rebate_rs_per_kwh, rng) ->   │
     │ np.ndarray[bool]                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ The status-quo rule the baseline encodes. When a sub-division's demand  │
     │ exceeds its available supply, whole 11 kV feeders are switched off in   │
     │ rotation until the shed load covers the gap. A shed feeder stays off    │
     │ for at least ROSTER_MIN_SLOTS (one hour). The rotation pointer          │
     │ persists, so the burden moves from feeder to feeder. Everything on a    │
     │ shed feeder loses supply, including critical facilities.                │
     │                                                                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/baseline.py                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """The status quo: rotational feeder shedding. Used for the shadow      │
     │ baseline and as the last resort                                         │
     │ of the solution world when no plan covers a deficit."""                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass, field                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class RosterState:                                                      │
     │     pointer: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)  #            │
     │ sub-division id -> next feeder position                                 │
     │     off_until: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)  # feeder   │
     │ id -> first slot it is back on                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def roster_step(state: RosterState, sd_id: str, feeder_ids: list[str],  │
     │ feeder_kw: dict[str, float],                                            │
     │                 gap_kw: float, abs_slot: int) -> set[str]:              │
     │     """Feeders that are off during `abs_slot`. `gap_kw` is computed     │
     │ with every feeder on."""                                                │
     │     off = {f for f in feeder_ids if state.off_until.get(f, -1) >        │
     │ abs_slot}                                                               │
     │     need = gap_kw - sum(feeder_kw[f] for f in off)                      │
     │     ptr = state.pointer.get(sd_id, 0)                                   │
     │     tried = 0                                                           │
     │     while need > 1e-9 and tried < len(feeder_ids):                      │
     │         f = feeder_ids[ptr % len(feeder_ids)]                           │
     │         ptr += 1                                                        │
     │         tried += 1                                                      │
     │         if f in off:                                                    │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         off.add(f)                                                      │
     │         state.off_until[f] = abs_slot + c.ROSTER_MIN_SLOTS              │
     │         need -= feeder_kw[f]                                            │
     │     state.pointer[sd_id] = ptr % len(feeder_ids)                        │
     │     return off                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Write backend/app/grid/metrics.py                         │

     │ """Reliability and quality accumulators, kept per sub-division and for  │

     │                                                                         │

     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class Metrics:                                                          │
     │     slots: int = 0  # intervals simulated (a clock; not summed by add)  │
     │     consumer_slots: int = 0                                             │
     │     outage_consumer_slots: int = 0  # consumer-intervals with zero      │
     │ supply                                                                  │
     │     interruptions: int = 0  # supply on -> off transitions, per         │
     │ consumer                                                                │
     │     ens_kwh: float = 0.0  # demand lost to outages                      │
     │     curtailed_kwh: float = 0.0  # demand trimmed by caps and DR while   │
     │ supply stayed on                                                        │
     │     served_kwh: float = 0.0                                             │
     │     deficit_consumer_slots: int = 0  # consumer-intervals inside a      │
     │ deficit                                                                 │
     │     lifeline_ok_consumer_slots: int = 0  # ... during which supply      │
     │ stayed on                                                               │
     │     critical_slots: int = 0                                             │
     │     critical_interrupted_slots: int = 0                                 │
     │     dt_slots: int = 0                                                   │
     │     dt_overload_slots: int = 0                                          │
     │     dt_trips: int = 0                                                   │

     │     loss_kwh: float = 0.0  # LV technical losses                        │

     │     @property                                                           │
     │     def hoh(self) -> float:                                             │
     │         return self.outage_consumer_slots * c.DT_H                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def saidi_min(self, n_consumers: int) -> float:                     │
     │         return self.hoh * 60.0 / n_consumers if n_consumers else 0.0    │

     │     def saifi(self, n_consumers: int) -> float:                         │
     │         return self.interruptions / n_consumers if n_consumers else 0.0 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def outage_h_per_consumer_day(self, n_consumers: int) -> float:     │
     │         days = self.slots / c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                             │
     │         return self.hoh / n_consumers / days if n_consumers and days    │
     │ else 0.0                                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @property                                                           │
     │     def lifeline_availability_pct(self) -> float:                       │
     │         if not self.deficit_consumer_slots:                             │
     │             return 100.0                                                │
     │         return 100.0 * self.lifeline_ok_consumer_slots /                │
     │ self.deficit_consumer_slots                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @property                                                           │
     │     def critical_availability_pct(self) -> float:                       │
     │         if not self.critical_slots:                                     │
     │             return 100.0                                                │
     │         return 100.0 * (1 - self.critical_interrupted_slots /           │
     │ self.critical_slots)                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @property                                                           │
     │     def loss_pct(self) -> float:                                        │
     │         total = self.served_kwh + self.loss_kwh                         │
     │         return 100.0 * self.loss_kwh / total if total else 0.0          │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def add(self, other: "Metrics") -> None:                            │
     │         for f in fields(self):                                          │
     │             if f.name != "slots":                                       │
     │                 setattr(self, f.name, getattr(self, f.name) +           │
     │ getattr(other, f.name))                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def to_dict(self, n_consumers: int) -> dict:                        │
     │         out = asdict(self)                                              │
     │         out.update(hoh=self.hoh, saidi_min=self.saidi_min(n_consumers), │
     │ saifi=self.saifi(n_consumers),                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ outage_h_per_consumer_day=self.outage_h_per_consumer_day(n_consumers),  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ lifeline_availability_pct=self.lifeline_availability_pct,               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ critical_availability_pct=self.critical_availability_pct,               │
     │ loss_pct=self.loss_pct)                                                 │
     │         return out                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @classmethod                                                        │
     │     def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "Metrics":                           │
     │         names = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}                           │
     │         return cls(**{k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in names})        │

     │ - [ ] Step 5: Write backend/app/grid/fairness.py                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Who carried the burden. Burden = energy a consumer wanted and did    │
     │ not get (outage, cap or DR)."""                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def jain(x) -> float:                                                   │
     │     """Jain's fairness index: 1 when everyone is equal, 1/n when one    │
     │ consumer has everything."""                                             │
     │     x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)                                      │
     │     denom = len(x) * float((x**2).sum())                                │
     │     return float(x.sum() ** 2 / denom) if denom > 0 else 1.0            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def served_fraction(burden_kwh: np.ndarray, entitled_kwh: np.ndarray)   │
     │ -> np.ndarray:                                                          │
     │     return 1.0 - np.asarray(burden_kwh, dtype=float) /                  │
     │ np.maximum(np.asarray(entitled_kwh, dtype=float), 1e-9)                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def gini(x) -> float:                                                   │
     │     x = np.sort(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))                             │
     │     n, total = len(x), float(x.sum())                                   │
     │     if n == 0 or total <= 0:                                            │
     │         return 0.0                                                      │
     │     return float((2 * np.arange(1, n + 1) - n - 1).dot(x) / (n *        │
     │ total))                                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def lorenz_points(x, points: int = 21) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:    │
     │     """(share of consumers, share of burden they carry), consumers      │
     │ sorted from least to most burdened."""                                  │
     │     x = np.sort(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))                             │
     │     total = float(x.sum())                                              │
     │     cum = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(x) / total]) if total > 0    │
     │ else np.linspace(0, 1, len(x) + 1)                                      │
     │     shares = np.linspace(0, 1, points)                                  │
     │     return [(float(s), float(np.interp(s, np.linspace(0, 1, len(cum)),  │
     │ cum))) for s in shares]                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def fairness_weights(dt_burden_ratio: np.ndarray, beta: float = 1.0) -> │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │     """1 for the least burdened DT, 1 + beta for the most burdened. All │
     │ ones if nobody is burdened."""                                          │
     │     r = np.asarray(dt_burden_ratio, dtype=float)                        │
     │     top = float(r.max()) if r.size else 0.0                             │
     │     return np.ones_like(r) if top <= 0 else 1.0 + beta * r / top        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 6: Write backend/app/grid/risk.py                            │

     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ RISK_THRESHOLDS = (25, 45, 65)  # monitor, stress, critical             │
     │ DRIVER_KEYS = ("loading", "thermal", "voltage", "deficit", "critical")  │
     │ DRIVER_LABEL = {"loading": "Peak loading", "thermal": "Hot-spot",       │

     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def dt_risk_drivers(peak_loading_pct, hotspot_peak_c, v_min_pu,         │
     │ deficit_slots, hosts_critical) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:                │

     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "loading": 35 * np.clip((np.asarray(peak_loading_pct,           │

     │         "thermal": 20 * np.clip((np.asarray(hotspot_peak_c,             │
     │ dtype=float) - 95) / 45, 0, 1),                                         │

     │         "critical": 10 * (np.asarray(hosts_critical, dtype=bool) &      │
     │ (deficit_slots > 0)),                                                   │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │

     │ v_min_pu, deficit_slots, hosts_critical)                                │
     │     return np.rint(sum(drivers.values())).astype(int)                   │
     │                                                                         │

     │ def risk_level(index: float) -> str:                                    │

     │ dt_index.max()) + min(10, 5 * urgent_pending)))                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 7: Write backend/app/grid/dr_model.py                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Learns how often each consumer segment accepts a demand-response ask │
     │ (Beta-Bernoulli per                                                     │
     │ archetype). The simulation's hidden truth is `true_acceptance`; the     │
     │ product only sees outcomes."""                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ PRIOR_ALPHA, PRIOR_BETA = 2.0, 5.0                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class DrModel:                                                          │
     │     def __init__(self, alpha: np.ndarray | None = None, beta:           │
     │ np.ndarray | None = None):                                              │
     │         n = len(c.ARCHETYPES)                                           │
     │         self.alpha = np.full(n, PRIOR_ALPHA) if alpha is None else      │
     │ np.asarray(alpha, dtype=float)                                          │
     │         self.beta = np.full(n, PRIOR_BETA) if beta is None else         │
     │ np.asarray(beta, dtype=float)                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def rate(self) -> np.ndarray:                                       │
     │         return self.alpha / (self.alpha + self.beta)                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def consumer_rate(self, arch: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:            │
     │         return self.rate()[np.asarray(arch, dtype=int)]                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def update(self, arch: np.ndarray, accepted: np.ndarray) -> None:   │
     │         arch = np.asarray(arch, dtype=int)                              │
     │         accepted = np.asarray(accepted, dtype=bool)                     │
     │         for k in range(len(c.ARCHETYPES)):                              │
     │             mask = arch == k                                            │
     │             self.alpha[k] += float(accepted[mask].sum())                │
     │             self.beta[k] += float((~accepted[mask]).sum())              │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def to_state(self) -> dict:                                         │
     │         return {"alpha": self.alpha.tolist(), "beta":                   │
     │ self.beta.tolist()}                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @classmethod                                                        │
     │     def from_state(cls, state: dict) -> "DrModel":                      │
     │         return cls(np.array(state["alpha"]), np.array(state["beta"]))   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def true_acceptance(propensity: np.ndarray, rebate_rs_per_kwh: float,   │
     │ rng: np.random.Generator) -> np.ndarray:                                │
     │     """Hidden behaviour: a consumer's propensity, scaled by the rebate  │
     │ (neutral at Rs 2 per kWh)."""                                           │
     │     p = np.clip(np.asarray(propensity, dtype=float) * (0.6 + 0.2 *      │
     │ rebate_rs_per_kwh), 0.0, 0.95)                                          │
     │     return rng.random(len(p)) < p                                       │
     │                                                                         │

     │ Task B1: The simulated world (two tracks)                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/world.py, backend/tests/helpers.py           │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_world.py                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Consumes: everything from Lane A.                                     │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - Actions(cap_kw (N,), cap_started (N,) bool, dr_on (N,) bool,        │
     │ hub_frac (H,), storage_kw (S,), shift_on (R,) bool) and Actions.none(n, │
     │ h, s, r)                                                                │
     │   - Track (per-world state) with .metrics: dict[str, Metrics] keyed by  │
     │ "all" and each sub-division id, .burden_kwh, .entitled_kwh, .soc,       │
     │ .hotspot, .lol_pct, .trip_left                                          │
     │   - IntervalResult (one track, one interval): at, served, meter_state,  │
     │ dt_on, dt_kw, dt_gross_kw, loading, hotspot, v_min, v_max, loss_kw,     │
     │ feeders_off, sd_supplied_kw, hub_kw, shift_kw, storage_kw, pv_kw,       │
     │ tripped_dts, events                                                     │
     │   - LogRow: at, sd_natural_kw, sd_avail_kw, sd_supplied_sol,            │
     │ sd_supplied_base, sd_out_sol, sd_out_base, sd_capped_sol, loading,      │
     │ hotspot, v_min, dt_on (per-interval history for charts)                 │
     │   - GridWorld(repo, days, supply, seed, sim_start, power_flow=True)     │
     │ with .warm_up(), .advance(actions: Actions | None = None) ->            │
     │ tuple[IntervalResult, IntervalResult], .now, .abs_slot, .solution,      │
     │ .baseline, .history_pu, .temp_hist, .log (deque, 672 rows),             │
     │ .no_actions, index arrays sd_dts, sd_cons, sd_feeders, feeder_dts,      │
     │ hub_dt, fac_dt, store_dt, shift_fac                                     │
     │ - tests/helpers.py produces SIM_START and make_world(seed=7,            │
     │ dts_per_subdivision=3, power_flow=True, firm=None) -> GridWorld         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ What one interval does, in order (both tracks run this on identical     │
     │ demand and supply; the baseline always receives no_actions):            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ 1. Consumer side: DR participants shed their flexible share; capped     │
     │ consumers are limited to their cap; in a cap's first interval a small   │
     │ share exceed it and trip for that interval. Life-support consumers are  │
     │ exempt from both.                                                       │
     │ 2. Assets: chargers follow their schedule minus any curtailment, and    │
     │ repay deferred energy when unconstrained; shiftable loads are held off  │
     │ or make up; storage discharges within its state of charge and recharges │
     │ in solar and night hours.                                               │
     │ 3. Compute every DT's load as if everything were energised.             │
     │ 4. For each sub-division: if demand exceeds available supply by more    │
     │ than the tolerance, shed feeders in rotation (the status quo). In the   │
     │ solution world this happens only when no approved plan covered the gap. │
     │ 5. Recompute energised quantities; update deferred-energy banks and     │
     │ state of charge.                                                        │
     │ 6. A DT above 130 percent for two intervals trips for two hours, from   │
     │ the next interval.                                                      │
     │ 7. Thermal state, loss of life, LV power flow, losses, voltage.         │
     │ 8. Rebound: 30 percent of energy trimmed or lost returns later, 15      │
     │ percent of the waiting amount per interval, once the DT is on and       │
     │ uncapped.                                                               │
     │ 9. Critical facilities ride through on backup, then count as            │
     │ interrupted.                                                            │
     │ 10. Meter states, fairness ledger, metrics, events.                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 1: Write backend/tests/helpers.py                            │

     │ def make_world(seed: int = 7, dts_per_subdivision: int = 3, power_flow: │
     │ bool = True, firm: dict | None = None) -> GridWorld:                    │
     │     repo = sized_test_repo(seed, dts_per_subdivision)                   │
