     │         z = np.zeros                                                    │
     │         return Track(                                                   │
     │             name=name, to_rise=z(self.D), hotspot=z(self.D),            │
     │ lol_pct=z(self.D),                                                      │
     │             overload_run=z(self.D, dtype=int), trip_left=z(self.D,      │
     │ dtype=int),                                                             │
     │             prev_supplied=np.ones(self.N, dtype=bool),                  │
     │ prev_interrupted=z(len(self.fac_dt), dtype=bool),                       │
     │             burden_kwh=z(self.N), entitled_kwh=z(self.N),               │
     │ backup_left=self.fac_backup.copy(),                                     │
     │             rebound_kwh=z(self.D), rebound_next_kw=z(self.D),           │
     │ hub_deferred_kwh=z(len(self.hub_dt)),                                   │
     │             shift_deferred_kwh=z(len(self.shift_fac)),                  │
     │ soc=np.full(len(self.store_dt), INITIAL_SOC),                           │
     │             metrics={k: Metrics() for k in ["all", *self.sd_ids]})      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ warm-up                                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def warm_up(self) -> None:                                          │
     │         """Fill the forecaster's history with the eight days before the │
     │ start, and start every                                                  │
     │         transformer at the thermal steady state of its last hour."""    │
     │         t = self.sim_start - HISTORY_SLOTS * STEP                       │
     │         cached_date, gross, temp = None, None, None                     │
     │         for col in range(HISTORY_SLOTS):                                │
     │             d = self.days.ist_date(t)                                   │
     │             if d != cached_date:                                        │
     │                 cached_date, gross, temp = d, self.days.gross_only(d),  │
     │ self.days.weather_dt(d)["temp_c"]                                       │
     │             s = ist_slot(t)                                             │
     │             self.history_pu[:, col] = gross[:, s] / self.repo.rating_kw │
     │             tail = col - (HISTORY_SLOTS - c.SLOTS_PER_DAY)              │
     │             if tail >= 0:                                               │
     │                 self.temp_hist[:, tail] = temp[:, s]                    │
     │             t += STEP                                                   │
     │         k = self.history_pu[:, -4:].mean(axis=1)                        │
     │         rise = top_oil_rise_ultimate(k)                                 │
     │         for tr in (self.solution, self.baseline):                       │
     │             tr.to_rise = rise.copy()                                    │
     │             tr.hotspot = hot_spot_temp(self.temp_hist[:, -1], rise, k)  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------ one  │
     │ interval                                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def advance(self, actions: Actions | None = None) ->                │
     │ tuple[IntervalResult, IntervalResult]:                                  │
     │         cons = self.repo.consumers                                      │
     │         at = self.now                                                   │
     │         day = self.days.get(self.days.ist_date(at))                     │
     │         slot = ist_slot(at)                                             │
     │         avail = np.array([self.supply.available_kw(s, at, 1)[0] for s   │
     │ in self.sd_ids])                                                        │
     │         d = day.demand[:, slot].astype(float)                           │
     │         nat_gross = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=d,               │
     │ minlength=self.D) + day.assets.dt_kw[:, slot]                           │
     │         nat_net = nat_gross - day.assets.pv_kw[:, slot]                 │
     │         sd_natural = np.array([max(0.0, nat_net[i].sum()) * (1 +        │
     │ c.HT_LOSS_FRAC) for i in self.sd_dts])                                  │
     │         sd_deficit = sd_natural > avail + self.tolerance                │
     │         draw = np.random.default_rng([self.seed,                        │
     │ self.abs_slot]).random(self.N)                                          │
     │         args = (at, slot, day, d, avail, sd_deficit, draw)              │
     │         sol = self._run(self.solution, *args, actions or                │
     │ self.no_actions)                                                        │
     │         base = self._run(self.baseline, *args, self.no_actions)         │
     │         self.history_pu[:, :-1] = self.history_pu[:, 1:]                │
     │         self.history_pu[:, -1] = nat_gross / self.repo.rating_kw        │
     │         self.temp_hist[:, :-1] = self.temp_hist[:, 1:]                  │
     │         self.temp_hist[:, -1] = day.temp_dt[:, slot]                    │
     │         self.log.append(LogRow(                                         │
     │             at=at, sd_natural_kw=sd_natural, sd_avail_kw=avail,         │
     │ sd_supplied_sol=sol.sd_supplied_kw,                                     │
     │             sd_supplied_base=base.sd_supplied_kw,                       │
     │             sd_out_sol=self._count(sol.meter_state >= c.METER_TRIPPED,  │
     │ sol.meter_state != c.METER_PROTECTED),                                  │
     │             sd_out_base=self._count(base.meter_state >=                 │
     │ c.METER_TRIPPED, base.meter_state != c.METER_PROTECTED),                │
     │             sd_capped_sol=self._count(sol.meter_state ==                │
     │ c.METER_CAPPED),                                                        │
     │             loading=sol.loading.astype(np.float32),                     │
     │ hotspot=sol.hotspot.astype(np.float32),                                 │
     │             v_min=sol.v_min.astype(np.float32), dt_on=sol.dt_on.copy(), │
     │ off_sol=frozenset(sol.feeders_off),                                     │
     │             off_base=frozenset(base.feeders_off),                       │
     │ hub_sched_kw=day.assets.hub_kw[:, slot].copy(), hub_kw=sol.hub_kw,      │
     │             soc=self.solution.soc.copy(), storage_kw=sol.storage_kw,    │
     │ shift_kw=sol.shift_kw))                                                 │
     │         self.abs_slot += 1                                              │
     │         self.now = at + STEP                                            │
     │         return sol, base                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _count(self, mask: np.ndarray, also: np.ndarray | None = None)  │
     │ -> np.ndarray:                                                          │
     │         m = mask if also is None else mask & also                       │
     │         return np.bincount(self.cons_sd, weights=m.astype(float),       │
     │ minlength=len(self.sd_ids)).astype(int)                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _run(self, tr: Track, at: datetime, slot: int, day: DayData, d: │
     │ np.ndarray, avail: np.ndarray,                                          │
     │              sd_deficit: np.ndarray, draw: np.ndarray, act: Actions) -> │
     │ IntervalResult:                                                         │
     │         cons = self.repo.consumers                                      │
     │         rating = self.repo.rating_kw                                    │
     │         exempt = cons.life_support                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 1. consumer side                                              │
     │         want = d.copy()                                                 │
     │         dr = act.dr_on & ~exempt                                        │
     │         want[dr] *= 1.0 - cons.flex_share[dr] * c.DR_FLEX_REALISED      │
     │         capped = np.isfinite(act.cap_kw) & ~exempt                      │
     │         over_cap = capped & (want > act.cap_kw)                         │
     │         tripped = over_cap & act.cap_started & (draw <                  │
     │ c.CAP_TRIP_SHARE)                                                       │
     │         served = np.where(over_cap, act.cap_kw, want)                   │
     │         served[tripped] = 0.0                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 2. assets                                                     │
     │         sched_hub = day.assets.hub_kw[:, slot]                          │
     │         hub_cut = sched_hub * act.hub_frac                              │
     │         spare = np.maximum(0.0, self.hub_max - sched_hub)               │
     │         hub_free = (act.hub_frac <= 0) & ~sd_deficit[self.hub_sd]       │
     │         hub_repay = np.where(hub_free, np.minimum(spare,                │
     │ tr.hub_deferred_kwh / c.DT_H), 0.0)                                     │
     │         hub = sched_hub - hub_cut + hub_repay                           │
     │         sched_shift = day.assets.shift_kw[:, slot]                      │
     │         held = act.shift_on & (sched_shift > 0)                         │
     │         make_up_rate = np.where(sched_shift > 0, 0.5, 1.0) *            │
     │ self.shift_power                                                        │
     │         shift_free = ~act.shift_on & ~sd_deficit[self.shift_sd]         │
     │         shift_repay = np.where(shift_free, np.minimum(make_up_rate,     │
     │ tr.shift_deferred_kwh / c.DT_H), 0.0)                                   │
     │         shift = np.where(held, 0.0, sched_shift) + shift_repay          │
     │         fac = day.assets.facility_kw[:, slot].copy()                    │
     │         fac[self.shift_fac] = shift                                     │
     │         usable = np.maximum(0.0, (tr.soc - self.store_soc_min) *        │
     │ self.store_energy)                                                      │
     │         sto = np.minimum(np.minimum(np.maximum(act.storage_kw, 0.0),    │
     │ self.store_power), usable * self.store_eff / c.DT_H)                    │
     │         hour = slot / 4.0                                               │
     │         charge_hours = (10 <= hour < 16) or (1 <= hour < 5)             │
     │         room = np.maximum(0.0, (SOC_CEILING - tr.soc) *                 │
     │ self.store_energy)                                                      │
     │         can_charge = (sto <= 0) & charge_hours &                        │
     │ ~sd_deficit[self.store_sd]                                              │
     │         charge = np.where(can_charge, np.minimum(0.5 *                  │
     │ self.store_power, room / c.DT_H), 0.0)                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 3. every DT as if energised                                   │
     │         asset_dt = np.zeros(self.D)                                     │
     │         np.add.at(asset_dt, self.hub_dt, hub)                           │
     │         np.add.at(asset_dt, self.fac_dt, fac)                           │
     │         np.add.at(asset_dt, self.store_dt, charge)                      │
     │         sto_dt = np.zeros(self.D)                                       │
     │         np.add.at(sto_dt, self.store_dt, sto)                           │
     │         pv = day.assets.pv_kw[:, slot]                                  │
     │         rebound_kw = tr.rebound_next_kw                                 │
     │         net_all = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=served,            │
     │ minlength=self.D) + asset_dt + rebound_kw - pv - sto_dt                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 4. the status quo covers whatever supply still cannot         │
     │         dead = tr.trip_left > 0                                         │
     │         live = np.where(dead, 0.0, net_all)                             │
     │         off: set[str] = set()                                           │
     │         for s, sd_id in enumerate(self.sd_ids):                         │
     │             demand = max(0.0, float(live[self.sd_dts[s]].sum())) * (1 + │
     │ c.HT_LOSS_FRAC)                                                         │
     │             gap = demand - avail[s]                                     │
     │             feeder_kw = {f: max(0.0,                                    │
     │ float(live[self.feeder_dts[f]].sum())) * (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC) for f in  │
     │ self.sd_feeders[s]}                                                     │
     │             off |= roster_step(tr.roster, sd_id, self.sd_feeders[s],    │
     │ feeder_kw, gap if gap > self.tolerance[s] else 0.0, self.abs_slot)      │
     │         feeder_on = np.ones(len(self.repo.feeder_ids), dtype=bool)      │
     │         for f in off:                                                   │
     │             feeder_on[self.feeder_pos[f]] = False                       │
     │         dt_on = feeder_on[self.repo.dt_feeder_index] & ~dead            │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 5. energised quantities and banks                             │
     │         on_c = dt_on[cons.dt_index]                                     │
     │         supplied = on_c & ~tripped                                      │
     │         served = served * on_c                                          │
     │         gross = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=served,              │
     │ minlength=self.D) + (asset_dt + rebound_kw) * dt_on                     │
     │         net = gross - (pv + sto_dt) * dt_on                             │
     │         loading = np.maximum(net, 0.0) / rating                         │
     │         hub_on, store_on, shift_on_dt = dt_on[self.hub_dt],             │
     │ dt_on[self.store_dt], dt_on[self.shift_dt]                              │
     │         tr.hub_deferred_kwh = np.maximum(0.0, tr.hub_deferred_kwh +     │
     │ (hub_cut - hub_repay * hub_on) * c.DT_H)                                │
     │         tr.shift_deferred_kwh = np.maximum(                             │
     │             0.0, tr.shift_deferred_kwh + (np.where(held, sched_shift,   │
     │ 0.0) - shift_repay * shift_on_dt) * c.DT_H)                             │
     │         tr.soc = np.clip(tr.soc + (charge * self.store_eff - sto /      │
     │ self.store_eff) * store_on * c.DT_H / self.store_energy, 0.0, 1.0)      │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 6. overload trips, effective from the next interval           │
     │         tr.overload_run = np.where((loading > c.TRIP_LOADING_PU) &      │
     │ dt_on, tr.overload_run + 1, 0)                                          │
     │         newly = tr.overload_run >= c.TRIP_INTERVALS                     │
     │         tr.trip_left = np.where(newly, c.TRIP_OUTAGE_INTERVALS,         │
     │ np.maximum(0, tr.trip_left - 1))                                        │
     │         tr.overload_run[newly] = 0                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 7. thermal state and LV power flow                            │
     │         amb = day.temp_dt[:, slot]                                      │
     │         tr.to_rise = step_top_oil(tr.to_rise, loading)                  │
     │         tr.hotspot = hot_spot_temp(amb, tr.to_rise, loading)            │
     │         lol = loss_of_life_pct(ageing_factor(tr.hotspot))               │
     │         tr.lol_pct = tr.lol_pct + lol                                   │
     │         limit_pu = dynamic_limit_pu(amb)                                │
     │         sd_supplied = np.array([max(0.0, float(net[i].sum())) * (1 +    │
     │ c.HT_LOSS_FRAC) for i in self.sd_dts])                                  │
     │         v_min, v_max, loss = np.zeros(self.D), np.zeros(self.D),        │
     │ np.zeros(self.D)                                                        │
     │         if self.power_flow:                                             │
     │             source = 1.0 - 0.03 * np.minimum(1.2, sd_supplied /         │
     │ self.alloc)                                                             │
     │             for i, dt in enumerate(self.repo.network.transformers):     │
     │                 if not dt_on[i]:                                        │
     │                     continue                                            │
     │                 sl = cons.dt_slices[i]                                  │
     │                 load = np.bincount(cons.node[sl], weights=served[sl],   │
     │ minlength=self.lv_nodes[i])                                             │
     │                 load[1] += asset_dt[i] + rebound_kw[i]                  │
     │                 unit = pv[i] / self.solar_sum_dt[i] if                  │
     │ self.solar_sum_dt[i] > 0 else 0.0                                       │
     │                 gen = np.bincount(cons.node[sl],                        │
     │ weights=cons.solar_kw[sl] * unit, minlength=self.lv_nodes[i])           │
     │                 gen[1] += sto_dt[i]                                     │
     │                 res = dt_powerflow(dt.lv, load, gen,                    │
     │ source_pu=float(source[self.repo.dt_subdivision_index[i]]))             │
     │                 v_min[i], v_max[i], loss[i] = res.v_min, res.v_max,     │
     │ res.loss_kw                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 8. rebound                                                    │
     │         lost_kwh = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=d - served,       │
     │ minlength=self.D) * c.DT_H                                              │
     │         tr.rebound_kwh = tr.rebound_kwh + c.REBOUND_SHARE * lost_kwh    │
     │         dt_capped = np.bincount(cons.dt_index,                          │
     │ weights=capped.astype(float), minlength=self.D) > 0                     │
     │         release = np.where(dt_on & ~dt_capped, c.REBOUND_RELEASE *      │
     │ tr.rebound_kwh, 0.0)                                                    │
     │         tr.rebound_kwh = tr.rebound_kwh - release                       │
     │         tr.rebound_next_kw = release / c.DT_H                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 9. critical facilities                                        │
     │         fac_on = dt_on[self.fac_dt]                                     │
     │         interrupted = ~fac_on & (tr.backup_left <= 0)                   │
     │         tr.backup_left = np.where(fac_on, self.fac_backup,              │
     │ np.maximum(0.0, tr.backup_left - c.INTERVAL_MIN))                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # 10. meter states, ledger, metrics, events                     │
     │         state = np.full(self.N, c.METER_NORMAL, dtype=np.uint8)         │
     │         state[dr] = c.METER_DR                                          │
     │         state[over_cap] = c.METER_CAPPED                                │
     │         state[exempt & (dt_capped[cons.dt_index] | act.dr_on)] =        │
     │ c.METER_PROTECTED                                                       │
     │         state[tripped] = c.METER_TRIPPED                                │
     │         state[~on_c] = c.METER_OUTAGE                                   │
     │         tr.burden_kwh = tr.burden_kwh + (d - served) * c.DT_H           │
     │         tr.entitled_kwh = tr.entitled_kwh + d * c.DT_H                  │
     │         for s, sd_id in enumerate(self.sd_ids):                         │
     │             ci, di, fi = self.sd_cons[s], self.sd_dts[s],               │
     │ self.sd_fac[s]                                                          │
     │             sup = supplied[ci]                                          │
     │             m = Metrics(                                                │
     │                 consumer_slots=len(ci),                                 │
     │ outage_consumer_slots=int((~sup).sum()),                                │
     │                 interruptions=int((tr.prev_supplied[ci] & ~sup).sum()), │
     │                 ens_kwh=float(d[ci][~sup].sum() * c.DT_H),              │
     │                 curtailed_kwh=float((d[ci] - served[ci])[sup].sum() *   │
     │ c.DT_H),                                                                │
     │                 served_kwh=float(gross[di].sum() * c.DT_H),             │
     │                 deficit_consumer_slots=len(ci) if sd_deficit[s] else 0, │
     │                 lifeline_ok_consumer_slots=int(sup.sum()) if            │
     │ sd_deficit[s] else 0,                                                   │
     │                 critical_slots=len(fi),                                 │
     │ critical_interrupted_slots=int(interrupted[fi].sum()),                  │
     │                 dt_slots=len(di), dt_overload_slots=int(((loading[di] > │
     │ limit_pu[di]) & dt_on[di]).sum()),                                      │
     │                 dt_trips=int(newly[di].sum()),                          │
     │ lol_pct=float(lol[di].sum()), loss_kwh=float(loss[di].sum() * c.DT_H),  │
     │                 v_violation_dt_slots=int((((v_min[di] < c.V_MIN_PU) |   │
     │ (v_max[di] > c.V_MAX_PU)) & dt_on[di]).sum()))                          │
     │             tr.metrics[sd_id].add(m)                                    │
     │             tr.metrics[sd_id].slots += 1                                │
     │             tr.metrics["all"].add(m)                                    │
     │         tr.metrics["all"].slots += 1                                    │
     │         events = self._events(tr, at, off, newly, interrupted)          │
     │         tr.prev_supplied, tr.prev_off, tr.prev_interrupted = supplied,  │
     │ off, interrupted                                                        │
     │         return IntervalResult(                                          │
     │             at=at, served=served, meter_state=state, dt_on=dt_on,       │
     │ dt_kw=net, dt_gross_kw=gross, loading=loading,                          │
     │             hotspot=tr.hotspot.copy(), v_min=v_min, v_max=v_max,        │
     │ loss_kw=loss, feeders_off=off,                                          │
     │             sd_supplied_kw=sd_supplied, hub_kw=hub * hub_on,            │
     │ shift_kw=shift * shift_on_dt, storage_kw=sto * store_on,                │
     │             pv_kw=pv * dt_on, tripped_dts=[self.repo.dt_ids[i] for i in │
     │ np.flatnonzero(newly)], events=events)                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _events(self, tr: Track, at: datetime, off: set[str], newly:    │
     │ np.ndarray, interrupted: np.ndarray) -> list[dict]:                     │
     │         net = self.repo.network                                         │
     │         stamp = at.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")                       │
     │         out: list[dict] = []                                            │
     │         for f in sorted(off - tr.prev_off):                             │
     │             feeder = self.repo.feeder(f)                                │
     │             out.append({"at": stamp, "track": tr.name, "type":          │
     │ "feeder_shed", "subdivision_id": feeder.subdivision_id,                 │
     │                         "feeder_id": f, "title": f"{feeder.name}        │
     │ switched off (rotational shedding)",                                    │
     │                         "detail": f"{len(feeder.dt_ids)} transformers   │
     │ without supply"})                                                       │
     │         for f in sorted(tr.prev_off - off):                             │
     │             feeder = self.repo.feeder(f)                                │
     │             out.append({"at": stamp, "track": tr.name, "type":          │
     │ "feeder_restored", "subdivision_id": feeder.subdivision_id,             │
     │                         "feeder_id": f, "title": f"{feeder.name}        │
     │ restored", "detail": ""})                                               │
     │         for i in np.flatnonzero(newly):                                 │
     │             dt = net.transformers[i]                                    │
     │             out.append({"at": stamp, "track": tr.name, "type":          │
     │ "dt_trip", "subdivision_id": dt.subdivision_id,                         │
     │                         "dt_id": dt.id, "title": f"{dt.name} tripped on │
     │ overload",                                                              │
     │                         "detail": f"Above {int(c.TRIP_LOADING_PU *      │
     │ 100)} percent for {c.TRIP_INTERVALS * c.INTERVAL_MIN} minutes"})        │
     │         for i in np.flatnonzero(interrupted & ~tr.prev_interrupted):    │
     │             fac = net.critical_facilities[i]                            │
     │             out.append({"at": stamp, "track": tr.name, "type":          │
     │ "critical_interrupted", "subdivision_id": fac.subdivision_id,           │
     │                         "dt_id": fac.dt_id, "facility_id": fac.id,      │
     │ "title": f"{fac.name} lost supply",                                     │
     │                         "detail": "Backup exhausted" if                 │
     │ fac.backup_minutes else "No backup"})                                   │

     │ ---                                                                     │
     │ Task B2: Forecast bundle and Flex Plan service                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/planner.py                                   │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_planner.py                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Consumes: GridWorld, Forecaster, DtStatic, DrModel, optimizer,        │
     │ deficits, levers, fairness, baseline.roster_step, models from Task A2.  │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - ForecastBundle dataclass: issued_at, start, horizon, gross_kw       │
     │ (D,T,3), pv_kw (D,T), net_kw (D,T,3), temp (D,T), limit_kw (D,T),       │
     │ avail_kw (SD,T), plan_net_kw (D,T), gap_kw (SD,T), over_kw (D,T), mode: │
     │ str                                                                     │
     │   - build_forecast(world, forecaster, static, now, risk=0.5) ->         │
     │ ForecastBundle                                                          │
     │   - plan_id_for(sd_id: str, start: datetime) -> str (fp_ + 8 hex, keyed │
     │ on the window's start hour)                                             │
     │   - FlexPlanService(world, forecaster, static, dr_model,                │
     │ autopilot=False) with                                                   │
     │       - .plans: dict[str, FlexPlan], .forecast: ForecastBundle | None,  │
     │ .on_approved: Callable[[FlexPlan, datetime], None] | None,              │
     │ .on_cancelled: Callable[[FlexPlan, datetime], None] | None              │
     │     - refresh(now) -> dict with keys added, expired, changed (lists of  │
     │ plan ids)                                                               │
     │     - list(status: str | None = None, subdivision_id: str | None =      │
     │ None) -> list[FlexPlan]                                                 │
     │     - get(plan_id) -> FlexPlan (raises NotFoundError("Plan", id))       │
     │     - approve(plan_id, actor, note=None, overrides: PlanOverrides |     │
     │ None = None, now=None) -> FlexPlan                                      │
     │     - reject(plan_id, actor, note=None, now=None) -> FlexPlan           │
     │     - cancel(plan_id, actor, reason, now=None) -> FlexPlan              │
     │     - transition(plan, status, now, actor, title, detail="") -> None    │
     │ (enforces LEGAL_TRANSITIONS)                                            │
     │     - simulate(plan_id, overrides) -> FlexPlan (a re-solved copy;       │
     │ nothing is stored)                                                      │
     │     - sensitivity(plan_id) -> dict with rows (max cap level 0..3), cols │
     │ (DR response scale), cells[row][col] = {"residual_kwh",                 │
     │ "households_capped", "households_blackout"}, base = [row, col]          │
     │     - consumer_caps(plan) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] (consumer    │
     │ positions, cap in kW with inf for exempt or uncapped)                   │
     │     - to_state() -> dict, load_state(state: dict) -> None               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ How a plan is built for one window.                                     │
     │ 1. Per-consumer expected demand comes from the load model under         │
     │ forecast weather, then is scaled per DT and slot so that consumers plus │
     │ scheduled assets equal the DT's planning load (the ML forecast). This   │
     │ reconciles the bottom-up split with the top-down forecast.              │
     │ 2. Voluntary DR is applied first: each consumer's expected demand falls │
     │ by flex_share × learned acceptance rate × 0.8. No optimisation is       │
     │ needed for a lever that costs the consumer nothing unless they opt in.  │
     │ 3. Cap potentials per DT and level, charger schedules, shiftable loads  │
     │ and usable storage become PlanInputs. Caps are disallowed when the      │
     │ window starts in less than NOTICE_MIN_CAPS minutes.                     │
     │ 4. The optimiser picks the cheapest mix. The result is assembled into a │
     │ FlexPlan with lever shares, a projection, reasons, and three compared   │
     │ options: rotational shedding, lifeline only, the full plan.             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests backend/tests/test_planner.py     │

     │ DR_SCALES = (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0)                                   │

     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class ForecastBundle:                                                   │
     │     issued_at: datetime                                                 │
     │     start: datetime                                                     │
     │     horizon: int                                                        │
     │     gross_kw: np.ndarray                                                │
     │     pv_kw: np.ndarray                                                   │
     │     net_kw: np.ndarray                                                  │
     │     temp: np.ndarray                                                    │
     │     limit_kw: np.ndarray                                                │
     │     avail_kw: np.ndarray                                                │
     │     plan_net_kw: np.ndarray                                             │
     │     gap_kw: np.ndarray                                                  │
     │     over_kw: np.ndarray                                                 │
     │     mode: str                                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def build_forecast(world: GridWorld, forecaster: Forecaster, static:    │
     │ DtStatic, now: datetime,                                                │
     │                    risk: float = 0.5) -> ForecastBundle:                │
     │     days, repo = world.days, world.repo                                 │
     │     T = c.FORECAST_HORIZON_SLOTS                                        │
     │     temp_fc, cloud_fc, ghi_fc = (np.zeros((world.D, T)) for _ in        │
     │ range(3))                                                               │
     │     for place in days.places:                                           │
     │         w = days.weather.forecast(place, now, now, T)                   │
     │         rows = days.rows_of_place[place]                                │
     │         temp_fc[rows], cloud_fc[rows], ghi_fc[rows] = w["temp_c"],      │
     │ w["cloud_pct"], w["ghi"]                                                │
     │     pu = forecast_horizon(forecaster, static, world.history_pu,         │
     │ ist_slot(now), days.ist_date(now).weekday(),                            │
     │                           np.concatenate([world.temp_hist, temp_fc],    │
     │ axis=1), cloud_fc, T)                                                   │
     │     gross = pu * static.rating_kw[:, None, None]                        │
     │     solar = np.array([d.solar_kw for d in repo.network.transformers]) * │
     │ days.weather.scenario.rooftop_multiplier                                │
     │     pv = solar[:, None] * PV_PERFORMANCE_RATIO * np.clip(ghi_fc /       │
     │ 1000.0, 0, 1.2) * (1 - 0.004 * np.maximum(0, temp_fc - 25))             │
     │     net = gross - pv[:, :, None]                                        │
     │     limit = dt_limits_kw(repo.rating_kw, temp_fc)                       │
     │     avail = np.stack([world.supply.available_kw(s, now, T,              │
     │ issued_at=now) for s in repo.sd_ids])                                   │
     │     plan_net = planning_load(net[:, :, 1], net[:, :, 2], risk)          │
     │     gap = np.stack([subdivision_gap(plan_net[idx], avail[s]) for s, idx │
     │ in enumerate(world.sd_dts)])                                            │
     │     return ForecastBundle(issued_at=now, start=now, horizon=T,          │
     │ gross_kw=gross, pv_kw=pv, net_kw=net, temp=temp_fc,                     │
     │                           limit_kw=limit, avail_kw=avail,               │
     │ plan_net_kw=plan_net, gap_kw=gap,                                       │
     │                           over_kw=np.maximum(0.0, plan_net - limit),    │
     │ mode=forecaster.mode)                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def plan_id_for(sd_id: str, start: datetime) -> str:                    │
     │     hour = start.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)             │
     │     return "fp_" +                                                      │
     │ hashlib.sha1(f"{sd_id}|{iso(hour)}".encode()).hexdigest()[:8]           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class WindowContext:                                                    │
     │     s: int  # sub-division position                                     │
     │     a: int  # first horizon slot of the window                          │
     │     b: int  # one past the last                                         │
     │     idx: np.ndarray  # DT positions in this sub-division, ascending     │
     │     ci: np.ndarray  # consumer positions in this sub-division           │
     │     local_dt: np.ndarray  # for each consumer, its DT's position inside │
     │ idx                                                                     │
     │     exp_after: np.ndarray  # (n, Tw) expected demand after voluntary DR │
     │     natural_dt: np.ndarray  # (Ds, Tw) planning net load before any     │
     │ lever                                                                   │
     │     dr_dt: np.ndarray  # (Ds, Tw) expected DR relief                    │
     │     rate: np.ndarray  # (n,) expected DR acceptance per consumer        │
     │     avail: np.ndarray  # (Tw,)                                          │
     │     hub_idx: list[int]                                                  │
     │     store_idx: list[int]                                                │
     │     shift_idx: list[int]                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class FlexPlanService:                                                  │
     │     def __init__(self, world: GridWorld, forecaster: Forecaster,        │
     │ static: DtStatic, dr_model: DrModel,                                    │
     │                  autopilot: bool = False):                              │
     │         self.world = world                                              │
     │         self.forecaster = forecaster                                    │
     │         self.static = static                                            │
     │         self.dr_model = dr_model                                        │
     │         self.autopilot = autopilot                                      │
     │         self.plans: dict[str, FlexPlan] = {}                            │
     │         self.episodes: dict[str, int] = {}                              │
     │         self.forecast: ForecastBundle | None = None                     │
     │         self.on_approved: Callable[[FlexPlan, datetime], None] | None = │
     │ None                                                                    │
     │         self.on_cancelled: Callable[[FlexPlan, datetime], None] | None  │
     │ = None                                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ queries                                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def list(self, status: str | None = None, subdivision_id: str |     │
     │ None = None) -> list[FlexPlan]:                                         │
     │         wanted = set(status.split(",")) if status else None             │
     │         rows = [p for p in self.plans.values()                          │
     │                 if (wanted is None or p.status in wanted) and           │
     │ (subdivision_id is None or p.subdivision_id == subdivision_id)]         │
     │         rank = {"critical": 0, "high": 1, "normal": 2}                  │
     │         return sorted(rows, key=lambda p: (rank[p.priority],            │
     │ p.window.start, p.id))                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get(self, plan_id: str) -> FlexPlan:                            │
     │         if plan_id not in self.plans:                                   │
     │             raise NotFoundError("Plan", plan_id)                        │
     │         return self.plans[plan_id]                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ refresh                                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def refresh(self, now: datetime) -> dict:                           │
     │         world = self.world                                              │
     │         fc = build_forecast(world, self.forecaster, self.static, now)   │
     │         self.forecast = fc                                              │
     │         added, changed, expired, seen = [], [], [], set()               │
     │         for plan in list(self.plans.values()):  # deadlines first, so a │
     │ late plan is never silently rebuilt                                     │
     │             if plan.status == "pending" and                             │
     │ parse_iso(plan.approval_deadline) <= now:                               │
     │                 self.transition(plan, "expired", now, "system", "Plan   │
     │ expired",                                                               │
     │                                 "Not approved in time. Rotational       │
     │ shedding applies for this window.")                                     │
     │                 expired.append(plan.id)                                 │
     │         for s, sd_id in enumerate(world.sd_ids):                        │
     │             threshold = max(c.MIN_GAP_KW, 0.5 *                         │
     │ float(world.tolerance[s]))                                              │
     │             need = need_series(fc.gap_kw[s],                            │
     │ fc.over_kw[world.sd_dts[s]])[:c.PLAN_HORIZON_SLOTS]                     │
     │             for a, b in find_windows(need, min_kw=threshold):           │
     │                 start, end = fc.start + a * STEP, fc.start + b * STEP   │
     │                 if start - now <                                        │
     │ timedelta(minutes=c.APPROVAL_DEADLINE_MIN):                             │
     │                     continue  # too late for a decision; the status quo │
     │ applies                                                                 │
     │                 if self._overlapping(sd_id, start, end, FROZEN):        │
     │                     continue  # an approved plan already covers this    │
     │ period                                                                  │
     │                 existing = self._overlapping(sd_id, start, end,         │
     │ ("pending",))                                                           │
     │                 pid = existing.id if existing else self._new_id(sd_id,  │
     │ start)                                                                  │
     │                 plan = self._build(pid, s, a, b, fc, now,               │
     │ PlanOverrides())                                                        │
     │                 if existing:                                            │
     │                     plan.created_at, plan.timeline, plan.episode =      │
     │ existing.created_at, existing.timeline, existing.episode                │
     │                     changed.append(pid)                                 │
     │                 else:                                                   │
     │                     plan.timeline.append(PlanEvent(at=iso(now),         │
     │ type="created", title="Plan proposed",                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ detail=f"{plan.window.slots * c.INTERVAL_MIN} minute window"))          │
     │                     added.append(pid)                                   │
     │                 self.plans[pid] = plan                                  │
     │                 seen.add(pid)                                           │
     │         for plan in list(self.plans.values()):                          │
     │             if plan.status == "pending" and plan.id not in seen:        │
     │                 self.transition(plan, "expired", now, "system", "Plan   │
     │ expired", "Condition cleared")                                          │
     │                 expired.append(plan.id)                                 │
     │         if self.autopilot:                                              │
     │             for pid in [*added, *changed]:                              │
     │                 if self.plans[pid].status == "pending":                 │
     │                     self.approve(pid, AUTOPILOT_ACTOR, "Demo            │
     │ autopilot", now=now)                                                    │
     │         return {"added": added, "changed": changed, "expired": expired} │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _overlapping(self, sd_id: str, start: datetime, end: datetime,  │
     │ statuses: tuple[str, ...]) -> FlexPlan | None:                          │
     │         for p in self.plans.values():                                   │
     │             if p.subdivision_id == sd_id and p.status in statuses:      │
     │                 if parse_iso(p.window.start) < end and start <          │
     │ parse_iso(p.window.end):                                                │
     │                     return p                                            │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _new_id(self, sd_id: str, start: datetime) -> str:              │
     │         base = plan_id_for(sd_id, start)                                │
     │         if base not in self.plans:                                      │
     │             return base                                                 │
     │         episode = self.episodes.get(base, 1) + 1                        │
     │         self.episodes[base] = episode                                   │
     │         return f"{base}_{episode}"                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ building                                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _context(self, s: int, a: int, b: int, fc: ForecastBundle, now: │
     │ datetime, ov: PlanOverrides) -> tuple[op.PlanInputs, WindowContext]:    │
     │         world, cons = self.world, self.world.repo.consumers             │
     │         net = world.repo.network                                        │
     │         idx, ci = world.sd_dts[s], world.sd_cons[s]                     │
     │         Tw = b - a                                                      │
     │         times = [fc.start + k * STEP for k in range(a, b)]              │
     │         exp = np.zeros((len(ci), Tw))                                   │
     │         hub_sched = np.zeros((len(world.hub_dt), Tw))                   │
     │         shift_sched = np.zeros((len(world.shift_fac), Tw))              │
     │         asset_dt = np.zeros((world.D, Tw))                              │
     │         by_date: dict = {}                                              │
     │         for k, t in enumerate(times):                                   │
     │             d = world.days.ist_date(t)                                  │
     │             if d not in by_date:                                        │
     │                 by_date[d] = world.days.expected(d, now)                │
     │             e, assets = by_date[d]                                      │
     │             sl = ist_slot(t)                                            │
     │             exp[:, k] = e[ci, sl]                                       │
     │             hub_sched[:, k], shift_sched[:, k], asset_dt[:, k] =        │
     │ assets.hub_kw[:, sl], assets.shift_kw[:, sl], assets.dt_kw[:, sl]       │
     │         local_dt = np.searchsorted(idx, cons.dt_index[ci])              │
     │         natural = fc.plan_net_kw[idx, a:b]                              │
     │         target = np.maximum(0.0, natural + fc.pv_kw[idx, a:b] -         │
     │ asset_dt[idx])                                                          │
     │         cons_sum = np.zeros((len(idx), Tw))                             │
     │         np.add.at(cons_sum, local_dt, exp)                              │
     │         exp = exp * (target / np.maximum(cons_sum, 1e-9))[local_dt]     │
     │         exempt, tier, flex = cons.life_support[ci], cons.tier[ci],      │
     │ cons.flex_share[ci]                                                     │
     │         rate = (self.dr_model.consumer_rate(cons.arch[ci]) *            │
     │ ov.dr_response_scale) if ov.use_dr else np.zeros(len(ci))               │
     │         rate = np.clip(rate, 0.0, 0.95)                                 │
     │         dr_dt = np.zeros((len(idx), Tw))                                │
     │         cap_red = np.zeros((len(idx), len(c.CAP_LEVELS), Tw))           │
     │         cap_hh = np.zeros((len(idx), len(c.CAP_LEVELS)))                │
     │         exp_after = exp * (1.0 - flex * rate * c.DR_FLEX_REALISED *     │
     │ ~exempt)[:, None]                                                       │
     │         for j in range(len(idx)):                                       │
     │             m = local_dt == j                                           │
     │             dr_dt[j] = dr_expected_kw(exp[m], flex[m], rate[m],         │
     │ exempt[m])                                                              │
     │             for lvl in range(1, len(c.CAP_LEVELS)):                     │
     │                 cap_red[j, lvl], cap_hh[j, lvl] =                       │
     │ cap_reduction(exp_after[m], tier[m], exempt[m], lvl)                    │
     │         load = natural - dr_dt                                          │
     │         avail = fc.avail_kw[s, a:b]                                     │
     │         gap = np.maximum(0.0, load.sum(axis=0) * (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC) - │
     │ avail) / (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC)                                           │
     │         pos = {int(d): j for j, d in enumerate(idx)}                    │
     │         end = times[-1] + STEP                                          │
     │         after_slots = ((24 - ist_slot(end)) % c.SLOTS_PER_DAY) or       │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY  # until 06:00 IST                                      │
     │         hubs, hub_idx = [], []                                          │
     │         if ov.use_charging:                                             │
     │             for h in np.flatnonzero(world.hub_sd == s):                 │
     │                 after = np.array([self._hub_kw(int(h), end + k * STEP,  │
     │ now, by_date) for k in range(after_slots)])                             │
     │                 hubs.append(op.HubInput(net.charger_hubs[h].id,         │
     │ pos[int(world.hub_dt[h])], hub_sched[h],                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ hub_recover_kwh(float(world.hub_max[h]), after)))                       │
     │                 hub_idx.append(int(h))                                  │
     │         stores, store_idx = [], []                                      │
     │         if ov.use_storage:                                              │
     │             for k in np.flatnonzero(world.store_sd == s):               │
     │                 unit = net.storage_units[k]                             │
     │                 usable = storage_usable_kwh(unit.energy_kwh,            │
     │ float(world.solution.soc[k]), unit.soc_min)                             │
     │                 stores.append(op.StoreInput(unit.id,                    │
     │ pos[int(world.store_dt[k])], unit.power_kw, usable, unit.eff))          │
     │                 store_idx.append(int(k))                                │
     │         shifts, shift_idx = [], []                                      │
     │         if ov.use_shifts:                                               │
     │             for r in np.flatnonzero(world.shift_sd == s):               │
     │                 sh = net.shiftable_loads[r]                             │
     │                 shifts.append(op.ShiftInput(sh.id,                      │
     │ pos[int(world.shift_dt[r])], shift_reduction(shift_sched[r],            │
     │ sh.max_shift_slots)))                                                   │
     │                 shift_idx.append(int(r))                                │
     │         tr = world.solution                                             │
     │         burden = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=tr.burden_kwh,      │
     │ minlength=world.D)[idx]                                                 │
     │         entitled = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=tr.entitled_kwh,  │
     │ minlength=world.D)[idx]                                                 │
     │         allowed = np.ones((len(idx), len(c.CAP_LEVELS)), dtype=bool)    │
     │         allowed[:, max(0, min(3, ov.max_level)) + 1:] = False           │
     │         for dt_id in ov.protect_dt_ids:                                 │
     │             if dt_id in world.repo.dt_ids and                           │
     │ world.repo.dt_index(dt_id) in pos:                                      │
     │                 allowed[pos[world.repo.dt_index(dt_id)], 1:] = False    │
     │         if (times[0] - now).total_seconds() / 60 < c.NOTICE_MIN_CAPS:   │
     │             allowed[:, 1:] = False  # caps are illegal without notice   │
     │         inp = op.PlanInputs(dt_ids=[world.repo.dt_ids[i] for i in idx], │
     │ gap_kw=gap, load_kw=load,                                               │
     │                             limit_kw=fc.limit_kw[idx, a:b],             │
     │ cap_red_kw=cap_red, cap_households=cap_hh,                              │
     │                             fair_w=fairness_weights(burden /            │
     │ np.maximum(entitled, 1e-9)), hubs=hubs, stores=stores,                  │
     │                             shifts=shifts, level_allowed=allowed)       │
     │         return inp, WindowContext(s, a, b, idx, ci, local_dt,           │
     │ exp_after, natural, dr_dt, rate, avail, hub_idx, store_idx, shift_idx)  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _hub_kw(self, h: int, t: datetime, now: datetime, cache: dict)  │
     │ -> float:                                                               │
     │         d = self.world.days.ist_date(t)                                 │
     │         if d not in cache:                                              │
     │             cache[d] = self.world.days.expected(d, now)                 │
     │         return float(cache[d][1].hub_kw[h, ist_slot(t)])                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @staticmethod                                                       │
     │     def _relief_dt(inp: op.PlanInputs, sol: op.PlanSolution) ->         │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │         r = np.stack([inp.cap_red_kw[d, sol.levels[d]] for d in         │
     │ range(len(inp.dt_ids))])                                                │
     │         for h, hub in enumerate(inp.hubs):                              │
     │             r[hub.dt_index] += sol.charger_frac[h] * hub.sched_kw       │
     │         for k, st in enumerate(inp.stores):                             │
     │             r[st.dt_index] += sol.storage_kw[k]                         │
     │         for q, sh in enumerate(inp.shifts):                             │
     │             if sol.shift_on[q]:                                         │
     │                 r[sh.dt_index] += sh.red_kw                             │
     │         return r                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _rotational(self, ctx: WindowContext, load: np.ndarray) ->      │
     │ dict:                                                                   │
     │         """What the status quo would do to this sub-division over the   │
     │ window, given DT loads `load`."""                                       │
     │         world = self.world                                              │
     │         s, idx = ctx.s, ctx.idx                                         │
     │         roster = copy.deepcopy(world.solution.roster)                   │
     │         feeders = world.sd_feeders[s]                                   │
     │         pos = {int(d): j for j, d in enumerate(idx)}                    │
     │         n_cons =                                                        │
     │ np.array([world.repo.network.transformers[i].n_consumers for i in idx]) │
     │         off_slots = np.zeros(len(idx), dtype=int)                       │
     │         hoh = ens = 0.0                                                 │
     │         for k in range(load.shape[1]):                                  │
     │             feeder_kw = {f: max(0.0, float(sum(load[pos[int(i)], k] for │
     │ i in world.feeder_dts[f]))) * (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC)                      │
     │                          for f in feeders}                              │
     │             gap = sum(feeder_kw.values()) - ctx.avail[k]                │
     │             off = roster_step(roster, world.sd_ids[s], feeders,         │
     │ feeder_kw, gap if gap > world.tolerance[s] else 0.0,                    │
     │                               world.abs_slot + ctx.a + k)               │
     │             for f in off:                                               │
     │                 for i in world.feeder_dts[f]:                           │
     │                     j = pos[int(i)]                                     │
     │                     off_slots[j] += 1                                   │
     │                     hoh += float(n_cons[j]) * c.DT_H                    │
     │                     ens += max(0.0, float(load[j, k])) * c.DT_H         │
     │         critical = sum(1 for fi in world.sd_fac[s]                      │
     │                        if off_slots[pos[int(world.fac_dt[fi])]] *       │
     │ c.INTERVAL_MIN > world.fac_backup[fi])                                  │
     │         return {"blackout": int(n_cons[off_slots > 0].sum()), "hoh":    │
     │ hoh, "ens": ens, "critical": critical,                                  │
     │                 "fairness": jain(1.0 - off_slots / max(1,               │
     │ load.shape[1])), "off_slots": off_slots}                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _build(self, pid: str, s: int, a: int, b: int, fc:              │
     │ ForecastBundle, now: datetime, ov: PlanOverrides) -> FlexPlan:          │
     │         world, cons = self.world, self.world.repo.consumers             │
     │         net = world.repo.network                                        │
     │         sd = net.subdivisions[s]                                        │
     │         inp, ctx = self._context(s, a, b, fc, now, ov)                  │
     │         sol = op.solve(inp)                                             │
     │         Tw = b - a                                                      │
     │         start, end = fc.start + a * STEP, fc.start + b * STEP           │
     │         relief = self._relief_dt(inp, sol)                              │
     │         post = inp.load_kw - relief                                     │
     │         entitled = np.maximum(ctx.natural_dt.sum(axis=1), 1e-9)         │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # levers                                                        │
     │         cap_series = np.stack([inp.cap_red_kw[d, sol.levels[d]] for d   │
     │ in range(len(ctx.idx))]).sum(axis=0)                                    │
     │         chg_series = sum((sol.charger_frac[h] * hub.sched_kw for h, hub │
     │ in enumerate(inp.hubs)), np.zeros(Tw))                                  │
     │         shift_series = sum((sh.red_kw for q, sh in                      │
     │ enumerate(inp.shifts) if sol.shift_on[q]), np.zeros(Tw))                │
     │         series = {"dr": ctx.dr_dt.sum(axis=0), "charging": chg_series,  │
     │ "shift": shift_series,                                                  │
     │                   "storage": sol.storage_kw.sum(axis=0) if              │
     │ len(inp.stores) else np.zeros(Tw),                                      │
     │                   "lifeline": cap_series, "residual": sol.unserved_kw}  │
     │         total = sum(float(v.sum()) for v in series.values()) or 1.0     │
     │         levers = [LeverSummary(lever=k, energy_kwh=round(float(v.sum()) │
     │ * c.DT_H, 2), peak_kw=round(float(v.max()), 2),                         │
     │                                share_pct=round(100 * float(v.sum()) /   │
     │ total, 1)) for k, v in series.items()]                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │         # options                                                       │
     │         rot = self._rotational(ctx, ctx.natural_dt)                     │
     │         lo_inp = op.PlanInputs(inp.dt_ids, np.maximum(0.0,              │
     │ ctx.natural_dt.sum(axis=0) * (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC) - ctx.avail) / (1 +   │
     │ c.HT_LOSS_FRAC),                                                        │
     │                                ctx.natural_dt, inp.limit_kw,            │
     │ inp.cap_red_kw, inp.cap_households, inp.fair_w,                         │
     │                                level_allowed=inp.level_allowed)         │
     │         lo = op.solve_greedy(lo_inp)                                    │
     │         lo_post = ctx.natural_dt - self._relief_dt(lo_inp, lo)          │
     │         zero = {"blackout": 0, "hoh": 0.0, "ens": 0.0, "critical": 0}   │
     │         lo_res = self._rotational(ctx, lo_post) if lo.unserved_kw.sum() │
     │ * c.DT_H > 1e-6 else zero                                               │
     │         fp_res = self._rotational(ctx, post) if sol.unserved_kw.sum() * │
     │ c.DT_H > 1e-6 else zero                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │         def capped(levels: list[int]) -> int:                           │
     │             return int(sum(inp.cap_households[d, levels[d]] for d in    │
     │ range(len(ctx.idx))))                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │         def plan_fairness(rel: np.ndarray, dr: np.ndarray) -> float:    │
     │             return round(jain(1.0 - (rel.sum(axis=1) + dr.sum(axis=1))  │
     │ / entitled), 3)                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │         def overload_slots(load: np.ndarray) -> int:                    │
     │             return int((load > inp.limit_kw + 1e-6).sum())              │
     │                                                                         │
     │         options = [                                                     │
     │             PlanOption(key="rotational", label="Rotational feeder       │
     │ shedding (status quo)", households_blackout=rot["blackout"],            │
     │                        hoh=round(rot["hoh"], 1),                        │
     │ ens_kwh=round(rot["ens"], 1), households_capped=0,                      │
     │                        critical_interrupted=rot["critical"],            │
     │ fairness=round(rot["fairness"], 3), chosen=False,                       │
     │                        checks={"no_blackout": rot["blackout"] == 0,     │
     │ "critical_protected": rot["critical"] == 0,                             │
     │                                "floor_respected": rot["blackout"] == 0, │
     │ "dt_safe": overload_slots(ctx.natural_dt) == 0}),                       │
     │             PlanOption(key="lifeline_only", label="Lifeline caps only", │
     │ households_blackout=lo_res["blackout"],                                 │
     │                        hoh=round(lo_res["hoh"], 1),                     │
     │ ens_kwh=round(lo_res["ens"], 1), households_capped=capped(lo.levels),   │
     │                        critical_interrupted=lo_res["critical"],         │

     │     def transition(self, plan: FlexPlan, status: str, now: datetime,    │
     │ actor: str, title: str, detail: str = "") -> None:                      │
     │         if status not in LEGAL_TRANSITIONS[plan.status]:                │
     │             raise InvalidTransitionError(f"Plan {plan.id} is            │
     │ {plan.status}; it cannot become {status}")                              │
     │         plan.status = status                                            │
     │         plan.timeline.append(PlanEvent(at=iso(now), type=status,        │
     │ title=title, detail=detail, actor=actor))                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _rebuild(self, plan: FlexPlan, ov: PlanOverrides, now:          │
     │ datetime) -> FlexPlan:                                                  │
     │         fc = self.forecast or build_forecast(self.world,                │
     │ self.forecaster, self.static, now)                                      │
     │         s = self.world.sd_ids.index(plan.subdivision_id)                │
     │         a = max(0, int(round((parse_iso(plan.window.start) - fc.start)  │
     │ / STEP)))                                                               │
     │         b = min(fc.horizon, max(a + 1,                                  │
     │ int(round((parse_iso(plan.window.end) - fc.start) / STEP))))            │
     │         fresh = self._build(plan.id, s, a, b, fc, now, ov)              │
     │         fresh.created_at, fresh.timeline, fresh.episode =               │
     │ plan.created_at, list(plan.timeline), plan.episode                      │
     │         return fresh                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def approve(self, plan_id: str, actor: str, note: str | None =      │
     │ None, overrides: PlanOverrides | None = None,                           │
     │                 now: datetime | None = None) -> FlexPlan:               │
     │         now = now or self.world.now                                     │
     │         plan = self.get(plan_id)                                        │
     │         if plan.status != "pending":                                    │
     │             raise InvalidTransitionError(f"Plan {plan.id} is            │
     │ {plan.status}; only a pending plan can be approved")                    │
     │         late = (parse_iso(plan.window.start) - now).total_seconds() /   │
     │ 60 < c.NOTICE_MIN_CAPS                                                  │
     │         if overrides is not None or (late and any(a.cap_level > 0 for a │
     │ in plan.dt_actions)):                                                   │
     │             rebuilt = self._rebuild(plan, overrides or PlanOverrides(), │
     │ now)                                                                    │
     │             rebuilt.modified = True                                     │
     │             if late:                                                    │
     │                 rebuilt.timeline.append(PlanEvent(at=iso(now),          │
     │ type="caps_removed", title="Caps removed",                              │
     │                                                   detail=f"Less than    │
     │ {c.NOTICE_MIN_CAPS} minutes of notice", actor="system"))                │
     │             self.plans[plan_id] = plan = rebuilt                        │
     │         self.transition(plan, "approved", now, actor, "Plan approved",  │
     │ note or "")                                                             │
     │         plan.resolved_at, plan.resolved_by, plan.resolution_note =      │
     │ iso(now), actor, note                                                   │
     │         if self.on_approved:                                            │
     │             self.on_approved(plan, now)                                 │
     │         return plan                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def reject(self, plan_id: str, actor: str, note: str | None = None, │
     │ now: datetime | None = None) -> FlexPlan:                               │
     │         now = now or self.world.now                                     │
     │         plan = self.get(plan_id)                                        │
     │         self.transition(plan, "rejected", now, actor, "Plan rejected",  │
     │ note or "")                                                             │
     │         plan.resolved_at, plan.resolved_by, plan.resolution_note =      │
     │ iso(now), actor, note                                                   │
     │         return plan                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def cancel(self, plan_id: str, actor: str, reason: str, now:        │
     │ datetime | None = None) -> FlexPlan:                                    │
     │         now = now or self.world.now                                     │
     │         plan = self.get(plan_id)                                        │
     │         self.transition(plan, "cancelled", now, actor, "Plan            │
     │ cancelled", reason)                                                     │
     │         if self.on_cancelled:                                           │
     │             self.on_cancelled(plan, now)                                │
     │         return plan                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def simulate(self, plan_id: str, overrides: PlanOverrides) ->       │
     │ FlexPlan:                                                               │
     │         return self._rebuild(self.get(plan_id), overrides,              │
     │ self.world.now)                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def sensitivity(self, plan_id: str) -> dict:                        │
     │         plan = self.get(plan_id)                                        │
     │         fc = self.forecast or build_forecast(self.world,                │
     │ self.forecaster, self.static, self.world.now)                           │
     │         s = self.world.sd_ids.index(plan.subdivision_id)                │
     │         a = max(0, int(round((parse_iso(plan.window.start) - fc.start)  │
     │ / STEP)))                                                               │
     │         b = min(fc.horizon, max(a + 1,                                  │
     │ int(round((parse_iso(plan.window.end) - fc.start) / STEP))))            │
     │         cells = []                                                      │
     │         for level in range(4):                                          │
     │             row = []                                                    │
     │             for scale in DR_SCALES:                                     │
     │                 inp, ctx = self._context(s, a, b, fc, self.world.now,   │
     │ PlanOverrides(max_level=level, dr_response_scale=scale))                │
     │                 sol = op.solve_greedy(inp)                              │
     │                 residual = float(sol.unserved_kw.sum() * c.DT_H)        │
     │                 blackout = self._rotational(ctx, inp.load_kw -          │
     │ self._relief_dt(inp, sol))["blackout"] if residual > 1e-6 else 0        │
     │                 row.append({"residual_kwh": round(residual, 1),         │
     │ "households_blackout": blackout,                                        │
     │                             "households_capped":                        │
     │ int(sum(inp.cap_households[d, sol.levels[d]] for d in                   │
     │ range(len(ctx.idx))))})                                                 │
     │             cells.append(row)                                           │
     │         return {"plan_id": plan_id, "rows": [lv.name for lv in          │
     │ c.CAP_LEVELS], "cols": list(DR_SCALES), "cells": cells,                 │
     │                 "base": [int(plan.overrides.get("max_level", 3)),       │
     │ DR_SCALES.index(1.0)]}                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def consumer_caps(self, plan: FlexPlan) -> tuple[np.ndarray,        │
     │ np.ndarray]:                                                            │
     │         world, cons = self.world, self.world.repo.consumers             │
     │         ci = world.sd_cons[world.sd_ids.index(plan.subdivision_id)]     │
     │         level_of_dt = np.zeros(world.D, dtype=int)                      │
     │         for a in plan.dt_actions:                                       │
     │             level_of_dt[world.repo.dt_index(a.dt_id)] = a.cap_level     │
     │         levels = level_of_dt[cons.dt_index[ci]]                         │
     │         caps = np.where(cons.tier[ci] == 1, T1_KW[levels],              │
     │ T2_KW[levels])                                                          │
     │         caps[cons.life_support[ci]] = np.inf                            │
     │         return ci, caps                                                 │

     │ Standards notes (put these in docs/05-integrations.md verbatim).        │
     │ - DLMS/COSEM: the Limiter interface class is class_id 71, logical name  │
     │ 0.0.17.0.0.255. A time-limited cap is written as threshold_emergency    │
     │ (attribute 5) plus an emergency_profile (attribute 8: profile id,       │
     │ activation time, duration). The meter reverts to threshold_normal on    │
     │ its own when the duration ends, which is the fail-safe this product     │
     │ relies on. Disconnect control is class_id 70, 0.0.96.3.10.255. Verify   │
     │ attribute numbering against the DLMS Blue Book and the IS 15959 Part 2  │
     │ companion profile before a pilot.                                       │
     │ - OCPP 1.6J: SetChargingProfile with chargingProfilePurpose =           │
     │ ChargePointMaxProfile on connectorId 0 limits a whole charge point.     │
     │ - OpenADR 3: REST resources programs, events, reports, vens. Event      │
     │ payload types used here: IMPORT_CAPACITY_LIMIT (kW) and                 │
     │ DISPATCH_SETPOINT (kW). Verify enumerations against the OpenADR 3       │
     │ definition before certification.                                        │
     │ - Beckn: the envelope is {context, message}; the energy domain string   │
     │ and item schema must be checked against the Digital Energy Grid         │
     │ specification before joining a live network. The DERC-approved pilot    │
     │ transaction charge of Rs 0.42 per kWh is included.                      │
     │ - [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests backend/tests/test_adapters.py    │
