     │ """A bounded, in-memory log of every protocol message LifelineGrid      │
     │ sends or receives."""                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from collections import Counter, deque                                  │
     │ from datetime import datetime                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ PROTOCOLS = ("dlms_hes", "ocpp", "openadr", "beckn", "whatsapp", "ivr", │
     │ "sms")                                                                  │
     │ PROTOCOL_STATUS = {p: "WIRED" for p in PROTOCOLS}                       │
     │ PROTOCOL_LABEL = {                                                      │
     │     "dlms_hes": "DLMS/COSEM via head-end system", "ocpp": "OCPP 1.6J",  │
     │ "openadr": "OpenADR 3",                                                 │
     │     "beckn": "Beckn / Unified Energy Interface", "whatsapp":            │
     │ "WhatsApp", "ivr": "IVR call", "sms": "SMS",                            │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class ProtocolLedger:                                                   │
     │     def __init__(self, maxlen: int = 600):                              │
     │         self._items: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=maxlen)                 │
     │         self._seq = 0                                                   │
     │         self._counts: Counter = Counter()                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def record(self, at: datetime, protocol: str, direction: str,       │
     │ summary: str, payload: dict,                                            │
     │                status: str = "ok", ref: str | None = None) -> dict:     │
     │         self._seq += 1                                                  │
     │         row = {"id": self._seq, "at": iso(at), "protocol": protocol,    │
     │ "direction": direction, "summary": summary,                             │
     │                "status": status, "ref": ref, "payload": payload}        │
     │         self._items.append(row)                                         │
     │         self._counts[(protocol, direction)] += 1                        │
     │         return row                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def list(self, protocol: str | None = None, ref: str | None = None, │
     │ limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:                                        │
     │         rows = [r for r in reversed(self._items)                        │
     │                 if (protocol is None or r["protocol"] == protocol) and  │
     │ (ref is None or r["ref"] == ref)]                                       │
     │         return rows[:limit]                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def stats(self) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:                       │
     │         return {p: {"out": self._counts[(p, "out")], "in":              │
     │ self._counts[(p, "in")]} for p in PROTOCOLS}                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Write backend/app/adapters/hes.py                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Mock head-end system. Commands are shaped like DLMS/COSEM Limiter    │
     │ writes and behave like a                                                │
     │ real AMI network: most meters acknowledge within a minute, a few need a │
     │ retry, a few never answer."""                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │ from datetime import datetime                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.adapters.ledger import ProtocolLedger                          │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ LIMITER = {"class_id": 71, "logical_name": "0.0.17.0.0.255"}            │
     │ DISCONNECT = {"class_id": 70, "logical_name": "0.0.96.3.10.255"}        │
     │ RETRY_DELAY_S = 120.0                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def limiter_payload(meter_id: str, cap_w: int, valid_from: datetime,    │
     │ duration_s: int, profile_id: int) -> dict:                              │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "meter_id": meter_id, "service": "SET",                         │
     │         "cosem": {**LIMITER, "attributes": {                            │
     │             "threshold_emergency": {"attribute_id": 5, "value_w":       │
     │ int(cap_w)},                                                            │
     │             "emergency_profile": {"attribute_id": 8,                    │
     │ "emergency_profile_id": profile_id,                                     │
     │                                   "emergency_activation_time":          │
     │ iso(valid_from), "emergency_duration_s": int(duration_s)},              │
     │         }},                                                             │
     │         "note": "The meter returns to its normal threshold by itself    │
     │ when the duration ends.",                                               │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class HesBatch:                                                         │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     plan_id: str                                                        │
     │     dt_id: str                                                          │
     │     n: int                                                              │
     │     acked: np.ndarray                                                   │
     │     attempts: np.ndarray                                                │
     │     delay_s: np.ndarray                                                 │
     │     valid_from: datetime                                                │
     │     valid_to: datetime                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @property                                                           │
     │     def success_pct(self) -> float:                                     │
     │         return 100.0 * float(self.acked.mean()) if self.n else 100.0    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class MockHes:                                                          │
     │     def __init__(self, ledger: ProtocolLedger, ack_prob: float =        │
     │ c.HES_ACK_PROB):                                                        │
     │         self.ledger = ledger                                            │
     │         self.ack_prob = ack_prob                                        │
     │         self.batches: list[HesBatch] = []                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def set_load_limits(self, plan_id: str, dt_id: str, meter_ids:      │
     │ list[str], cap_w: np.ndarray, valid_from: datetime,                     │
     │                         valid_to: datetime, now: datetime, rng:         │
     │ np.random.Generator) -> HesBatch:                                       │
     │         n = len(meter_ids)                                              │
     │         first = rng.random(n) < self.ack_prob                           │
     │         second = ~first & (rng.random(n) < self.ack_prob)               │
     │         base = rng.lognormal(3.0, 0.6, n)  # median about 20 seconds    │
     │         batch = HesBatch(id=f"hes_{len(self.batches) + 1:05d}",         │
     │ plan_id=plan_id, dt_id=dt_id, n=n, acked=first | second,                │
     │                          attempts=np.where(first, 1, 2),                │
     │ delay_s=np.where(first, base, base + RETRY_DELAY_S),                    │
     │                          valid_from=valid_from, valid_to=valid_to)      │
     │         self.batches.append(batch)                                      │
     │         duration = int((valid_to - valid_from).total_seconds())         │
     │         profile = int(plan_id[-4:], 16) if all(ch in "0123456789abcdef" │
     │ for ch in plan_id[-4:]) else len(self.batches)                          │
     │         sample = [limiter_payload(meter_ids[i], int(cap_w[i]),          │
     │ valid_from, duration, profile) for i in range(min(3, n))]               │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "dlms_hes", "out", f"Load limit for {n} │
     │ meters on {dt_id}",                                                     │
     │                            {"batch_id": batch.id, "meters": n, "cosem": │
     │ LIMITER, "valid_from": iso(valid_from),                                 │
     │                             "valid_to": iso(valid_to), "sample":        │
     │ sample}, ref=plan_id)                                                   │
     │         retried, failed = int((batch.attempts == 2).sum()),             │
     │ int((~batch.acked).sum())                                               │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "dlms_hes", "in",                       │
     │                            f"{int(batch.acked.sum())} of {n}            │
     │ acknowledged, {retried} after a retry, {failed} unreachable",           │
     │                            {"batch_id": batch.id, "acked":              │
     │ int(batch.acked.sum()), "retried": retried, "failed": failed,           │
     │                             "median_delay_s":                           │
     │ round(float(np.median(batch.delay_s)), 1) if n else 0.0},               │
     │                            status="ok" if failed == 0 else "partial",   │
     │ ref=plan_id)                                                            │
     │         return batch                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 5: Write backend/app/adapters/ocpp.py                        │

     │                                                                         │
     │ from datetime import datetime                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.adapters.ledger import ProtocolLedger                          │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ CALL, CALL_RESULT, CALL_ERROR = 2, 3, 4                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ SET_CHARGING_PROFILE_SCHEMA = {                                         │
     │     "type": "object",                                                   │
     │     "required": ["connectorId", "csChargingProfiles"],                  │
     │     "additionalProperties": False,                                      │
     │     "properties": {                                                     │
     │         "connectorId": {"type": "integer"},                             │
     │         "csChargingProfiles": {                                         │
     │             "type": "object",                                           │
     │             "required": ["chargingProfileId", "stackLevel",             │
     │ "chargingProfilePurpose", "chargingProfileKind", "chargingSchedule"],   │
     │             "additionalProperties": False,                              │
     │             "properties": {                                             │
     │                 "chargingProfileId": {"type": "integer"},               │
     │                 "transactionId": {"type": "integer"},                   │
     │                 "stackLevel": {"type": "integer"},                      │
     │                 "chargingProfilePurpose": {"enum":                      │
     │ ["ChargePointMaxProfile", "TxDefaultProfile", "TxProfile"]},            │
     │                 "chargingProfileKind": {"enum": ["Absolute",            │
     │ "Recurring", "Relative"]},                                              │
     │                 "recurrencyKind": {"enum": ["Daily", "Weekly"]},        │
     │                 "validFrom": {"type": "string"},                        │
     │                 "validTo": {"type": "string"},                          │
     │                 "chargingSchedule": {                                   │
     │                     "type": "object",                                   │
     │                     "required": ["chargingRateUnit",                    │
     │ "chargingSchedulePeriod"],                                              │
     │                     "additionalProperties": False,                      │
     │                     "properties": {                                     │
     │                         "duration": {"type": "integer"},                │
     │                         "startSchedule": {"type": "string"},            │
     │                         "chargingRateUnit": {"enum": ["A", "W"]},       │
     │                         "minChargingRate": {"type": "number"},          │
     │                         "chargingSchedulePeriod": {                     │
     │                             "type": "array", "minItems": 1,             │
     │                             "items": {"type": "object", "required":     │
     │ ["startPeriod", "limit"], "additionalProperties": False,                │
     │                                       "properties": {"startPeriod":     │
     │ {"type": "integer"}, "limit": {"type": "number"},                       │
     │                                                      "numberPhases":    │
     │ {"type": "integer"}}},                                                  │
     │                         },                                              │
     │                     },                                                  │
     │                 },                                                      │
     │             },                                                          │
     │         },                                                              │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def set_charging_profile(profile_id: int, start: datetime, limits_w:    │
     │ list[float], step_s: int = 900) -> dict:                                │
     │     """An absolute charge-point-wide limit. Consecutive equal limits    │
     │ are merged into one period."""                                          │
     │     periods: list[dict] = []                                            │
     │     for k, limit in enumerate(limits_w):                                │
     │         value = round(float(limit), 1)                                  │
     │         if not periods or periods[-1]["limit"] != value:                │
     │             periods.append({"startPeriod": k * step_s, "limit": value}) │
     │     duration = len(limits_w) * step_s                                   │
     │     return {"connectorId": 0, "csChargingProfiles": {                   │
     │         "chargingProfileId": int(profile_id), "stackLevel": 1,          │
     │ "chargingProfilePurpose": "ChargePointMaxProfile",                      │
     │         "chargingProfileKind": "Absolute", "validFrom": iso(start),     │
     │         "chargingSchedule": {"duration": duration, "startSchedule":     │
     │ iso(start), "chargingRateUnit": "W",                                    │
     │                              "chargingSchedulePeriod": periods}}}       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def clear_charging_profile(profile_id: int) -> dict:                    │
     │     return {"id": int(profile_id), "connectorId": 0,                    │
     │ "chargingProfilePurpose": "ChargePointMaxProfile", "stackLevel": 1}     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def call(unique_id: str, action: str, payload: dict) -> list:           │
     │     return [CALL, unique_id, action, payload]                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class InProcChargePoint:                                                │
     │     """Answers the two calls the product makes. A real charge point     │
     │ connects over WebSocket instead."""                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def __init__(self, ocpp_id: str):                                   │
     │         self.ocpp_id = ocpp_id                                          │
     │         self.profiles: dict[int, dict] = {}                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def handle(self, frame: list) -> list:                              │
     │         _, uid, action, payload = frame                                 │
     │         if action == "SetChargingProfile":                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ self.profiles[payload["csChargingProfiles"]["chargingProfileId"]] =     │
     │ payload                                                                 │
     │             return [CALL_RESULT, uid, {"status": "Accepted"}]           │
     │         if action == "ClearChargingProfile":                            │
     │             known = self.profiles.pop(payload.get("id"), None) is not   │
     │ None                                                                    │
     │             return [CALL_RESULT, uid, {"status": "Accepted" if known    │
     │ else "Unknown"}]                                                        │
     │         return [CALL_ERROR, uid, "NotImplemented", f"{action} is not    │
     │ supported", {}]                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OcppGateway:                                                      │
     │     def __init__(self, ledger: ProtocolLedger):                         │
     │         self.ledger = ledger                                            │
     │         self.points: dict[str, InProcChargePoint] = {}                  │
     │         self._seq = 0                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _exchange(self, ocpp_id: str, plan_id: str, action: str,        │
     │ payload: dict, now: datetime, summary: str) -> bool:                    │
     │         self._seq += 1                                                  │
     │         point = self.points.setdefault(ocpp_id,                         │
     │ InProcChargePoint(ocpp_id))                                             │
     │         frame = call(f"lg-{self._seq:06d}", action, payload)            │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "ocpp", "out", f"{action} to {ocpp_id}: │
     │ {summary}", {"frame": frame}, ref=plan_id)                              │
     │         reply = point.handle(frame)                                     │
     │         ok = reply[0] == CALL_RESULT and reply[2].get("status") ==      │
     │ "Accepted"                                                              │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "ocpp", "in", f"{ocpp_id} answered      │
     │ {reply[2].get('status') if reply[0] == CALL_RESULT else reply[2]}",     │
     │                            {"frame": reply}, status="ok" if ok else     │
     │ "rejected", ref=plan_id)                                                │
     │         return ok                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def send_profile(self, ocpp_id: str, plan_id: str, profile_id: int, │
     │ start: datetime, limits_w: list[float], now: datetime) -> bool:         │
     │         payload = set_charging_profile(profile_id, start, limits_w)     │
     │         return self._exchange(ocpp_id, plan_id, "SetChargingProfile",   │
     │ payload, now,                                                           │
     │                               f"limit {min(limits_w):.0f} to            │
     │ {max(limits_w):.0f} W for {len(limits_w) * 15} min")                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def clear(self, ocpp_id: str, plan_id: str, profile_id: int, now:   │
     │ datetime) -> bool:                                                      │
     │         return self._exchange(ocpp_id, plan_id, "ClearChargingProfile", │
     │ clear_charging_profile(profile_id), now, "restore normal charging")     │
     │                                                                         │

     │ """A minimal OpenADR 3 style Virtual Top Node: programs, events,        │
     │ reports and VENs as REST resources.                                     │
     │ Shiftable public loads and storage units are the Virtual End Nodes."""  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from datetime import datetime                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from pydantic import BaseModel, Field                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.adapters.ledger import ProtocolLedger                          │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso                                          │
     │ from app.grid.models import Network                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrPayload(BaseModel):                                           │
     │     type: str                                                           │
     │     values: list[float]                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrInterval(BaseModel):                                          │
     │     id: int                                                             │
     │     payloads: list[OadrPayload]                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrPeriod(BaseModel):                                            │
     │     start: str                                                          │
     │     duration: str = "PT15M"                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrTarget(BaseModel):                                            │
     │     type: str = "VEN_NAME"                                              │
     │     values: list[str]                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrProgram(BaseModel):                                           │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     objectType: str = "PROGRAM"                                         │
     │     programName: str                                                    │
     │     programLongName: str                                                │
     │     retailerName: str = "LifelineGrid operator"                         │
     │     programType: str                                                    │
     │     country: str = "IN"                                                 │
     │     principalSubdivision: str = "UP"                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrEvent(BaseModel):                                             │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     objectType: str = "EVENT"                                           │
     │     programID: str                                                      │
     │     eventName: str                                                      │
     │     priority: int = 1                                                   │
     │     targets: list[OadrTarget]                                           │
     │     intervalPeriod: OadrPeriod                                          │
     │     intervals: list[OadrInterval]                                       │
     │     createdDateTime: str                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OadrReport(BaseModel):                                            │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     objectType: str = "REPORT"                                          │
     │     programID: str                                                      │
     │     eventID: str                                                        │
     │     clientName: str                                                     │
     │     resources: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)                 │
     │     createdDateTime: str                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class OpenAdrVtn:                                                       │
     │     def __init__(self, ledger: ProtocolLedger, network: Network):       │
     │         self.ledger = ledger                                            │
     │         self.programs = {                                               │
     │             "prog-shift": OadrProgram(id="prog-shift",                  │
     │ programName="lifeline-shift",                                           │
     │                                       programLongName="Shift public     │
     │ pumping and telecom load", programType="LOAD_LIMIT"),                   │
     │             "prog-storage": OadrProgram(id="prog-storage",              │
     │ programName="lifeline-storage",                                         │
     │                                         programLongName="Dispatch       │
     │ registered storage", programType="DISPATCH"),                           │
     │         }                                                               │
     │         self.vens: dict[str, dict] = {}                                 │
     │         for s in network.shiftable_loads:                               │
     │             self.vens[s.id] = {"id": s.id, "objectType": "VEN",         │
     │ "venName": s.id, "resource": s.name, "kind": s.kind}                    │
     │         for u in network.storage_units:                                 │
     │             self.vens[u.id] = {"id": u.id, "objectType": "VEN",         │
     │ "venName": u.id, "resource": u.name, "kind": u.kind}                    │
     │         self.events: dict[str, OadrEvent] = {}                          │
     │         self.reports: list[OadrReport] = []                             │
     │         self._plan_of_event: dict[str, str] = {}                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _publish(self, plan_id: str, program: str, ven: str,            │
     │ payload_type: str, start: datetime, kw: list[float],                    │
     │                  now: datetime, name: str) -> OadrEvent:                │
     │         event = OadrEvent(                                              │
     │             id=f"evt-{len(self.events) + 1:05d}", programID=program,    │
     │ eventName=name, targets=[OadrTarget(values=[ven])],                     │
     │             intervalPeriod=OadrPeriod(start=iso(start)),                │
     │             intervals=[OadrInterval(id=k,                               │
     │ payloads=[OadrPayload(type=payload_type, values=[round(float(v), 2)])]) │
     │                        for k, v in enumerate(kw)],                      │
     │             createdDateTime=iso(now))                                   │
     │         self.events[event.id] = event                                   │
     │         self._plan_of_event[event.id] = plan_id                         │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "openadr", "out", f"Event {event.id} to │
     │ {ven}: {payload_type} for {len(kw) * 15} min",                          │
     │                            event.model_dump(), ref=plan_id)             │
     │         return event                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def publish_limit(self, plan_id: str, ven_name: str, start:         │
     │ datetime, kw: list[float], now: datetime) -> OadrEvent:                 │
     │         return self._publish(plan_id, "prog-shift", ven_name,           │
     │ "IMPORT_CAPACITY_LIMIT", start, kw, now, "Hold load during deficit")    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def publish_dispatch(self, plan_id: str, ven_name: str, start:      │
     │ datetime, kw: list[float], now: datetime) -> OadrEvent:                 │
     │         return self._publish(plan_id, "prog-storage", ven_name,         │
     │ "DISPATCH_SETPOINT", start, kw, now, "Discharge during deficit")        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def add_report(self, event_id: str, ven_name: str, values:          │
     │ list[float], now: datetime) -> OadrReport:                              │
     │         event = self.events[event_id]                                   │
     │         report = OadrReport(                                            │
     │             id=f"rep-{len(self.reports) + 1:05d}",                      │
     │ programID=event.programID, eventID=event_id, clientName=ven_name,       │
     │             resources=[{"resourceName": ven_name,                       │
     │                         "intervals": [{"id": k, "payloads": [{"type":   │
     │ "USAGE", "values": [round(float(v), 2)]}]}                              │
     │                                       for k, v in enumerate(values)]}], │
     │             createdDateTime=iso(now))                                   │
     │         self.reports.append(report)                                     │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "openadr", "in", f"Report {report.id}   │
     │ from {ven_name} for {event_id}", report.model_dump(),                   │
     │                            ref=self._plan_of_event.get(event_id))       │
     │         return report                                                   │

     │ """Beckn-shaped peer-to-peer energy trade messages. Used when           │
     │ consenting prosumer batteries                                           │
     │ discharge into their own neighbourhood during a deficit."""             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import uuid                                                             │
     │ from datetime import datetime                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.adapters.ledger import ProtocolLedger                          │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ DOMAIN = "energy:p2p-trading"  # check against the Digital Energy Grid  │
     │ specification before going live                                         │
     │ BAP_ID, BPP_ID = "lifelinegrid.bap", "lifelinegrid.bpp"                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class BecknGateway:                                                     │
     │     def __init__(self, ledger: ProtocolLedger):                         │
     │         self.ledger = ledger                                            │
     │         self.trades: list[dict] = []                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def confirm_trade(self, plan_id: str, seller_id: str, buyer_id:     │
     │ str, kwh: float, start: datetime, end: datetime,                        │
     │                       now: datetime, price_rs_per_kwh: float = 5.5) ->  │
     │ dict:                                                                   │
     │         energy_cost = round(kwh * price_rs_per_kwh, 2)                  │
     │         charge = kwh * c.P2P_CHARGE_RS_PER_KWH                          │
     │         message = {                                                     │
     │             "context": {"domain": DOMAIN, "action": "confirm",          │
     │ "version": "1.1.0", "bap_id": BAP_ID, "bpp_id": BPP_ID,                 │
     │                         "transaction_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),            │
     │ "message_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "timestamp": iso(now),                 │
     │                         "location": {"country": {"code": "IND"},        │
     │ "city": {"code": "std:0581"}}},                                         │
     │             "message": {"order": {                                      │
     │                 "provider": {"id": seller_id},                          │
     │                 "items": [{"id": "energy-kwh", "quantity": {"selected": │
     │ {"measure": {"value": round(kwh, 2), "unit": "kWh"}}}}],                │
     │                 "fulfillments": [{"type": "ENERGY_DELIVERY", "stops": [ │
     │                     {"type": "start", "time": {"timestamp":             │
     │ iso(start)}, "location": {"descriptor": {"code": seller_id}}},          │
     │                     {"type": "end", "time": {"timestamp": iso(end)},    │
     │ "location": {"descriptor": {"code": buyer_id}}}]}],                     │
     │                 "quote": {"price": {"currency": "INR", "value":         │
     │ round(energy_cost + charge, 2)}, "breakup": [                           │
     │                     {"title": "Energy", "price": {"currency": "INR",    │
     │ "value": energy_cost}},                                                 │
     │                     {"title": "Platform transaction charge", "price":   │
     │ {"currency": "INR", "value": charge}}]},                                │
     │             }},                                                         │
     │         }                                                               │
     │         self.trades.append({"plan_id": plan_id, "seller_id": seller_id, │
     │ "buyer_id": buyer_id, "kwh": round(kwh, 2),                             │
     │                             "at": iso(now), "value_rs":                 │
     │ round(energy_cost + charge, 2)})                                        │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, "beckn", "out", f"confirm: {kwh:.1f}    │
     │ kWh from {seller_id} to {buyer_id}", message, ref=plan_id)              │
     │         return message                                                  │

     │ - [ ] Step 8: Write backend/app/adapters/channels.py                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Consumer channels: WhatsApp, IVR and SMS. The transport is a mock    │
     │ that keeps a bounded sample of                                          │
     │ rendered messages; counts cover everyone. IVR text is turned into       │
     │ speech on demand by the API layer."""                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from collections import Counter, deque                                  │
     │ from datetime import datetime                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.adapters.ledger import ProtocolLedger                          │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ CHANNEL_NAMES = ("whatsapp", "ivr", "sms")                              │
     │ LANGUAGES = ("hi", "en")                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ TEMPLATES: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {                                │
     │     "lifeline_notice": {                                                │
     │         "hi": "LifelineGrid सूचना: आज {start} से {end} बजे तक बिजली की कमी रहेगी। │
     │ आपके घर की बिजली नहीं कटेगी। "                                                  │
     │               "पंखा, लाइट और फोन चार्जिंग चलती रहेगी ({watts} वॉट तक)। इस समय AC,   │
     │ गीज़र और मोटर न चलाएँ।",                                                     │
     │         "en": "LifelineGrid notice: supply is short today from {start}  │
     │ to {end}. Your power will not be cut. "                                 │
     │               "Fans, lights and phone charging keep running (up to      │
     │ {watts} W). Please avoid AC, geyser and motor in this period.",         │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     "dr_ask": {                                                         │
     │         "hi": "आज {start} से {end} बजे के बीच भारी उपकरण बंद रखें और ₹{rebate}   │
     │ प्रति यूनिट की छूट अपने बिल में पाएँ। "                                             │
     │               "शामिल होने के लिए 1 भेजें।",                                      │
     │         "en": "Keep heavy appliances off between {start} and {end}      │
     │ today and earn a bill rebate of Rs {rebate} per unit. "                 │
     │               "Reply 1 to take part.",                                  │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     "protected": {                                                      │
     │         "hi": "आपका घर सुरक्षित सूची में है। आज {start} से {end} बजे तक आप पर कोई   │
     │ सीमा लागू नहीं होगी।",                                                          │
     │         "en": "Your home is on the protected list. No limit applies to  │
     │ you from {start} to {end} today.",                                      │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     "restored": {                                                       │
     │         "hi": "बिजली सामान्य हो गई है। सहयोग के लिए धन्यवाद। आपकी छूट: ₹{amount}।",   │
     │         "en": "Supply is back to normal. Thank you. Your rebate: Rs     │
     │ {amount}.",                                                             │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     "power_weather": {                                                  │
     │         "hi": "कल का बिजली मौसम: {summary}",                                │
     │         "en": "Tomorrow's power weather: {summary}",                    │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def render(template: str, language: str, **kw) -> str:                  │
     │     return TEMPLATES[template].get(language,                            │
     │ TEMPLATES[template]["hi"]).format(**kw)                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class ChannelGateway:                                                   │
     │     def __init__(self, ledger: ProtocolLedger, sample: int = 40):       │
     │         self.ledger = ledger                                            │
     │         self.sample = sample                                            │
     │         self._outbox: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=2000)                  │
     │         self._seq = 0                                                   │
     │         self.counts: Counter = Counter()                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _store(self, consumer_id: str, channel: int, language: int,     │
     │ template: str, now: datetime, plan_id: str | None, kw: dict) -> dict:   │
     │         self._seq += 1                                                  │
     │         row = {"id": self._seq, "at": iso(now), "consumer_id":          │
     │ consumer_id, "channel": CHANNEL_NAMES[channel],                         │
     │                "language": LANGUAGES[language], "template": template,   │
     │ "text": render(template, LANGUAGES[language], **kw),                    │
     │                "status": "delivered", "plan_id": plan_id, "reply":      │
     │ None}                                                                   │
     │         self._outbox.append(row)                                        │
     │         return row                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def broadcast(self, plan_id: str, template: str, consumer_ids:      │
     │ list[str], channel: np.ndarray, language: np.ndarray,                   │
     │                   now: datetime, **kw) -> dict[str, int]:               │
     │         channel = np.asarray(channel, dtype=int)                        │
     │         counts = {name: int((channel == k).sum()) for k, name in        │
     │ enumerate(CHANNEL_NAMES)}                                               │
     │         per_channel = -(-self.sample // len(CHANNEL_NAMES))  # ceiling, │
     │ so the sample can fill up                                               │
     │         kept = 0                                                        │
     │         for k in range(len(CHANNEL_NAMES)):                             │
     │             for i in np.flatnonzero(channel == k)[:per_channel]:        │
     │                 if kept < self.sample:                                  │
     │                     self._store(consumer_ids[i], k, int(language[i]),   │
     │ template, now, plan_id, kw)                                             │
     │                     kept += 1                                           │
     │         for name, n in counts.items():                                  │
     │             if n:                                                       │
     │                 self.counts[name] += n                                  │
     │                 self.ledger.record(now, name, "out", f"{template} to    │
     │ {n} consumers", {"template": template, "count": n,                      │
     │                                    "example": render(template, "hi",    │
     │ **kw)}, ref=plan_id)                                                    │
     │         return counts                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def send_one(self, consumer_id: str, channel: int, language: int,   │
     │ template: str, now: datetime,                                           │
     │                  plan_id: str | None = None, **kw) -> dict:             │
     │         row = self._store(consumer_id, channel, language, template,     │
     │ now, plan_id, kw)                                                       │
     │         self.counts[row["channel"]] += 1                                │
     │         self.ledger.record(now, row["channel"], "out", f"{template} to  │
     │ {consumer_id}", {"text": row["text"]}, ref=plan_id)                     │
     │         return row                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def reply(self, message_id: int, text: str, now: datetime) -> dict: │
     │         for row in self._outbox:                                        │
     │             if row["id"] == message_id:                                 │
     │                 row["status"], row["reply"] = "replied", text           │
     │                 self.ledger.record(now, row["channel"], "in", f"reply   │
     │ from {row['consumer_id']}: {text}", {"text": text}, ref=row["plan_id"]) │
     │                 return row                                              │
     │         raise KeyError(message_id)                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def messages(self, plan_id: str | None = None, consumer_id: str |   │
     │ None = None, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:                           │
     │         rows = [r for r in reversed(self._outbox)                       │
     │                 if (plan_id is None or r["plan_id"] == plan_id) and     │
     │ (consumer_id is None or r["consumer_id"] == consumer_id)]               │
     │         return rows[:limit]                                             │

     │                                                                         │

     │ - Consumes: GridWorld, FlexPlanService (sets its on_approved and        │
     │ on_cancelled hooks), the six adapters, DrModel.                         │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - STEPS = ("notify", "signal", "hes", "start", "end", "verify")       │
     │   - Run dataclass (one per approved plan): plan_id, sd, start, end,     │
     │ due, ci, caps, acked, dr_accept, hub, store, shift, planned_kwh, done,  │
     │ realised_kwh, hoh_actual, hoh_baseline, trips, complaints, rebate_kwh,  │
     │ commanded, invited, accepted, notices                                   │
     │   - Dispatcher(world, planner, hes, ocpp, openadr, beckn, channels,     │
     │ dr_model, seed) with                                                    │
     │       - .runs: dict[str, Run], .completed: list[dict] (summaries of     │
     │ verified plans)                                                         │
     │     - step(now) -> list[dict] fires every due step in order and returns │
     │ stream events {"type": "plan", "at", "plan_id", "subdivision_id",       │
     │ "step", "status", "title"}                                              │
     │     - actions(at) -> Actions for the interval starting at at            │
     │     - observe(sol: IntervalResult, base: IntervalResult) -> None        │
     │ accumulates verification data                                           │
     │     - add_complaint(consumer_position: int) -> None                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ The contract with the service loop (Task B5). At every interval         │
     │ boundary t, in this order: dispatcher.step(t), then                     │
     │ world.advance(dispatcher.actions(t)), then dispatcher.observe(sol,      │
     │ base).                                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Timeline of one approved plan.                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ┌────────┬──────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┐                                                                    │
     │ │  Step  │       When       │                    What                   │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ ├────────┼──────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┤                                                                    │
     │ │        │ max(approval     │ Lifeline notice to capped consumers,      │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │ notify │ time, start −    │ "protected" notice to life-support homes, │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │        │ 120 min)         │ DR ask to everyone else; replies drawn;   │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │        │                  │ DrModel learns; plan → scheduled          │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ ├────────┼──────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┤                                                                    │
     │ │        │                  │ OCPP SetChargingProfile per hub; OpenADR  │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │ signal │ start − 30 min   │ events for shiftable loads and storage;   │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │        │                  │ Beckn confirm for prosumer batteries      │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ ├────────┼──────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┤                                                                    │
     │ │        │                  │ One HES batch per capped DT, each command │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │ hes    │ start − 15 min   │ with valid_to = end; acknowledgements     │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │        │                  │ recorded                                  │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ ├────────┼──────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┤                                                                    │
     │ │ start  │ start            │ Plan → active; the world starts applying  │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │        │                  │ actions                                   │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ ├────────┼──────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┤                                                                    │
     │ │ end    │ end              │ Plan → completed; OCPP profiles cleared;  │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ │        │                  │ "restored" message with the rebate        │
     │   │                                                                     │
     │ ├────────┼──────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┤                                                                    │
     │ │ verify │ end + 15 min     │ PlanVerification computed; plan →         │
     │ verified  │                                                             │
     │ └────────┴──────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────── │
     │ ───┘                                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ A meter whose command was not acknowledged is not capped in the world.  │
     │ That is why the HES success rate matters and why it is shown.           │
     │                                                                         │
