     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/dispatch.py                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Turns an approved Flex Plan into timed commands and into the world's │
     │ Actions, then verifies it."""                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass, field                                │
     │ from datetime import datetime, timedelta                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import numpy as np                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.adapters.beckn import BecknGateway                             │
     │ from app.adapters.channels import ChannelGateway                        │
     │ from app.adapters.hes import MockHes                                    │
     │ from app.adapters.ocpp import OcppGateway                               │
     │ from app.adapters.openadr import OpenAdrVtn                             │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid.clock import iso, parse_iso                               │
     │ from app.grid.dr_model import DrModel, true_acceptance                  │
     │ from app.grid.loadgen import ist_slot                                   │
     │ from app.grid.models import FlexPlan, PlanVerification                  │
     │ from app.grid.network import stable_seed                                │
     │ from app.grid.planner import FlexPlanService                            │
     │ from app.grid.world import STEP, Actions, GridWorld, IntervalResult     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ STEPS = ("notify", "signal", "hes", "start", "end", "verify")           │
     │ STEP_TITLE = {"notify": "Consumers notified", "signal": "Chargers and   │
     │ shiftable loads signalled",                                             │
     │               "hes": "Meter limits sent", "start": "Window started",    │
     │ "end": "Window ended", "verify": "Plan verified"}                       │
     │ IST = timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def clock_ist(t: datetime) -> str:                                      │
     │     return (t + IST).strftime("%H:%M")                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class Run:                                                              │
     │     plan_id: str                                                        │
     │     sd: int                                                             │
     │     start: datetime                                                     │
     │     end: datetime                                                       │
     │     due: dict[str, datetime]                                            │
     │     ci: np.ndarray  # consumer positions of the sub-division            │
     │     caps: np.ndarray  # planned cap per consumer in kW; inf means none  │
     │     acked: np.ndarray  # the meter acknowledged its cap command         │
     │     dr_accept: np.ndarray                                               │
     │     hub: dict[int, np.ndarray]  # world hub position -> share curtailed │
     │ per slot                                                                │
     │     store: dict[int, np.ndarray]  # world storage position -> kW per    │
     │ slot                                                                    │
     │     shift: dict[int, np.ndarray]  # world shiftable position -> kW held │
     │ off per slot                                                            │
     │     planned_kwh: float                                                  │
     │     done: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)                       │
     │     realised_kwh: float = 0.0                                           │
     │     hoh_actual: float = 0.0                                             │
     │     hoh_baseline: float = 0.0                                           │
     │     trips: int = 0                                                      │
     │     complaints: int = 0                                                 │
     │     rebate_kwh: float = 0.0                                             │
     │     commanded: int = 0                                                  │
     │     invited: int = 0                                                    │
     │     accepted: int = 0                                                   │
     │     notices: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class Dispatcher:                                                       │
     │     def __init__(self, world: GridWorld, planner: FlexPlanService, hes: │
     │ MockHes, ocpp: OcppGateway,                                             │
     │                  openadr: OpenAdrVtn, beckn: BecknGateway, channels:    │
     │ ChannelGateway, dr_model: DrModel, seed: int):                          │
     │         self.world, self.planner = world, planner                       │
     │         self.hes, self.ocpp, self.openadr, self.beckn, self.channels =  │
     │ hes, ocpp, openadr, beckn, channels                                     │
     │         self.dr_model = dr_model                                        │
     │         self.seed = seed                                                │
     │         self.runs: dict[str, Run] = {}                                  │
     │         self.completed: list[dict] = []                                 │
     │         net = world.repo.network                                        │
     │         self._hub_pos = {h.id: i for i, h in                            │
     │ enumerate(net.charger_hubs)}                                            │
     │         self._store_pos = {s.id: i for i, s in                          │
     │ enumerate(net.storage_units)}                                           │
     │         self._shift_pos = {s.id: i for i, s in                          │
     │ enumerate(net.shiftable_loads)}                                         │
     │         planner.on_approved = self.on_approved                          │
     │         planner.on_cancelled = self.on_cancelled                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ hooks                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def on_approved(self, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None:       │
     │         start, end = parse_iso(plan.window.start),                      │
     │ parse_iso(plan.window.end)                                              │
     │         ci, caps = self.planner.consumer_caps(plan)                     │
     │         self.runs[plan.id] = Run(                                       │
     │             plan_id=plan.id,                                            │
     │ sd=self.world.sd_ids.index(plan.subdivision_id), start=start, end=end,  │
     │             due={"notify": parse_iso(plan.notify_at), "signal": start - │
     │ timedelta(minutes=c.SIGNAL_LEAD_MIN),                                   │
     │                  "hes": start - timedelta(minutes=c.HES_LEAD_MIN),      │
     │ "start": start, "end": end,                                             │
     │                  "verify": end +                                        │
     │ timedelta(minutes=c.VERIFY_DELAY_MIN)},                                 │
     │             ci=ci, caps=caps, acked=np.zeros(len(ci), dtype=bool),      │
     │ dr_accept=np.zeros(len(ci), dtype=bool),                                │
     │             hub={self._hub_pos[a.hub_id]: np.array(a.limit_frac) for a  │
     │ in plan.hub_actions},                                                   │
     │             store={self._store_pos[a.storage_id]: np.array(a.kw) for a  │
     │ in plan.storage_actions},                                               │
     │             shift={self._shift_pos[a.shift_id]: np.array(a.kw) for a in │
     │ plan.shift_actions},                                                    │
     │             planned_kwh=sum(lv.energy_kwh for lv in plan.levers if      │
     │ lv.lever != "residual"))                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def on_cancelled(self, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None:      │
     │         run = self.runs.pop(plan.id, None)                              │
     │         if run and "signal" in run.done:                                │
     │             self._clear_chargers(run, plan, now)                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ steps                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def step(self, now: datetime) -> list[dict]:                        │
     │         events: list[dict] = []                                         │
     │         for run in list(self.runs.values()):                            │
     │             plan = self.planner.plans.get(run.plan_id)                  │
     │             if plan is None:                                            │
     │                 self.runs.pop(run.plan_id, None)                        │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             for name in STEPS:                                          │
     │                 if name in run.done:                                    │
     │                     continue                                            │
     │                 if run.due[name] > now:                                 │
     │                     break  # steps are strictly ordered                 │
     │                 getattr(self, f"_{name}")(run, plan, now)               │
     │                 run.done.append(name)                                   │
     │                 events.append({"type": "plan", "at": iso(now),          │
     │ "plan_id": plan.id, "subdivision_id": plan.subdivision_id,              │
     │                                "step": name, "status": plan.status,     │
     │ "title": STEP_TITLE[name]})                                             │
     │             if "verify" in run.done:                                    │
     │                 self.runs.pop(run.plan_id, None)                        │
     │         return events                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _notify(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None: │
     │         cons = self.world.repo.consumers                                │
     │         ci = run.ci                                                     │
     │         exempt = cons.life_support[ci]                                  │
     │         capped = np.isfinite(run.caps)                                  │
     │         t0, t1 = clock_ist(run.start), clock_ist(run.end)               │
     │         totals: dict[str, int] = {}                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │         def send(template: str, mask: np.ndarray, **kw) -> None:        │
     │             if not mask.any():                                          │
     │                 return                                                  │
     │             pos = ci[mask]                                              │
     │             counts = self.channels.broadcast(plan.id, template,         │
     │ [cons.ids[i] for i in pos], cons.channel[pos],                          │
     │                                              cons.language[pos], now,   │
     │ start=t0, end=t1, **kw)                                                 │
     │             for k, v in counts.items():                                 │
     │                 totals[k] = totals.get(k, 0) + v                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │         if capped.any():                                                │
     │             send("lifeline_notice", capped,                             │
     │ watts=int(round(float(run.caps[capped].min()) * 1000)))                 │
     │         if plan.dr_actions:                                             │
     │             invited = ~exempt                                           │
     │             send("dr_ask", invited, rebate=int(c.DR_REBATE_RS_PER_KWH)) │
     │             rng = np.random.default_rng(stable_seed(self.seed, plan.id, │
     │ "dr"))                                                                  │
     │             accept = np.zeros(len(ci), dtype=bool)                      │
     │             accept[invited] =                                           │
     │ true_acceptance(cons.propensity[ci][invited], c.DR_REBATE_RS_PER_KWH,   │
     │ rng)                                                                    │
     │             run.dr_accept, run.invited, run.accepted = accept,          │
     │ int(invited.sum()), int(accept.sum())                                   │
     │             self.dr_model.update(cons.arch[ci][invited],                │
     │ accept[invited])                                                        │
     │             self.channels.ledger.record(now, "whatsapp", "in",          │
     │ f"{run.accepted} of {run.invited} consumers accepted the ask",          │
     │                                         {"invited": run.invited,        │
     │ "accepted": run.accepted}, ref=plan.id)                                 │
     │         if capped.any() or plan.dr_actions:                             │
     │             send("protected", exempt)                                   │
     │         run.notices = totals                                            │
     │         self.planner.transition(plan, "scheduled", now, "system",       │
     │ STEP_TITLE["notify"],                                                   │
     │                                 f"{sum(totals.values())} messages;      │
     │ {run.accepted} of {run.invited} accepted the DR ask")                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _hub_sched_kw(self, h: int, run: Run, now: datetime) ->         │
     │ np.ndarray:                                                             │
     │         days = self.world.days                                          │
     │         out, cache = [], {}                                             │
     │         for k in range(int(round((run.end - run.start) / STEP))):       │
     │             t = run.start + k * STEP                                    │
     │             d = days.ist_date(t)                                        │
     │             if d not in cache:                                          │
     │                 cache[d] = days.expected(d, now)[1]                     │
     │             out.append(float(cache[d].hub_kw[h, ist_slot(t)]))          │
     │         return np.array(out)                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _signal(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None: │
     │         net = self.world.repo.network                                   │
     │         profile = stable_seed(plan.id) % 100000                         │
     │         for h, frac in run.hub.items():                                 │
     │             limits = ((1.0 - frac) * self._hub_sched_kw(h, run, now) *  │
     │ 1000.0).tolist()                                                        │
     │             self.ocpp.send_profile(net.charger_hubs[h].ocpp_id,         │
     │ plan.id, profile, run.start, limits, now)                               │
     │         for r, kw in run.shift.items():                                 │
     │             sh = net.shiftable_loads[r]                                 │
     │             self.openadr.publish_limit(plan.id, sh.id, run.start, [0.0  │
     │ if v > 0 else sh.power_kw for v in kw], now)                            │
     │         for k, kw in run.store.items():                                 │
     │             unit = net.storage_units[k]                                 │
     │             self.openadr.publish_dispatch(plan.id, unit.id, run.start,  │
     │ kw.tolist(), now)                                                       │
     │             if unit.kind == "prosumer_battery":                         │
     │                 self.beckn.confirm_trade(plan.id, unit.id, unit.dt_id,  │
     │ float(kw.sum() * c.DT_H), run.start, run.end, now)                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _hes(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None:    │
     │         cons = self.world.repo.consumers                                │
     │         rng = np.random.default_rng(stable_seed(self.seed, plan.id,     │
     │ "hes"))                                                                 │
     │         planned = np.isfinite(run.caps)                                 │
     │         dt_of = cons.dt_index[run.ci]                                   │
     │         for action in plan.dt_actions:                                  │
     │             if action.cap_level == 0:                                   │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             idx = np.flatnonzero(planned & (dt_of ==                    │
     │ self.world.repo.dt_index(action.dt_id)))                                │
     │             if len(idx) == 0:                                           │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             batch = self.hes.set_load_limits(plan.id, action.dt_id,     │
     │ [cons.ids[run.ci[i]] for i in idx],                                     │
     │                                              run.caps[idx] * 1000.0,    │
     │ run.start, run.end, now, rng)                                           │
     │             run.acked[idx] = batch.acked                                │
     │             run.commanded += batch.n                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _start(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None:  │
     │         capped = int((np.isfinite(run.caps) & run.acked).sum())         │
     │         self.planner.transition(plan, "active", now, "system",          │
     │ STEP_TITLE["start"],                                                    │
     │                                 f"{capped} meters on a lifeline limit;  │
     │ {run.accepted} homes responding voluntarily")                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _clear_chargers(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime)  │
     │ -> None:                                                                │
     │         net = self.world.repo.network                                   │
     │         for h in run.hub:                                               │
     │             self.ocpp.clear(net.charger_hubs[h].ocpp_id, plan.id,       │
     │ stable_seed(plan.id) % 100000, now)                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _end(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None:    │
     │         cons = self.world.repo.consumers                                │
     │         self._clear_chargers(run, plan, now)                            │
     │         if run.dr_accept.any():                                         │
     │             pos = run.ci[run.dr_accept]                                 │
     │             amount = int(round(run.rebate_kwh * c.DR_REBATE_RS_PER_KWH  │
     │ / max(1, run.accepted)))                                                │
     │             self.channels.broadcast(plan.id, "restored", [cons.ids[i]   │
     │ for i in pos], cons.channel[pos], cons.language[pos],                   │
     │                                     now, amount=amount)                 │
     │         self.planner.transition(plan, "completed", now, "system",       │
     │ STEP_TITLE["end"], "Limits expired on the meters")                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _verify(self, run: Run, plan: FlexPlan, now: datetime) -> None: │
     │         planned = np.isfinite(run.caps)                                 │
     │         success = 100.0 * float(run.acked[planned].mean()) if           │
     │ planned.any() else 100.0                                                │
     │         v = PlanVerification(                                           │
     │             planned_relief_kwh=round(run.planned_kwh, 1),               │
     │ realised_relief_kwh=round(run.realised_kwh, 1),                         │
     │             realisation_pct=round(100.0 * run.realised_kwh /            │
     │ max(run.planned_kwh, 1e-9), 1),                                         │
     │             command_success_pct=round(success, 2), trips=run.trips,     │
     │ complaints=run.complaints,                                              │
     │             hoh_actual=round(run.hoh_actual, 1),                        │
     │ hoh_baseline=round(run.hoh_baseline, 1),                                │
     │             rebate_paid_rs=round(run.rebate_kwh *                       │
     │ c.DR_REBATE_RS_PER_KWH, 0))                                             │
     │         plan.verification = v                                           │
     │         self.planner.transition(plan, "verified", now, "system",        │
     │ STEP_TITLE["verify"],                                                   │
     │                                 f"{v.realisation_pct:.0f} percent of    │
     │ planned relief realised; "                                              │
     │                                 f"{v.hoh_baseline - v.hoh_actual:.0f}   │
     │ household-outage-hours avoided")                                        │
     │         self.completed.append({"plan_id": plan.id, "subdivision_id":    │
     │ plan.subdivision_id, "at": iso(now),                                    │
     │                                "invited": run.invited, "accepted":      │
     │ run.accepted, "commanded": run.commanded,                               │
     │                                "acked": int(run.acked[planned].sum()),  │
     │ **v.model_dump()})                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ world interface                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def actions(self, at: datetime) -> Actions:                         │
     │         base = self.world.no_actions                                    │
     │         act = Actions(base.cap_kw.copy(), base.cap_started.copy(),      │
     │ base.dr_on.copy(), base.hub_frac.copy(),                                │
     │                       base.storage_kw.copy(), base.shift_on.copy())     │
     │         for run in self.runs.values():                                  │
     │             if "start" not in run.done or "end" in run.done:            │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             k = int(round((at - run.start) / STEP))                     │
     │             if k < 0 or at >= run.end:                                  │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             live = np.isfinite(run.caps) & run.acked                    │
     │             act.cap_kw[run.ci[live]] = run.caps[live]                   │
     │             if k == 0:                                                  │
     │                 act.cap_started[run.ci[live]] = True                    │
     │             act.dr_on[run.ci[run.dr_accept]] = True                     │
     │             for h, frac in run.hub.items():                             │
     │                 act.hub_frac[h] = frac[k]                               │
     │             for s, kw in run.store.items():                             │
     │                 act.storage_kw[s] = kw[k]                               │
     │             for r, kw in run.shift.items():                             │
     │                 act.shift_on[r] = kw[k] > 0                             │
     │         return act                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def observe(self, sol: IntervalResult, base: IntervalResult) ->     │
     │ None:                                                                   │
     │         if not self.runs:                                               │
     │             return                                                      │
     │         world, cons = self.world, self.world.repo.consumers             │
     │         row = world.log[-1]                                             │
     │         for run in self.runs.values():                                  │
     │             if "start" not in run.done or not (run.start <= sol.at <    │
     │ run.end):                                                               │
     │                 continue                                                │
     │             relief = max(0.0, float(row.sd_natural_kw[run.sd] -         │
     │ sol.sd_supplied_kw[run.sd]))                                            │
     │             run.realised_kwh += relief * c.DT_H / (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC)  │
     │             state = sol.meter_state[run.ci]                             │
     │             run.hoh_actual += float(((state == c.METER_OUTAGE) | (state │
     │ == c.METER_TRIPPED)).sum()) * c.DT_H                                    │
     │             run.trips += int((state == c.METER_TRIPPED).sum())          │
     │             run.hoh_baseline += float((base.meter_state[run.ci] ==      │
     │ c.METER_OUTAGE).sum()) * c.DT_H                                         │
     │             day = world.days.get(world.days.ist_date(sol.at))           │
     │             d = day.demand[run.ci, ist_slot(sol.at)]                    │
     │             acc = run.dr_accept & sol.dt_on[cons.dt_index[run.ci]]      │
     │             run.rebate_kwh += float((d[acc] *                           │
     │ cons.flex_share[run.ci][acc]).sum()) * c.DR_FLEX_REALISED * c.DT_H      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def add_complaint(self, consumer_position: int) -> None:            │
     │         for run in self.runs.values():                                  │
     │             if "start" in run.done and consumer_position in run.ci:     │
     │                 run.complaints += 1                                     │

     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Produces (service.py):                                                │
     │   - GridService(settings, repo, firm_base=None, time_fn=time.time,      │
     │ store=None)                                                             │
     │   - Attributes after boot(): world, planner, dispatcher, ledger, hes,   │
     │ ocpp, openadr, beckn, channels, dr_model, forecaster, static, weather,  │
     │ days, supply, clock, risk (dict with index, level, drivers), events     │
     │ (deque of dicts, newest first), audit (deque), complaints (deque),      │
     │ last_sol, last_base, lock (RLock), listeners                            │
     │   - boot(scenario_id=None, start=None, seed=None) -> None               │
     │   - now() -> datetime                                                   │
     │   - tick(now: datetime | None = None) -> dict (the frame described      │
     │ below)                                                                  │
     │   - kpis(subdivision_id: str | None = None) -> dict                     │
     │   - set_time_scale(scale: float) -> dict, reset(scenario_id=None,       │
     │ seed=None) -> dict, jump(hhmm: str) -> dict, set_autopilot(on: bool) -> │
     │ dict, clock_state() -> dict                                             │
     │   - record_audit(actor, action, target, detail) -> dict                 │
     │   - flush() -> None                                                     │
     │ - Produces (stream.py): StreamHub(service), sse_events(hub,             │
     │ subdivision_id=None), TickLoop(service, interval=1.0)                   │
     │ - Produces (deps.py): get_grid_service(), get_stream_hub() (both        │
     │ lru-cached)                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ The tick frame (one per real second; telemetry is present only when a   │
     │ new interval was computed):                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ {                                                                       │
     │   "sim_now": "2026-06-01T13:07:00Z",                                    │
     │   "fresh": true,                                                        │
     │   "telemetry": {                                                        │
     │     "at": "2026-06-01T13:00:00Z",                                       │
     │     "dts": [["dt_sn_01", 71.4, 79, 0, 96.2, 0.957]],                    │
     │     "feeders_off": [], "base_feeders_off": ["fdr_fp_a"],                │
     │     "sd": [{"id": "sd_faridpur", "natural_kw": 812.0, "avail_kw":       │
     │ 640.0, "supplied_kw": 631.5,                                            │
     │             "base_supplied_kw": 520.1, "out": 0, "base_out": 612,       │
     │ "capped": 418}],                                                        │
     │     "meters": {"normal": 6120, "dr": 402, "lifeline": 890, "tripped":   │
     │ 12, "outage": 0, "protected": 38},                                      │
     │     "base_out": 1204                                                    │
     │   },                                                                    │
     │   "events": [], "plan_events": [], "plans": null, "risk": []            │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Each dts row is [dt_id, net_kw, loading_pct, state, hotspot_c,          │
     │ v_min_pu]. state: 0 normal, 1 some meters on a lifeline limit, 2 above  │
     │ thermal limit, 3 off.                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ SSE events on GET /api/v1/stream?subdivision_id=: tick ({sim_now,       │
     │ telemetry} filtered to the scope), event (world events: feeder shed or  │
     │ restored, DT trip, critical interrupted), plan (dispatcher step         │
     │ events), plans ({added, changed, expired}), risk ({dt_id, dt_name,      │
     │ subdivision_id, from, to, reason}), kpis (every 5 real seconds). Only   │
     │ tick frames may be dropped for a slow client.                           │

     │ """What survives a restart: the audit log, registry edits, learned DR   │
     │ rates and complaints.                                                   │
     │ The simulated world itself restarts from the scenario start on every    │
     │ boot (documented limitation)."""                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import logging                                                          │
     │ import os                                                               │
     │ import threading                                                        │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │ from typing import Any                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from pydantic import BaseModel, Field                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ logger = logging.getLogger("lifelinegrid")                              │
     │ SCHEMA_VERSION = 1                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class GridState(BaseModel):                                             │
     │     schema_version: int = SCHEMA_VERSION                                │
     │     audit: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)                     │
     │     life_support_added: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)         │
     │     life_support_removed: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)       │
     │     consents: dict[str, dict] = Field(default_factory=dict)             │
     │     dr_model: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)              │
     │     complaints: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class StateStore:                                                       │
     │     def load(self) -> GridState | None:  # pragma: no cover - interface │
     │         raise NotImplementedError                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def save(self, state: GridState) -> None:  # pragma: no cover -     │
     │ interface                                                               │
     │         raise NotImplementedError                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class MemoryStateStore(StateStore):                                     │
     │     def __init__(self):                                                 │
     │         self._text: str | None = None                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def load(self) -> GridState | None:                                 │
     │         return GridState.model_validate_json(self._text) if self._text  │
     │ else None                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def save(self, state: GridState) -> None:                           │
     │         self._text = state.model_dump_json()                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class JsonFileStateStore(StateStore):                                   │
     │     """Atomic JSON file: write `*.tmp`, then `os.replace`. An           │
     │ unreadable file is moved aside."""                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def __init__(self, path: Path | str):                               │
     │         self.path = Path(path)                                          │
     │         self._lock = threading.Lock()                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def load(self) -> GridState | None:                                 │
     │         if not self.path.exists():                                      │
     │             return None                                                 │
     │         try:                                                            │
     │             data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))    │
     │             if data.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:            │
     │                 raise ValueError(f"schema_version                       │
     │ {data.get('schema_version')} != {SCHEMA_VERSION}")                      │
     │             return GridState.model_validate(data)                       │
     │         except Exception as exc:                                        │
     │             backup = self.path.with_name(self.path.name + ".corrupt")   │
     │             try:                                                        │
     │                 os.replace(self.path, backup)                           │
     │             except OSError:                                             │
     │                 logger.warning("Could not move the unreadable state     │
     │ file aside", exc_info=True)                                             │
     │             logger.warning("State file unreadable (%s); starting        │
     │ clean", exc)                                                            │
     │             return None                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def save(self, state: GridState) -> None:                           │
     │         with self._lock:                                                │
     │             self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)         │
     │             tmp = self.path.with_name(self.path.name + ".tmp")          │
     │             tmp.write_text(state.model_dump_json(), encoding="utf-8")   │
     │             os.replace(tmp, self.path)                                  │

     │         self.store = store or                                           │

     │         self.lock = threading.RLock()                                   │
     │         self.listeners: list[Callable[[dict], None]] = []               │
     │         self.audit: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=500)                     │
     │         self.events: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=300)                    │
     │         self.complaints: deque[dict] = deque(maxlen=300)                │
     │         self.state = GridState()                                        │
     │         self.booted = False                                             │
     │         self._dirty = False                                             │
     │         self._last_save = 0.0                                           │

     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------ boot │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def boot(self, scenario_id: str | None = None, start: datetime |    │
     │ None = None, seed: int | None = None) -> None:                          │
     │         with self.lock:                                                 │
     │             s = self.settings                                           │
     │             self.scenario_id = scenario_id or s.lifeline_scenario       │
     │             self.seed = seed if seed is not None else s.lifeline_seed   │
     │             if start is None:                                           │
     │                 start = parse_iso(s.lifeline_scenario_start) if         │
     │ s.lifeline_scenario_start else default_start()                          │
     │             self.sim_start = start                                      │
     │             saved = self.store.load()                                   │
     │             if saved is not None:                                       │
     │                 self.state = saved                                      │
     │                 self.audit = deque(saved.audit, maxlen=500)             │
     │                 self.complaints = deque(saved.complaints, maxlen=300)   │
     │             self._apply_registry()                                      │
     │             self.weather = load_weather_provider(s.data_dir,            │
     │ self.scenario_id, start)                                                │
     │             self.load_model = LoadModel(self.repo.consumers,            │
     │ load_shapes(s.data_dir), seed=self.seed)                                │
     │             self.days = DayBuilder(self.repo, self.load_model,          │
     │ self.weather,                                                           │
     │                                    base_date=DayBuilder.ist_date(start) │
     │ - timedelta(days=9))                                                    │
     │             self.supply = SupplyModel(self.repo.network, self.weather,  │
     │ self.firm_base or load_calibration(s.data_dir))                         │
     │             self.world = GridWorld(self.repo, self.days, self.supply,   │
     │ seed=self.seed, sim_start=start)                                        │
     │             self.world.warm_up()                                        │
     │             self.forecaster = Forecaster(s.data_dir / "models")         │
     │             self.static = dt_static(self.repo, self.seed)               │
     │             self.dr_model = DrModel.from_state(self.state.dr_model) if  │
     │ self.state.dr_model else DrModel()                                      │
     │             self.planner = FlexPlanService(self.world, self.forecaster, │
     │ self.static, self.dr_model,                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ autopilot=s.lifeline_autopilot)                                         │
     │             self.ledger = ProtocolLedger()                              │
     │             self.hes, self.ocpp = MockHes(self.ledger),                 │
     │ OcppGateway(self.ledger)                                                │
     │             self.openadr, self.beckn = OpenAdrVtn(self.ledger,          │
     │ self.repo.network), BecknGateway(self.ledger)                           │
     │             self.channels = ChannelGateway(self.ledger)                 │
     │             self.dispatcher = Dispatcher(self.world, self.planner,      │
     │ self.hes, self.ocpp, self.openadr, self.beckn,                          │
     │                                          self.channels, self.dr_model,  │
     │ self.seed)                                                              │
     │             self.clock = SimClock(anchor_real=self.time_fn(),           │
     │ anchor_sim=start, scale=s.lifeline_time_scale,                          │
     │                                   time_fn=self.time_fn)                 │
     │             self.events.clear()                                         │
     │             self.last_sol = self.last_base = None                       │
     │             self.risk = {"index": np.zeros(self.world.D, dtype=int),    │
     │ "level": ["healthy"] * self.world.D, "drivers": {}}                     │
     │             self.planner.refresh(start)                                 │
     │             self._update_risk()                                         │
     │             self.booted = True                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _apply_registry(self) -> None:                                  │
     │         """Life-support flags edited in the field app are applied on    │
     │ top of the seeded population."""                                        │
     │         cons = self.repo.consumers                                      │
     │         pos = {cid: i for i, cid in enumerate(cons.ids)}                │
     │         for cid in self.state.life_support_added:                       │
     │             if cid in pos and cons.tier[pos[cid]] == 1:                 │
     │                 cons.life_support[pos[cid]] = True                      │
     │         for cid in self.state.life_support_removed:                     │
     │             if cid in pos:                                              │
     │                 cons.life_support[pos[cid]] = False                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def now(self) -> datetime:                                          │
     │         return self.clock.now()                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------ tick │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def tick(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> dict:                │
     │         started = time.perf_counter()                                   │
     │         with self.lock:                                                 │
     │             target = now or self.clock.now()                            │
     │             events: list[dict] = []                                     │
     │             plan_events: list[dict] = []                                │
     │             plans: dict | None = None                                   │
     │             risk: list[dict] = []                                       │
     │             steps = 0                                                   │
     │             while self.world.now <= target and steps < MAX_CATCHUP:     │
     │                 ev, pev, delta, changes = self._interval()              │
     │                 events += ev                                            │
     │                 plan_events += pev                                      │
     │                 risk += changes                                         │
     │                 if delta and any(delta.values()):                       │
     │                     plans = delta if plans is None else {k: [*plans[k], │
     │ *delta[k]] for k in delta}                                              │
     │                 steps += 1                                              │
     │             if steps == MAX_CATCHUP and self.world.now <= target:       │
     │                 self.clock.reanchor(self.world.now)  # the host slept:  │
     │ do not replay the gap                                                   │
     │                 target = self.world.now                                 │
     │             frame = {"sim_now": iso(target), "fresh": steps > 0,        │
     │ "telemetry": self._telemetry() if steps else None,                      │
     │                      "events": events, "plan_events": plan_events,      │
     │ "plans": plans, "risk": risk}                                           │
     │             self._maybe_save()                                          │
     │         self.tick_ms.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)     │
     │         for fn in list(self.listeners):                                 │
     │             try:                                                        │
     │                 fn(frame)                                               │
     │             except Exception:                                           │
     │                 logger.exception("tick listener failed")                │
     │         return frame                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _interval(self) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], dict | None,   │
     │ list[dict]]:                                                            │
     │         t = self.world.now                                              │
     │         delta, changes = None, []                                       │
     │         if ist_slot(t) % 4 == 0 and self.world.abs_slot > 0:  # top of  │
     │ every IST hour; boot already refreshed                                  │
     │             delta = self.planner.refresh(t)                             │
     │             changes = self._update_risk()                               │
     │         plan_events = self.dispatcher.step(t)                           │
     │         sol, base = self.world.advance(self.dispatcher.actions(t))      │
     │         self.dispatcher.observe(sol, base)                              │
     │         self.last_sol, self.last_base = sol, base                       │
     │         events = [*sol.events, *base.events]                            │
     │         for e in [*events, *plan_events]:                               │
     │             self.events.appendleft(e)                                   │
     │         if plan_events or (delta and any(delta.values())):              │
     │             self._dirty = True                                          │
     │         return events, plan_events, delta, changes                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _update_risk(self) -> list[dict]:                               │
     │         world, fc = self.world, self.planner.forecast                   │
     │         day = c.SLOTS_PER_DAY                                           │
     │         load = fc.plan_net_kw[:, :day] / self.repo.rating_kw[:, None]   │
     │         k = np.maximum(load, 0.0)                                       │
     │         hot = hot_spot_temp(fc.temp[:, :day], top_oil_rise_ultimate(k), │
     │ k).max(axis=1)                                                          │
     │         deficit = np.zeros(world.D)                                     │
     │         for s, idx in enumerate(world.sd_dts):                          │
     │             deficit[idx] = (fc.gap_kw[s, :day] >                        │
     │ world.tolerance[s]).sum()                                               │
     │         deficit = np.maximum(deficit, (fc.over_kw[:, :day] >            │
     │ 0).sum(axis=1))                                                         │
     │         v_min = self.last_sol.v_min if self.last_sol is not None else   │
     │ np.ones(world.D)                                                        │
     │         v_min = np.where(v_min > 0, v_min, 1.0)                         │
     │         hosts = np.isin(np.arange(world.D), world.fac_dt)               │
     │         drivers = dt_risk_drivers(load.max(axis=1) * 100, hot, v_min,   │
     │ deficit, hosts)                                                         │
     │         index = np.rint(sum(drivers.values())).astype(int)              │
     │         level = [risk_level(v) for v in index]                          │
     │         changes = []                                                    │
     │         for i, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(self.risk["level"], level,   │
     │ strict=True)):                                                          │
     │             if old != new and self.world.abs_slot > 0:                  │
     │                 dt = self.repo.network.transformers[i]                  │
     │                 top = max(drivers, key=lambda name: drivers[name][i])   │
     │                 changes.append({"dt_id": dt.id, "dt_name": dt.name,     │
     │ "subdivision_id": dt.subdivision_id, "from": old,                       │
     │                                 "to": new, "reason": top})              │
     │         self.risk = {"index": index, "level": level, "drivers":         │
     │ drivers, "peak_loading_pct": load.max(axis=1) * 100,                    │
     │                      "hotspot_peak_c": hot, "deficit_slots": deficit}   │
     │         return changes                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _telemetry(self) -> dict:                                       │
     │         sol, base, row = self.last_sol, self.last_base,                 │
     │ self.world.log[-1]                                                      │
     │         cons = self.repo.consumers                                      │
     │         capped = np.bincount(cons.dt_index, weights=(sol.meter_state == │
     │ c.METER_CAPPED).astype(float), minlength=self.world.D)                  │
     │         limit = dynamic_limit_pu(self.world.temp_hist[:, -1])           │
     │         state = np.where(~sol.dt_on, 3, np.where(sol.loading > limit,   │
     │ 2, np.where(capped > 0, 1, 0)))                                         │
     │         ids = self.repo.dt_ids                                          │
     │         return {                                                        │
     │             "at": iso(sol.at),                                          │
     │             "dts": [[ids[i], round(float(sol.dt_kw[i]), 1),             │
     │ int(round(float(sol.loading[i]) * 100)), int(state[i]),                 │
     │                      round(float(sol.hotspot[i]), 1),                   │
     │ round(float(sol.v_min[i]), 3)] for i in range(self.world.D)],           │
     │             "feeders_off": sorted(sol.feeders_off), "base_feeders_off": │
     │ sorted(base.feeders_off),                                               │
     │             "sd": [{"id": sd, "natural_kw":                             │
     │ round(float(row.sd_natural_kw[s]), 1), "avail_kw":                      │
     │ round(float(row.sd_avail_kw[s]), 1),                                    │
     │                     "supplied_kw": round(float(row.sd_supplied_sol[s]), │
     │ 1), "base_supplied_kw": round(float(row.sd_supplied_base[s]), 1),       │
     │                     "out": int(row.sd_out_sol[s]), "base_out":          │
     │ int(row.sd_out_base[s]), "capped": int(row.sd_capped_sol[s])}           │
     │                    for s, sd in enumerate(self.world.sd_ids)],          │
     │             "meters": {name: int((sol.meter_state == k).sum()) for k,   │
     │ name in enumerate(c.METER_STATE_NAMES)},                                │
     │             "base_out": int((base.meter_state ==                        │
     │ c.METER_OUTAGE).sum()),                                                 │
     │         }                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     #                                                                   │
     │ ------------------------------------------------------------------ KPIs │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def kpis(self, subdivision_id: str | None = None) -> dict:          │
     │         with self.lock:                                                 │
     │             world = self.world                                          │
     │             key = subdivision_id or "all"                               │
     │             sol, base = world.solution.metrics[key],                    │
     │ world.baseline.metrics[key]                                             │
     │             if subdivision_id:                                          │
     │                 ci = world.sd_cons[world.sd_ids.index(subdivision_id)]  │
     │             else:                                                       │
     │                 ci = np.arange(world.N)                                 │

     │     def jump(self, hhmm: str) -> dict:                                  │
     │         """Fast-forward to the next occurrence of an IST clock time (at │
     │ most 24 hours ahead)."""                                                │
     │         with self.lock:                                                 │
     │             hours, minutes = (int(x) for x in hhmm.split(":"))          │
     │             now = self.clock.now()                                      │
     │             local = now + IST                                           │
     │             target_local = local.replace(hour=hours, minute=minutes,    │
     │ second=0, microsecond=0)                                                │
     │             if target_local <= local:                                   │
     │                 target_local += timedelta(days=1)                       │
     │             target = target_local - IST                                 │
     │             self.clock.reanchor(target)                                 │
     │         self.tick(target)                                               │
     │         return self.clock_state()                                       │

     │ async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):                                       │
     │     """Starts the tick loop (unless LIFELINE_TICK=false) and flushes    │
     │ state on exit."""                                                       │
     │     tick_loop = None                                                    │
     │     service = None                                                      │
     │     if get_settings().lifeline_tick:                                    │
     │         from app.api.deps import get_grid_service, get_stream_hub       │
     │         from app.grid.stream import TickLoop                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │         service = await asyncio.to_thread(get_grid_service)             │
     │         await asyncio.to_thread(get_stream_hub)                         │
     │         tick_loop = TickLoop(service)                                   │
     │         tick_loop.start()                                               │
     │     try:                                                                │
     │         yield                                                           │
     │     finally:                                                            │
     │         if tick_loop is not None:                                       │
     │             await tick_loop.stop()                                      │
     │         if service is not None:                                         │
     │             service.flush()                                             │

     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/core/security.py, backend/app/api/v1/auth.py      │

     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - Produces:                                                             │
     │   - ROLES = ("consumer", "field", "je", "ae", "regulator", "admin"),    │
     │ APPROVER_ROLES = ("je", "ae", "admin")                                  │
     │   - User dataclass: username, name, role, title, subdivision_id         │
     │   - DEMO_USERS: tuple[User, ...], DEMO_PASSWORD = "lifeline-demo"       │
     │   - create_token(user, settings) -> str, decode_token(token, settings)  │
     │ -> User                                                                 │
     │   - FastAPI dependencies current_user (returns User | None),            │
     │ require_roles(*roles) (returns a dependency yielding User, raising 401  │
     │ or 403), and helper ensure_scope(user, subdivision_id) (a je may act    │
     │ only on their own sub-division)                                         │
     │ - Endpoints: POST /api/v1/auth/login {username, password}, POST         │
     │ /api/v1/auth/demo-login {role, subdivision_id?}, GET /api/v1/auth/me,   │
     │ GET /api/v1/auth/demo-users. Token responses: {"token": "...", "user":  │
     │ {username, name, role, title, subdivision_id}}.                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Policy. Reads are public (the demo must open without a login). Every    │
     │ mutation that affects consumers or the simulation's decisions requires  │
     │ a token: plan approve, reject, modify, cancel need je, ae or admin;     │
     │ field registry writes need field, ae or admin. Each successful mutation │
     │ writes an audit row with the actor's username. Simulation admin         │
     │ endpoints stay open when LIFELINE_ADMIN_ENABLED=true (demo operation)   │
     │ and are disabled otherwise.                                             │
     │                                                                         │

     │ class User:                                                             │

     │     name: str                                                           │
     │     role: str                                                           │

     │     subdivision_id: str | None = None                                   │

     │ DEMO_USERS: tuple[User, ...] = (                                        │
     │     *(User(f"je.{key}", f"Junior Engineer, {name}", "je", f"JE, {name}  │
     │ sub-division", f"sd_{key}") for key, name in _SD),                      │
     │     User("ae.bareilly", "Assistant Engineer, Bareilly", "ae", "AE,      │

     │     User("ae.mathura", "Assistant Engineer, Mathura", "ae", "AE,        │

     │ def find_user(username: str) -> User | None:                            │
     │     return _BY_NAME.get(username)                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def verify_password(password: str) -> bool:                             │
     │     return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode(), _HASH)                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def create_token(user: User, settings: Settings) -> str:                │
     │     claims = {"sub": user.username, "name": user.name, "role":          │
     │ user.role, "title": user.title,                                         │
     │               "sd": user.subdivision_id, "exp": int(time.time()) +      │
     │ settings.jwt_ttl_minutes * 60}                                          │
     │     return jwt.encode(claims, settings.jwt_secret, algorithm="HS256")   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def decode_token(token: str, settings: Settings) -> User:               │
     │     try:                                                                │
     │         claims = jwt.decode(token, settings.jwt_secret,                 │
     │ algorithms=["HS256"])                                                   │
     │     except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError as exc:                            │
     │         raise ApiError(401, "Session expired. Sign in again.",          │
     │ "token_expired") from exc                                               │
     │     except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:                                       │
     │         raise ApiError(401, "Invalid session token.", "token_invalid")  │
     │ from exc                                                                │
     │     return User(claims["sub"], claims.get("name", claims["sub"]),       │
     │ claims["role"], claims.get("title", ""), claims.get("sd"))              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def current_user(authorization: str | None = Header(default=None),      │
     │ settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings)) -> User | None:             │
     │     if not authorization or not                                         │
     │ authorization.lower().startswith("bearer "):                            │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │     return decode_token(authorization[7:].strip(), settings)            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def require_roles(*roles: str):                                         │
     │     def dependency(user: User | None = Depends(current_user)) -> User:  │
     │         if user is None:                                                │
     │             raise ApiError(401, "Sign in to do this.",                  │
     │ "unauthenticated")                                                      │
     │         if user.role not in roles:                                      │
     │             raise ApiError(403, f"The {user.role} role cannot do        │
     │ this.", "forbidden")                                                    │
     │         return user                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     return dependency                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def ensure_scope(user: User, subdivision_id: str) -> None:              │
     │     """A Junior Engineer acts only on their own sub-division."""        │
     │     if user.role == "je" and user.subdivision_id != subdivision_id:     │
     │         raise ApiError(403, "This plan belongs to another               │
     │ sub-division.", "forbidden_scope")                                      │

     │         return act                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │     svc.dispatcher.actions = spy                                        │
     │     svc.tick(SIM_START + timedelta(hours=hours))                        │
     │     return svc, seen                                                    │
