     │         "peak_loading_pct":                                             │
     │ r1(svc.risk["peak_loading_pct"][idx].max()),                            │
     │         "dts_overloaded_24h": int((fc.over_kw[idx, :DAY].max(axis=1) >  │
     │ 0).sum()),                                                              │
     │         "hotspot_peak_c": r1(svc.risk["hotspot_peak_c"][idx].max()),    │
     │         "deficit_slots_24h": int((fc.gap_kw[s, :DAY] >                  │
     │ world.tolerance[s]).sum()),                                             │
     │         "next_deficit_at": pending[0].window.start if pending else      │
     │ None,                                                                   │
     │         "pending_plans": len(pending), "active_plans": sum(p.status in  │
     │ ("scheduled", "active") for p in plans_sd),                             │
     │         "hoh": r1(sol.hoh), "base_hoh": r1(base.hoh), "hoh_avoided":    │
     │ r1(base.hoh - sol.hoh),                                                 │
     │         "outage_h_per_day": r2(sol.outage_h_per_consumer_day(n)),       │
     │ "base_outage_h_per_day": r2(base.outage_h_per_consumer_day(n)),         │
     │         "ceew_outage_h_per_day": CEEW_OUTAGE_H[sd.kind],                │
     │         "saidi_min": r1(sol.saidi_min(n)), "base_saidi_min":            │
     │ r1(base.saidi_min(n)),                                                  │
     │         "lifeline_availability_pct": r1(sol.lifeline_availability_pct), │
     │         "base_lifeline_availability_pct":                               │
     │ r1(base.lifeline_availability_pct),                                     │
     │         "critical_availability_pct": r1(sol.critical_availability_pct), │
     │         "fairness_jain": r3(jain(served_fraction(tr.burden_kwh[ci],     │
     │ tr.entitled_kwh[ci]))) if entitled > 0 else 1.0,                        │
     │         "spark_loading": [r1(100 * float(h.sd_supplied_sol[s]) /        │
     │ sd.alloc_kw) for h in hist],                                            │
     │         "spark_base_out": [int(h.sd_out_base[s]) for h in hist],        │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def circle_summary(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:              │
     │     rows = [_sd_row(svc, s) for s in _scope(svc, sd_id)]                │
     │     k = svc.kpis(sd_id)                                                 │
     │     totals = {                                                          │
     │         "consumers": k["consumers"], "dts": sum(r["dts"] for r in       │
     │ rows), "subdivisions": len(rows),                                       │
     │         "risk_counts": {lv: sum(r["risk_counts"][lv] for r in rows) for │
     │ lv in c.RISK_LEVELS},                                                   │
     │         "risk_index": round(sum(r["risk_index"] for r in rows) /        │
     │ len(rows)),                                                             │
     │         **{key: r1(sum(r[key] for r in rows)) for key in ("natural_kw", │
     │ "avail_kw", "supplied_kw", "gap_kw")},                                  │
     │         "dts_overloaded_24h": sum(r["dts_overloaded_24h"] for r in      │
     │ rows),                                                                  │
     │         **{key: k[key] for key in ("out_now", "base_out_now",           │
     │ "capped_now", "deficit_now", "pending_plans", "active_plans",           │
     │                                    "plans_verified", "dt_trips",        │
     │ "base_dt_trips", "next_deficit_at", "autopilot", "forecast_mode")},     │
     │         **{key: r1(k[key]) for key in ("hoh", "base_hoh",               │
     │ "hoh_avoided", "saidi_min", "base_saidi_min",                           │
     │                                        "lifeline_availability_pct",     │
     │ "base_lifeline_availability_pct",                                       │
     │                                        "critical_availability_pct",     │
     │ "base_critical_availability_pct")},                                     │
     │         "fairness_jain": r3(k["fairness_jain"]),                        │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │     return {"generated_at": k["sim_now"], "scope": sd_id or "all",      │
     │ "totals": totals, "subdivisions": rows}                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def feeders(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                     │
     │     world, net = svc.world, svc.repo.network                            │
     │     wanted = {world.sd_ids[s] for s in _scope(svc, sd_id)}              │
     │     sol, base = svc.last_sol, svc.last_base                             │
     │     log = list(world.log)[-DAY:]                                        │
     │     items = []                                                          │
     │     for f in net.feeders:                                               │
     │         if f.subdivision_id not in wanted:                              │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         idx = world.feeder_dts[f.id]                                    │
     │         kw = float(sol.dt_kw[idx].sum()) if sol else 0.0                │
     │         items.append({                                                  │
     │             "id": f.id, "name": f.name, "subdivision_id":               │
     │ f.subdivision_id, "capacity_kw": f.capacity_kw,                         │
     │             "length_km": f.length_km, "dt_ids": f.dt_ids, "consumers":  │
     │ sum(net.transformers[i].n_consumers for i in idx),                      │
     │             "kw": r1(kw), "loading_pct": r1(100 * kw / f.capacity_kw)   │
     │ if f.capacity_kw else 0.0,                                              │
     │             "on": f.id not in sol.feeders_off if sol else True,         │
     │ "base_on": f.id not in base.feeders_off if base else True,              │
     │             "off_slots_24h": sum(f.id in row.off_sol for row in log),   │
     │ "base_off_slots_24h": sum(f.id in row.off_base for row in log),         │
     │             # slots off in each of the last 24 hours (0 to 4), oldest   │
     │ first; padded with zeros while the log is short                         │
     │             "off_by_hour": _by_hour([f.id in row.off_sol for row in     │
     │ log]),                                                                  │
     │             "base_off_by_hour": _by_hour([f.id in row.off_base for row  │
     │ in log])})                                                              │
     │     return {"items": items}                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _by_hour(flags: list[bool]) -> list[int]:                           │
     │     padded = [False] * (DAY - len(flags)) + flags                       │
     │     return [int(sum(padded[h * 4:h * 4 + 4])) for h in range(24)]       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _dt_row(svc, i: int, levels: dict[str, int]) -> dict:               │
     │     world, cons = svc.world, svc.repo.consumers                         │
     │     dt, sol, tr, base = svc.repo.network.transformers[i], svc.last_sol, │
     │ world.solution, world.baseline                                          │
     │     sl = cons.dt_slices[i]                                              │
     │     state = sol.meter_state[sl] if sol else np.zeros(dt.n_consumers,    │
     │ dtype=np.uint8)                                                         │
     │     entitled = float(tr.entitled_kwh[sl].sum())                         │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "id": dt.id, "name": dt.name, "subdivision_id":                 │
     │ dt.subdivision_id, "feeder_id": dt.feeder_id,                           │
     │         "rating_kva": dt.rating_kva, "lat": dt.lat, "lng": dt.lng,      │
     │ "income_band": dt.income_band,                                          │
     │         "n_consumers": dt.n_consumers, "solar_kw": dt.solar_kw,         │
     │ "year_installed": dt.year_installed,                                    │
     │         "on": bool(sol.dt_on[i]) if sol else True, "kw":                │
     │ r1(sol.dt_kw[i]) if sol else 0.0,                                       │
     │         "loading_pct": r1(sol.loading[i] * 100) if sol else 0.0,        │
     │         "limit_pct": r1(float(dynamic_limit_pu(world.temp_hist[i, -1])) │
     │ * 100),                                                                 │
     │         "hotspot_c": r1(tr.hotspot[i]), "v_min_pu": r3(sol.v_min[i]) if │
     │ sol else 1.0, "v_max_pu": r3(sol.v_max[i]) if sol else 1.0,             │
     │         "loss_kw": r2(sol.loss_kw[i]) if sol else 0.0, "lol_pct":       │
     │ round(float(tr.lol_pct[i]), 5),                                         │
     │         "base_lol_pct": round(float(base.lol_pct[i]), 5),               │
     │         "risk_index": int(svc.risk["index"][i]), "risk_level":          │
     │ svc.risk["level"][i],                                                   │
     │         "drivers": {k: r1(svc.risk["drivers"][k][i]) for k in           │
     │ DRIVER_KEYS},                                                           │
     │         "peak_loading_pct_24h": r1(svc.risk["peak_loading_pct"][i]),    │
     │ "hotspot_peak_c_24h": r1(svc.risk["hotspot_peak_c"][i]),                │
     │         "deficit_slots_24h": int(svc.risk["deficit_slots"][i]),         │
     │         "capped_now": int((state == c.METER_CAPPED).sum()), "out_now":  │
     │ int(np.isin(state, OUT_STATES).sum()),                                  │
     │         "cap_level": levels.get(dt.id, 0), "critical_count":            │
     │ int((world.fac_dt == i).sum()),                                         │
     │         "life_support_count": int(cons.life_support[sl].sum()),         │
     │         "served_fraction": r3(1 - float(tr.burden_kwh[sl].sum()) /      │
     │ entitled) if entitled > 0 else 1.0,                                     │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def transformers(svc, sd_id: str | None = None, risk: str | None =      │
     │ None) -> dict:                                                          │
     │     levels = _active_levels(svc)                                        │
     │     rows = [_dt_row(svc, i, levels) for i in _dt_scope(svc, sd_id)]     │
     │     if risk:                                                            │
     │         rows = [r for r in rows if r["risk_level"] in risk.split(",")]  │
     │     return {"items": rows}                                              │

     │ def transformer_profile(svc, dt_id: str) -> dict:                       │
     │     world, repo, net = svc.world, svc.repo, svc.repo.network            │
     │     i = repo.dt_index(dt_id)                                            │
     │     dt, cons = net.transformers[i], repo.consumers                      │

     │     feeder = repo.feeder(dt.feeder_id)                                  │
     │     tr = world.solution                                                 │

     │     amb = float(world.temp_hist[i, -1])                                 │

     │         **row,                                                          │
     │         "feeder": {"id": feeder.id, "name": feeder.name, "capacity_kw": │

     │         "history": [{"at": iso(h.at), "loading_pct": r1(h.loading[i] *  │
     │ 100), "hotspot_c": r1(h.hotspot[i]),                                    │
     │                      "v_min_pu": r3(h.v_min[i]), "on":                  │
     │ bool(h.dt_on[i])} for h in list(world.log)[-DAY:]],                     │

     │ r1(tr.to_rise[i]), "hotspot_c": r1(tr.hotspot[i]),                      │

     │ "dynamic_limit_pu": r3(dynamic_limit_pu(amb)),                          │
     │                     "steady_hotspot_c": r1(hot_spot_temp(amb,           │
     │ top_oil_rise_ultimate(k), k)),                                          │
     │                     "lol_pct": round(float(tr.lol_pct[i]), 5),          │
     │ "base_lol_pct": round(float(world.baseline.lol_pct[i]), 5)},            │
     │         "critical": [{"id": f.id, "name": f.name, "kind": f.kind,       │
     │ "load_kw": f.load_kw, "backup_minutes": f.backup_minutes}               │
     │                      for f in net.critical_facilities if f.dt_id ==     │
     │ dt_id],                                                                 │
     │         "assets": {"hubs": [{"id": h.id, "name": h.name, "max_kw":      │
     │ h.max_kw} for h in net.charger_hubs if h.dt_id == dt_id],               │
     │                    "storage": [{"id": u.id, "name": u.name,             │
     │ "energy_kwh": u.energy_kwh, "power_kw": u.power_kw}                     │
     │                                for u in net.storage_units if u.dt_id == │
     │ dt_id],                                                                 │
     │                    "shifts": [{"id": s.id, "name": s.name, "kind":      │
     │ s.kind, "power_kw": s.power_kw}                                         │
     │                               for s in net.shiftable_loads if s.dt_id   │
     │ == dt_id]},                                                             │
     │         "tier_mix": {name: int((cons.arch[sl] == k_).sum()) for k_,     │
     │ name in enumerate(c.ARCHETYPES)},                                       │
     │         "plans": [{"id": p.id, "status": p.status, "start":             │
     │ p.window.start, "end": p.window.end,                                    │
     │                    "cap_level": next((a.cap_level for a in p.dt_actions │
     │ if a.dt_id == dt_id), 0)}                                               │
     │                   for p in                                              │
     │ svc.planner.list(subdivision_id=dt.subdivision_id)],                    │
     │     }                                                                   │

     │ def transformer_meters(svc, dt_id: str) -> dict:                        │
     │     repo, cons = svc.repo, svc.repo.consumers                           │
     │     i = repo.dt_index(dt_id)                                            │
     │     sl = cons.dt_slices[i]                                              │
     │     sol = svc.last_sol                                                  │
     │     n = sl.stop - sl.start                                              │
     │     state = sol.meter_state[sl] if sol else np.zeros(n, dtype=np.uint8) │
     │     served = sol.served[sl] if sol else np.zeros(n)                     │
     │     caps = svc.dispatcher.actions(sol.at).cap_kw[sl] if sol else        │
     │ np.full(n, np.inf)                                                      │
     │     items = [{"id": cons.ids[sl.start + j], "tier":                     │
     │ f"T{int(cons.tier[sl.start + j])}",                                     │
     │               "archetype": c.ARCHETYPES[int(cons.arch[sl.start + j])],  │
     │ "kw": r3(served[j]),                                                    │
     │               "cap_w": int(round(caps[j] * 1000)) if                    │
     │ np.isfinite(caps[j]) else None,                                         │
     │               "state": c.METER_STATE_NAMES[int(state[j])],              │
     │ "life_support": bool(cons.life_support[sl.start + j]),                  │
     │               "solar_kw": r2(cons.solar_kw[sl.start + j]), "node":      │
     │ int(cons.node[sl.start + j])} for j in range(n)]                        │
     │     return {"dt_id": dt_id, "items": items,                             │
     │             "summary": {name: int((state == k).sum()) for k, name in    │
     │ enumerate(c.METER_STATE_NAMES)}}                                        │

     │ def transformer_lv(svc, dt_id: str) -> dict:                            │
     │     world, repo, cons = svc.world, svc.repo, svc.repo.consumers         │
     │     i = repo.dt_index(dt_id)                                            │
     │     dt, sl, sol = repo.network.transformers[i], cons.dt_slices[i],      │
     │ svc.last_sol                                                            │
     │     n_nodes = len(dt.lv.parent)                                         │
     │     served = sol.served[sl] if sol else np.zeros(sl.stop - sl.start)    │
     │     load = np.bincount(cons.node[sl], weights=served,                   │
     │ minlength=n_nodes)                                                      │
     │     pv = float(sol.pv_kw[i]) if sol else 0.0                            │
     │     unit = pv / world.solar_sum_dt[i] if world.solar_sum_dt[i] > 0 else │
     │ 0.0                                                                     │
     │     gen = np.bincount(cons.node[sl], weights=cons.solar_kw[sl] * unit,  │
     │ minlength=n_nodes)                                                      │
     │     s = int(repo.dt_subdivision_index[i])                               │
     │     source = 1.0 - 0.03 * min(1.2, float(sol.sd_supplied_kw[s]) /       │
     │ float(world.alloc[s])) if sol else 1.0                                  │
     │     res = dt_powerflow(dt.lv, load, gen, source_pu=source)              │
     │     return {"dt_id": dt_id, "source_pu": r3(source), "v_min":           │
     │ r3(res.v_min), "v_max": r3(res.v_max), "loss_kw": r2(res.loss_kw),      │
     │             "limits": {"v_min_pu": c.V_MIN_PU, "v_max_pu": c.V_MAX_PU}, │
     │             "nodes": [{"id": k, "parent": dt.lv.parent[k], "length_km": │
     │ dt.lv.length_km[k], "load_kw": r2(load[k]),                             │
     │                        "gen_kw": r2(gen[k]), "v_pu": r3(res.v_pu[k]),   │
     │ "amps": r1(res.edge_amps[k]),                                           │
     │                        "meters": int((cons.node[sl] == k).sum())} for k │
     │ in range(n_nodes)]}                                                     │
     │                                                                         │

     │ def critical(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                    │
     │     world, net, cons = svc.world, svc.repo.network, svc.repo.consumers  │
     │     wanted = set(_scope(svc, sd_id))                                    │
     │     sol, base = svc.last_sol, svc.last_base                             │
     │     shiftable = {s.critical_facility_id for s in net.shiftable_loads}   │
     │     items = []                                                          │
     │     for k, f in enumerate(net.critical_facilities):                     │
     │         if int(world.fac_sd[k]) not in wanted:                          │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         dt_i = int(world.fac_dt[k])                                     │
     │         on = bool(sol.dt_on[dt_i]) if sol else True                     │
     │         base_on = bool(base.dt_on[dt_i]) if base else True              │
     │         items.append({"id": f.id, "name": f.name, "kind": f.kind,       │
     │ "dt_id": f.dt_id, "subdivision_id": f.subdivision_id,                   │
     │                       "load_kw": f.load_kw, "backup_minutes":           │
     │ f.backup_minutes, "lat": f.lat, "lng": f.lng,                           │
     │                       "backup_left_min":                                │
     │ int(world.solution.backup_left[k]),                                     │
     │                       "powered": bool(on or                             │
     │ world.solution.backup_left[k] > 0), "supply_on": on,                    │
     │                       "base_powered": bool(base_on or                   │
     │ world.baseline.backup_left[k] > 0), "shiftable": f.id in shiftable})    │
     │     by_sd = [{"subdivision_id": world.sd_ids[s], "count":               │
     │ int(cons.life_support[world.sd_cons[s]].sum())} for s in                │
     │ sorted(wanted)]                                                         │
     │     return {"items": items, "life_support": {"count": sum(r["count"]    │
     │ for r in by_sd), "by_subdivision": by_sd}}                              │
     │                                                                         │

     │ forecast                                                                │

     │                                                                         │
     │ def _fc_times(svc, n: int) -> list[str]:                                │
     │     fc = svc.planner.forecast                                           │
     │     return [iso(fc.start + k * STEP) for k in range(n)]                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def forecast_dt(svc, dt_id: str, hours: int = 36) -> dict:              │
     │     world, fc = svc.world, svc.planner.forecast                         │
     │     i = svc.repo.dt_index(dt_id)                                        │
     │     n = min(fc.horizon, hours * 4)                                      │
     │     times = _fc_times(svc, n)                                           │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "dt_id": dt_id, "issued_at": iso(fc.issued_at), "mode":         │
     │ fc.mode, "rating_kw": r1(svc.repo.rating_kw[i]),                        │
     │         "points": [{"at": times[k], "p10": r1(fc.net_kw[i, k, 0]),      │
     │ "p50": r1(fc.net_kw[i, k, 1]), "p90": r1(fc.net_kw[i, k, 2]),           │
     │                     "pv_kw": r1(fc.pv_kw[i, k]), "limit_kw":            │
     │ r1(fc.limit_kw[i, k]), "temp_c": r1(fc.temp[i, k])} for k in range(n)], │
     │         "actual": [{"at": iso(h.at), "kw": r1(h.loading[i] *            │
     │ svc.repo.rating_kw[i]), "on": bool(h.dt_on[i])}                         │
     │                    for h in list(world.log)[-DAY:]],                    │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def forecast_subdivision(svc, sd_id: str | None = None, hours: int =    │
     │ 36) -> dict:                                                            │
     │     world, fc = svc.world, svc.planner.forecast                         │
     │     sds = _scope(svc, sd_id)                                            │
     │     idx = _dt_scope(svc, sd_id)                                         │
     │     n = min(fc.horizon, hours * 4)                                      │
     │     times = _fc_times(svc, n)                                           │
     │     q = fc.net_kw[idx, :n, :].sum(axis=0) * (1 + c.HT_LOSS_FRAC)        │
     │     avail = fc.avail_kw[sds, :n].sum(axis=0)                            │
     │     gap = fc.gap_kw[sds, :n].sum(axis=0)                                │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "scope": sd_id or "all", "issued_at": iso(fc.issued_at),        │
     │ "mode": fc.mode,                                                        │
     │         "points": [{"at": times[k], "p10": r1(q[k, 0]), "p50": r1(q[k,  │
     │ 1]), "p90": r1(q[k, 2]), "avail_kw": r1(avail[k]),                      │
     │                     "gap_kw": r1(gap[k])} for k in range(n)],           │
     │         "actual": [{"at": iso(h.at), "natural_kw":                      │
     │ r1(h.sd_natural_kw[sds].sum()), "avail_kw":                             │
     │ r1(h.sd_avail_kw[sds].sum()),                                           │
     │                     "supplied_kw": r1(h.sd_supplied_sol[sds].sum()),    │
     │ "base_supplied_kw": r1(h.sd_supplied_base[sds].sum()),                  │
     │                     "out": int(h.sd_out_sol[sds].sum()), "base_out":    │
     │ int(h.sd_out_base[sds].sum())}                                          │
     │                    for h in list(world.log)[-DAY:]],                    │
     │     }                                                                   │

     │ def forecast_model(svc) -> dict:                                        │
     │     path = svc.settings.data_dir / "models" / "backtest.json"           │
     │     backtest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if          │
     │ path.exists() else None                                                 │
     │     return {"mode": svc.forecaster.mode, "features":                    │
     │ list(svc.forecaster.meta.get("features", [])),                          │
     │             "conformal_q_hat": svc.forecaster.q_hat, "backtest":        │
     │ backtest, "shape_source": svc.load_model.shape_source,                  │
     │             "weather_source": svc.weather.scenario.source,              │
     │             "label": "Trained on simulated meter history calibrated to  │
     │ public Indian load shapes"}                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ MATRIX_SCALES = {                                                       │
     │     "loading": ([70, 90, 100, 120], True), "hotspot": ([90, 105, 120,   │
     │ 140], True), "voltage": ([0.97, 0.955, 0.94, 0.92], False),             │
     │ }                                                                       │

     │ def dt_hour_matrix(svc, metric: str = "loading", window: str = "next",  │
     │ sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                                      │
     │     """24 hourly columns. window 'next' uses the forecast (loading,     │
     │ hotspot); 'last' uses history (all three)."""                           │
     │     world, fc, net = svc.world, svc.planner.forecast, svc.repo.network  │
     │     idx = _dt_scope(svc, sd_id)                                         │
     │     if metric not in MATRIX_SCALES or (window == "next" and metric ==   │
     │ "voltage"):                                                             │
     │         raise NotFoundError("Matrix", f"{metric}/{window}")             │
     │     if window == "next":                                                │
     │         k = np.maximum(fc.plan_net_kw[:, :DAY] / svc.repo.rating_kw[:,  │
     │ None], 0.0)                                                             │
     │         data = k * 100 if metric == "loading" else                      │
     │ hot_spot_temp(fc.temp[:, :DAY], top_oil_rise_ultimate(k), k)            │
     │         hours = [iso(fc.start + h * 4 * STEP) for h in range(24)]       │
     │         grid = data.reshape(world.D, 24, 4).max(axis=2)                 │
     │     else:                                                               │
     │         log = list(world.log)[-DAY:]                                    │
     │         pad = DAY - len(log)                                            │
     │         attr = {"loading": "loading", "hotspot": "hotspot", "voltage":  │
     │ "v_min"}[metric]                                                        │
     │         raw = np.stack([getattr(h, attr) for h in log],                 │
     │ axis=1).astype(float) if log else np.zeros((world.D, 0))                │
     │         if metric == "loading":                                         │
     │             raw = raw * 100                                             │
     │         if metric == "voltage":                                         │
     │             raw = np.where(raw > 0, raw, np.nan)                        │
     │         raw = np.concatenate([np.full((world.D, pad), np.nan), raw],    │
     │ axis=1)                                                                 │
     │         first = (log[0].at if log else svc.world.now) - pad * STEP      │
     │         hours = [iso(first + h * 4 * STEP) for h in range(24)]          │
     │         block = raw.reshape(world.D, 24, 4)                             │
     │         with np.errstate(all="ignore"):                                 │
     │             grid = np.nanmin(block, axis=2) if metric == "voltage" else │
     │ np.nanmax(block, axis=2)                                                │
     │     thresholds, worse = MATRIX_SCALES[metric]                           │
     │     digits = 3 if metric == "voltage" else 1                            │
     │     return {"metric": metric, "window": window, "hours": hours,         │
     │ "thresholds": thresholds, "higher_is_worse": worse,                     │
     │             "rows": [{"dt_id": net.transformers[i].id, "name":          │
     │ net.transformers[i].name,                                               │
     │                       "subdivision_id":                                 │
     │ net.transformers[i].subdivision_id,                                     │
     │                       "values": [None if np.isnan(v) else               │
     │ round(float(v), digits) for v in grid[i]]} for i in idx]}               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │

     │ def deficits(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                    │
     │     wanted = {svc.world.sd_ids[s] for s in _scope(svc, sd_id)}          │
     │     live = ("pending", "approved", "scheduled", "active")               │
     │     rows = [{**p.window.model_dump(), "plan_id": p.id, "plan_status":   │
     │ p.status, "priority": p.priority}                                       │
     │             for p in svc.planner.list() if p.subdivision_id in wanted   │
     │ and p.status in live]                                                   │

     │     if sd_id is not None:                                               │
     │         _scope(svc, sd_id)                                              │

     │ sd_id)]}                                                                │

     │ def plan_funnel(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                 │
     │     wanted = {svc.world.sd_ids[s] for s in _scope(svc, sd_id)}          │
     │     rows = [p for p in svc.planner.plans.values() if p.subdivision_id   │
     │ in wanted]                                                              │
     │     approved = ("approved", "scheduled", "active", "completed",         │
     │ "verified", "cancelled")                                                │
     │     dispatched = ("active", "completed", "verified")                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def count(group: list) -> dict:                                     │
     │         return {"proposed": len(group), "approved": sum(p.status in     │
     │ approved for p in group),                                               │
     │                 "dispatched": sum(p.status in dispatched for p in       │
     │ group), "verified": sum(p.status == "verified" for p in group),         │
     │                 "rejected": sum(p.status == "rejected" for p in group), │
     │ "expired": sum(p.status == "expired" for p in group)}                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     total = count(rows)                                                 │
     │     labels = {"proposed": "Proposed", "approved": "Approved",           │
     │ "dispatched": "Dispatched", "verified": "Verified"}                     │
     │     return {"stages": [{"key": k, "label": labels[k], "value":          │
     │ total[k]} for k in labels],                                             │
     │             "rejected": total["rejected"], "expired": total["expired"], │
     │             "by_subdivision": [{"subdivision_id": sd, **count([p for p  │
     │ in rows if p.subdivision_id == sd])} for sd in sorted(wanted)]}         │

     │ def flex_live(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                   │
     │     world, net, cons = svc.world, svc.repo.network, svc.repo.consumers  │
     │     sds = set(_scope(svc, sd_id))                                       │
     │     sol, row = svc.last_sol, (world.log[-1] if world.log else None)     │
     │     in_scope = np.isin(world.cons_sd, list(sds))                        │
     │     zero = {"levers": [{"lever": k, "kw_now": 0.0} for k in ("dr",      │
     │ "charging", "shift", "storage", "lifeline")],                           │
     │             "hubs": [], "storage": [], "shifts": [], "dr":              │
     │ {"participants_now": 0, "kw_now": 0.0},                                 │
     │             "lifeline": {"capped_now": 0, "protected_now": 0,           │
     │ "tripped_now": 0, "by_level": {"1": 0, "2": 0, "3": 0}}}                │
     │     if sol is None or row is None:                                      │
     │         return zero                                                     │
     │     day = world.days.get(world.days.ist_date(sol.at))                   │
     │     d = day.demand[:, ist_slot(sol.at)].astype(float)                   │
     │     state = sol.meter_state                                             │
     │     dr_mask = (state == c.METER_DR) & in_scope                          │
     │     cap_mask = (state == c.METER_CAPPED) & in_scope                     │
     │     dr_kw = float((d[dr_mask] * cons.flex_share[dr_mask]).sum()) *      │
     │ c.DR_FLEX_REALISED                                                      │
     │     cap_kw = float((d[cap_mask] - sol.served[cap_mask]).sum())          │
     │     hubs = [{"id": h.id, "name": h.name, "dt_id": h.dt_id,              │
     │ "subdivision_id": h.subdivision_id, "max_kw": h.max_kw,                 │
     │              "sched_kw": r1(row.hub_sched_kw[k]), "kw":                 │
     │ r1(row.hub_kw[k]),                                                      │
     │              "curtailed_kw": r1(max(0.0, float(row.hub_sched_kw[k] -    │
     │ row.hub_kw[k]))),                                                       │
     │              "deferred_kwh": r1(world.solution.hub_deferred_kwh[k]),    │
     │ "ocpp_id": h.ocpp_id}                                                   │
     │             for k, h in enumerate(net.charger_hubs) if                  │
     │ int(world.hub_sd[k]) in sds]                                            │
     │     storage = [{"id": u.id, "name": u.name, "kind": u.kind, "dt_id":    │
     │ u.dt_id, "subdivision_id": u.subdivision_id,                            │
     │                 "energy_kwh": u.energy_kwh, "power_kw": u.power_kw,     │
     │ "soc_pct": r1(row.soc[k] * 100), "kw": r1(row.storage_kw[k])}           │
     │                for k, u in enumerate(net.storage_units) if              │
     │ int(world.store_sd[k]) in sds]                                          │
     │     sched_shift = day.assets.shift_kw[:, ist_slot(sol.at)]              │
     │     shifts = [{"id": s.id, "name": s.name, "kind": s.kind, "dt_id":     │
     │ s.dt_id, "subdivision_id": s.subdivision_id,                            │
     │                "power_kw": s.power_kw, "sched_kw": r1(sched_shift[k]),  │
     │ "kw": r1(row.shift_kw[k]),                                              │
     │                "held": bool(sched_shift[k] > 0 and row.shift_kw[k] ==   │
     │ 0),                                                                     │
     │                "deferred_kwh":                                          │
     │ r1(world.solution.shift_deferred_kwh[k])}                               │
     │               for k, s in enumerate(net.shiftable_loads) if             │
     │ int(world.shift_sd[k]) in sds]                                          │
     │     levels = _active_levels(svc)                                        │
     │     by_level = {"1": 0, "2": 0, "3": 0}                                 │
     │     for i in _dt_scope(svc, sd_id):                                     │
     │         lvl = levels.get(svc.repo.dt_ids[i], 0)                         │
     │         if lvl:                                                         │
     │             by_level[str(lvl)] += int((state[cons.dt_slices[i]] ==      │
     │ c.METER_CAPPED).sum())                                                  │
     │     lever_kw = {"dr": dr_kw, "charging": sum(h["curtailed_kw"] for h in │
     │ hubs),                                                                  │
     │                 "shift": sum(s["sched_kw"] for s in shifts if           │
     │ s["held"]), "storage": sum(u["kw"] for u in storage),                   │
     │                 "lifeline": cap_kw}                                     │
     │     return {"levers": [{"lever": k, "kw_now": r1(vv)} for k, vv in      │
     │ lever_kw.items()], "hubs": hubs, "storage": storage,                    │
     │             "shifts": shifts, "dr": {"participants_now":                │
     │ int(dr_mask.sum()), "kw_now": r1(dr_kw)},                               │
     │             "lifeline": {"capped_now": int(cap_mask.sum()),             │
     │ "protected_now": int(((state == c.METER_PROTECTED) & in_scope).sum()),  │
     │                          "tripped_now": int(((state == c.METER_TRIPPED) │
     │ & in_scope).sum()), "by_level": by_level}}                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def asset_series(svc) -> dict:                                          │

     │ def dr_view(svc) -> dict:                                               │
     │     model = svc.dr_model                                                │
     │     rate = model.rate()                                                 │
     │     prior = PRIOR_ALPHA / (PRIOR_ALPHA + PRIOR_BETA)                    │
     │     done = svc.dispatcher.completed                                     │
     │     invited, accepted = sum(e["invited"] for e in done),                │
     │ sum(e["accepted"] for e in done)                                        │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "segments": [{"archetype": name, "rate_pct": r1(rate[k] * 100), │
     │ "prior_pct": r1(prior * 100),                                           │
     │                       "observations": int(model.alpha[k] +              │
     │ model.beta[k] - PRIOR_ALPHA - PRIOR_BETA)}                              │
     │                      for k, name in enumerate(c.ARCHETYPES)],           │
     │         "events": [{"plan_id": e["plan_id"], "subdivision_id":          │
     │ e["subdivision_id"], "at": e["at"], "invited": e["invited"],            │
     │                     "accepted": e["accepted"], "acceptance_pct": r1(100 │
     │ * e["accepted"] / e["invited"]) if e["invited"] else 0.0,               │
     │                     "rebate_paid_rs": e["rebate_paid_rs"]} for e in     │
     │ done],                                                                  │
     │         "totals": {"invited": invited, "accepted": accepted,            │
     │ "acceptance_pct": r1(100 * accepted / invited) if invited else 0.0,     │
     │                    "rebate_paid_rs": sum(e["rebate_paid_rs"] for e in   │
     │ done), "rebate_rs_per_kwh": c.DR_REBATE_RS_PER_KWH},                    │
     │     }                                                                   │

     │ def fairness_view(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:               │
     │     world, net, cons = svc.world, svc.repo.network, svc.repo.consumers  │
     │     sds = _scope(svc, sd_id)                                            │
     │     mask = np.isin(world.cons_sd, sds)                                  │
     │     tr = world.solution                                                 │
     │     burden, entitled = tr.burden_kwh[mask], tr.entitled_kwh[mask]       │
     │     has = float(entitled.sum()) > 0                                     │
     │     band_of_dt = np.array([c.INCOME_BANDS.index(d.income_band) for d in │
     │ net.transformers])                                                      │
     │     band_of_cons = band_of_dt[cons.dt_index]                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def group(m: np.ndarray) -> dict:                                   │
     │         ent = float(tr.entitled_kwh[m].sum())                           │
     │         return {"consumers": int(m.sum()), "burden_kwh":                │
     │ r1(tr.burden_kwh[m].sum()),                                             │
     │                 "served_fraction": r3(1 - float(tr.burden_kwh[m].sum()) │
     │ / ent) if ent > 0 else 1.0}                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     done = svc.dispatcher.completed                                     │
     │     commanded, acked = sum(e["commanded"] for e in done),               │
     │ sum(e["acked"] for e in done)                                           │
     │     issued = {"1": 0, "2": 0, "3": 0}                                   │
     │     for p in svc.planner.plans.values():                                │
     │         if p.status in ("scheduled", "active", "completed", "verified") │
     │ and p.subdivision_id in {world.sd_ids[s] for s in sds}:                 │
     │             for a in p.dt_actions:                                      │
     │                 if a.cap_level:                                         │
     │                     issued[str(a.cap_level)] += a.households_capped     │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "jain": r3(jain(served_fraction(burden, entitled))) if has else │
     │ 1.0, "gini": r3(gini(burden)),                                          │
     │         "lorenz": [[r3(x), r3(y)] for x, y in lorenz_points(burden)],   │
     │         "by_subdivision": [{"subdivision_id": world.sd_ids[s], "name":  │
     │ net.subdivisions[s].name, "kind": net.subdivisions[s].kind,             │
     │                             **group(world.cons_sd == s)} for s in sds], │
     │         "by_band": [{"band": band, **group(mask & (band_of_cons == k))} │
     │ for k, band in enumerate(c.INCOME_BANDS)],                              │
     │         "low_income": group(mask & cons.low_income),                    │
     │         "protected": {"life_support":                                   │
     │ int(cons.life_support[mask].sum()),                                     │
     │                       "critical_facilities": int(np.isin(world.fac_sd,  │
     │ sds).sum())},                                                           │
     │         "levels_issued": issued,                                        │
     │         "hes": {"commanded": commanded, "acked": acked, "success_pct":  │
     │ r2(100 * acked / commanded) if commanded else 100.0,                    │
     │                 "batches": len(svc.hes.batches)},                       │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # ----------------------------------------------------------------      │
     │ reliability, thermal, quality                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def reliability(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                 │
     │     world, net = svc.world, svc.repo.network                            │
     │     sds = _scope(svc, sd_id)                                            │
     │     key = sd_id or "all"                                                │
     │     n = int(sum(len(world.sd_cons[s]) for s in sds))                    │
     │     log = list(world.log)[-DAY:]                                        │
     │     wanted = {world.sd_ids[s] for s in sds}                             │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "consumers": n,                                                 │
     │         "solution": world.solution.metrics[key].to_dict(n), "baseline": │
     │ world.baseline.metrics[key].to_dict(n),                                 │
     │         "by_subdivision": [{"subdivision_id": world.sd_ids[s], "name":  │
     │ net.subdivisions[s].name, "kind": net.subdivisions[s].kind,             │
     │                             "ceew_outage_h_per_day":                    │
     │ CEEW_OUTAGE_H[net.subdivisions[s].kind],                                │
     │                             "solution":                                 │
     │ world.solution.metrics[world.sd_ids[s]].to_dict(len(world.sd_cons[s])), │
     │                             "baseline":                                 │
     │ world.baseline.metrics[world.sd_ids[s]].to_dict(len(world.sd_cons[s]))} │
     │ for s in sds],                                                          │
     │         "series": [{"at": iso(h.at), "out":                             │
     │ int(h.sd_out_sol[sds].sum()), "base_out":                               │
     │ int(h.sd_out_base[sds].sum()),                                          │
     │                     "capped": int(h.sd_capped_sol[sds].sum())} for h in │
     │ log],                                                                   │
     │         "events": [e for e in svc.events if e.get("subdivision_id") in  │
     │ wanted and e["type"] != "plan"][:60],                                   │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def thermal_view(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                │
     │     world = svc.world                                                   │
     │     idx = _dt_scope(svc, sd_id)                                         │
     │     levels = _active_levels(svc)                                        │
     │     log = list(world.log)[-DAY:]                                        │
     │     peak = np.stack([h.hotspot for h in log], axis=1).max(axis=1) if    │
     │ log else world.solution.hotspot                                         │
     │     items = []                                                          │
     │     for i in idx:                                                       │
     │         row = _dt_row(svc, i, levels)                                   │
     │         items.append({k: row[k] for k in ("id", "name",                 │
     │ "subdivision_id", "rating_kva", "loading_pct", "limit_pct",             │
     │ "hotspot_c",                                                            │
     │                                            "lol_pct", "base_lol_pct",   │
     │ "risk_level", "peak_loading_pct_24h", "hotspot_peak_c_24h")}            │
     │                      | {"hotspot_peak_c_last24h": r1(peak[i]),          │
     │ "ageing_factor": r2(ageing_factor(world.solution.hotspot[i])),          │
     │                         "lol_saved_pct":                                │
     │ round(float(world.baseline.lol_pct[i] - world.solution.lol_pct[i]),     │
     │ 5)})                                                                    │
     │     sol, base = world.solution.metrics[sd_id or "all"],                 │
     │ world.baseline.metrics[sd_id or "all"]                                  │
     │     return {"items": sorted(items, key=lambda r: -r["hotspot_c"]),      │
     │             "totals": {"overload_slots": sol.dt_overload_slots,         │
     │ "base_overload_slots": base.dt_overload_slots,                          │

     │ def power_quality(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:               │
     │     world = svc.world                                                   │
     │     idx = _dt_scope(svc, sd_id)                                         │
     │     levels = _active_levels(svc)                                        │

     │     vmin = np.stack([h.v_min for h in log], axis=1).astype(float) if    │

     │ np.ones((world.D, 1), dtype=bool)                                       │
     │     viol = ((vmin < c.V_MIN_PU) & on).sum(axis=1)                       │
     │     low = np.where(on, vmin, np.nan)                                    │

     │     for i in idx:                                                       │
     │         row = _dt_row(svc, i, levels)                                   │

     │             worst = float(np.nanmin(low[i])) if on[i].any() else 0.0    │
     │         kw = max(row["kw"], 1e-9)                                       │

     │                      | {"violation_slots_24h": int(viol[i]),            │
     │ "v_min_24h": r3(worst), "loss_pct": r2(100 * row["loss_kw"] / kw)})     │
     │     m = world.solution.metrics[sd_id or "all"]                          │

     │ def impact(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                      │
     │     world = svc.world                                                   │
     │     key = sd_id or "all"                                                │
     │     n = int(sum(len(world.sd_cons[s]) for s in _scope(svc, sd_id)))     │

     │ base.critical_interrupted_slots - sol.critical_interrupted_slots,       │

     │ sol.dt_overload_slots,                                                  │

     │ def kpi_tree(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:                    │
     │     k = svc.kpis(sd_id)                                                 │
     │     world = svc.world                                                   │
     │     m = world.solution.metrics[sd_id or "all"]                          │
     │     thermal = 100.0 * (1 - m.dt_overload_slots / m.dt_slots) if         │
     │ m.dt_slots else 100.0                                                   │
     │     fair = 100.0 * k["fairness_jain"]                                   │
     │     score = 0.4 * k["lifeline_availability_pct"] + 0.2 *                │
     │ k["critical_availability_pct"] + 0.2 * thermal + 0.2 * fair             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def state(v: float) -> str:                                         │
     │         return "healthy" if v >= 95 else "monitor" if v >= 85 else      │
     │ "stress" if v >= 70 else "critical"                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │     return {                                                            │
     │         "root": {"label": "Reliability index", "score": r1(score),      │
     │                  "sub": "40% lifeline availability, 20% critical loads, │
     │ 20% transformer health, 20% fairness"},                                 │
     │         "branches": [                                                   │
     │             {"id": "lifeline", "label": "Lifeline availability",        │
     │ "score": r1(k["lifeline_availability_pct"]), "unit": "%",               │
     │              "state": state(k["lifeline_availability_pct"]),            │
     │              "leaves": [{"label": "Homes without supply now", "value":  │
     │ str(k["out_now"])},                                                     │
     │                         {"label": "Baseline would be", "value":         │
     │ str(k["base_out_now"])},                                                │
     │                         {"label": "Household-outage-hours avoided",     │
     │ "value": f"{k['hoh_avoided']:.0f}"}]},                                  │
     │             {"id": "critical", "label": "Critical load availability",   │
     │ "score": r1(k["critical_availability_pct"]), "unit": "%",               │
     │              "state": state(k["critical_availability_pct"]),            │
     │              "leaves": [{"label": "Baseline availability", "value":     │
     │ f"{k['base_critical_availability_pct']:.1f}%"},                         │
     │                         {"label": "Critical facilities", "value":       │
     │ str(len(world.fac_dt))}]},                                              │
     │             {"id": "thermal", "label": "Transformer health", "score":   │
     │ r1(thermal), "unit": "%", "state": state(thermal),                      │
     │              "leaves": [{"label": "Overload intervals", "value":        │
     │ str(k["dt_overload_slots"])},                                           │
     │                         {"label": "Baseline overload intervals",        │
     │ "value": str(k["base_dt_overload_slots"])},                             │
     │                         {"label": "Trips avoided", "value":             │
     │ str(k["base_dt_trips"] - k["dt_trips"])}]},                             │
     │             {"id": "fairness", "label": "Fairness (Jain index)",        │
     │ "score": r1(fair), "unit": "", "state": state(fair),                    │
     │              "leaves": [{"label": "Meters on a lifeline limit now",     │
     │ "value": str(k["capped_now"])},                                         │
     │                         {"label": "Plans verified", "value":            │
     │ str(k["plans_verified"])}]},                                            │
     │         ],                                                              │
     │     }                                                                   │

     │ def briefing_facts(svc, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:              │

     │ def consumer_home(svc, consumer_id: str) -> dict:                       │
     │     world, repo, cons = svc.world, svc.repo, svc.repo.consumers         │

     │         t0, t1 = start + timedelta(hours=h), start + timedelta(hours=h  │
     │ + 1)                                                                    │
     │         status, cap_w = "normal", None                                  │
     │         for p in live:                                                  │
     │             if parse_iso(p.window.start) < t1 and t0 <                  │
     │ parse_iso(p.window.end):                                                │
     │                 level = next((a.cap_level for a in p.dt_actions if      │
     │ a.dt_id == dt.id), 0)                                                   │
     │                 if exempt:                                              │

     │                 elif level:                                             │
     │                     lv = c.CAP_LEVELS[level]                            │
     │                     status, cap_w = "lifeline", (lv.t1_w if tier == 1   │
     │ else lv.t2_w)                                                           │
     │                 elif status == "normal":                                │
     │                     status = "save" if p.dr_actions else "normal"       │
     │                 if p.status == "pending" and status != "normal":        │
     │                     status += "_expected"                               │
     │         hours.append({"at": iso(t0), "status": status, "cap_w": cap_w}) │
     │     msgs = svc.channels.messages(consumer_id=consumer_id, limit=20)     │

     │ int(round(cap_now * 1000)) if np.isfinite(cap_now) else None},          │

     │ tier == 1 else c.CAP_LEVELS[3].t2_w),                                   │

     │ def federation(svc) -> dict:                                            │
     │     world, net = svc.world, svc.repo.network                            │
     │     nodes = []                                                          │
     │     for d in net.discoms:                                               │
     │         sds = [s for s, sd in enumerate(net.subdivisions) if            │
     │ sd.discom_id == d.id]                                                   │
     │         n = int(sum(len(world.sd_cons[s]) for s in sds))                │
     │         sol, base = _sum_metrics(world.solution.metrics, world, sds),   │
     │ _sum_metrics(world.baseline.metrics, world, sds)                        │
     │         mask = np.isin(world.cons_sd, sds)                              │
     │         tr = world.solution                                             │
     │         flex_kw = float(sum(net.charger_hubs[k].max_kw for k in         │
     │ range(len(net.charger_hubs)) if int(world.hub_sd[k]) in sds)            │
     │                         + sum(u.power_kw for k, u in                    │
     │ enumerate(net.storage_units) if int(world.store_sd[k]) in sds)          │
     │                         + sum(s.power_kw for k, s in                    │
     │ enumerate(net.shiftable_loads) if int(world.shift_sd[k]) in sds))       │
     │         nodes.append({"discom_id": d.id, "discom": d.short, "name":     │
     │ d.name, "subdivisions": len(sds), "consumers": n,                       │
     │                       "saidi_min": r1(sol.saidi_min(n)),                │
     │ "base_saidi_min": r1(base.saidi_min(n)),                                │
     │                       "lifeline_availability_pct":                      │
     │ r1(sol.lifeline_availability_pct),                                      │
     │                       "fairness_jain":                                  │
     │ r3(jain(served_fraction(tr.burden_kwh[mask], tr.entitled_kwh[mask])))   │
     │ if tr.entitled_kwh[mask].sum() > 0 else 1.0,                            │
     │                       "flexible_kw": r1(flex_kw), "hoh_avoided":        │
     │ r1(base.hoh - sol.hoh)})                                                │
     │     return {"nodes": nodes, "note": "Aggregates only. Consumer-level    │
     │ data stays inside each DISCOM node."}                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _sum_metrics(metrics: dict, world, sds: list[int]):                 │
     │     from app.grid.metrics import Metrics                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     total = Metrics()                                                   │
     │     for s in sds:                                                       │
     │         total.add(metrics[world.sd_ids[s]])                             │
     │     total.slots = metrics["all"].slots                                  │
     │     return total                                                        │

     │ def timeline(svc, sd_id: str | None = None, limit: int = 50) -> dict:   │
     │     wanted = {svc.world.sd_ids[s] for s in _scope(svc, sd_id)}          │
     │     return {"events": [e for e in svc.events if e.get("subdivision_id") │
     │ in wanted and e.get("track", "solution") == "solution"][:limit]}        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ _sum_metrics is defined after its first use to keep the public          │
     │ functions together; Python resolves it at call time.                    │

     │ from collections.abc import Callable                                    │
     │ from typing import Any                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid.service import GridService                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def locked(service: GridService, fn: Callable[..., Any], *args,         │
     │ **kwargs) -> Any:                                                       │
     │     """Run a read model while holding the service lock, so the tick     │
     │ thread cannot change the world mid-read."""                             │
     │     with service.lock:                                                  │
     │         return fn(service, *args, **kwargs)                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Write the read routers                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ network.py:                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.api.deps import get_grid_service                               │
     │ from app.api.v1._util import locked                                     │
     │ from app.grid import views                                              │
     │ from app.grid.service import GridService                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1", tags=["network"])                  │
     │ SD = Query(default=None, alias="subdivision_id")                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.get("/subdivisions")                                            │
     │ def subdivisions(svc: GridService = Depends(get_grid_service)) -> dict: │
     │     return locked(svc, views.subdivisions)                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.get("/feeders")                                                 │
     │ def feeders(sd: str | None = SD, svc: GridService =                     │
     │ Depends(get_grid_service)) -> dict:                                     │
     │     return locked(svc, views.feeders, sd)                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │

     │ GridService = Depends(get_grid_service)) -> dict:                       │

     │     return locked(svc, views.critical, sd)                              │

     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.get("/geo/service-areas")                                       │
     │ def service_areas(svc: GridService = Depends(get_grid_service)) ->      │
     │ dict:                                                                   │
     │     return svc.repo.service_areas                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.get("/geo/feeders")                                             │
     │ def geo_feeders(svc: GridService = Depends(get_grid_service)) -> dict:  │
     │     """Feeder paths. Road-following paths come from                     │
     │ data/feeder_routes.json when the build script has run;                  │
     │     otherwise each feeder is drawn substation to DT to DT in electrical │
     │ order."""                                                               │
     │     net = svc.repo.network                                              │
     │     routes_path = svc.settings.data_dir / "feeder_routes.json"          │
     │     routes = json.loads(routes_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if     │
     │ routes_path.exists() else {}                                            │
     │     ss = {s.id: s for s in net.substations}                             │
     │     out = []                                                            │
     │     for f in net.feeders:                                               │
     │         path = routes.get(f.id)                                         │
     │         if not path:                                                    │
     │             path = [[ss[f.substation_id].lat, ss[f.substation_id].lng]] │
     │ + [[svc.repo.dt(d).lat, svc.repo.dt(d).lng] for d in f.dt_ids]          │
     │         out.append({"id": f.id, "name": f.name, "subdivision_id":       │
     │ f.subdivision_id, "path": path})                                        │
     │     return {"substations": [{"id": s.id, "name": s.name,                │
     │ "subdivision_id": s.subdivision_id, "lat": s.lat, "lng": s.lng} for s   │
     │ in net.substations],                                                    │
     │             "feeders": out, "attribution": net.attribution}             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ insights.py, forecast.py, flex.py, reliability.py, protocols.py and     │
     │ federation.py follow the identical pattern: one function per row of the │
     │ contract table, each return locked(svc, views.<function>, <query        │
     │ params in the order of the view's signature>). Use these exact          │
     │ signatures:                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # insights.py   router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/insights",           │
     │ tags=["insights"])                                                      │
     │ @router.get("/circle-summary")   -> locked(svc, views.circle_summary,   │
     │ sd)                                                                     │
     │ @router.get("/kpis")             -> svc.kpis(sd)                      # │
     │ kpis takes the lock itself                                              │
     │ @router.get("/dt-hour-matrix")   -> locked(svc, views.dt_hour_matrix,   │
     │ metric, window, sd)   # metric: str = "loading", window: str = "next"   │
     │ @router.get("/impact")           -> locked(svc, views.impact, sd)       │
     │ @router.get("/kpi-tree")         -> locked(svc, views.kpi_tree, sd)     │
     │ @router.get("/briefing")         -> locked(svc, views.briefing_facts,   │
     │ sd)                                                                     │
     │ @router.get("/timeline")         -> locked(svc, views.timeline, sd,     │
     │ limit)                  # limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200)          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # forecast.py   router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/forecast",           │
     │ tags=["forecast"])                                                      │
     │ @router.get("/transformers/{dt_id}") -> locked(svc, views.forecast_dt,  │
     │ dt_id, hours)        # hours: int = Query(36, ge=1, le=36)              │
     │ @router.get("/subdivisions")         -> locked(svc,                     │
     │ views.forecast_subdivision, sd, hours)                                  │
     │ @router.get("/model")                -> locked(svc,                     │
     │ views.forecast_model)                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # flex.py       router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/flex",               │
     │ tags=["flex"])                                                          │
     │ @router.get("/live")     -> locked(svc, views.flex_live, sd)            │
     │ @router.get("/series")   -> locked(svc, views.asset_series)             │
     │ @router.get("/dr")       -> locked(svc, views.dr_view)                  │
     │ @router.get("/fairness") -> locked(svc, views.fairness_view, sd)        │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # reliability.py router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1",                   │
     │ tags=["reliability"])                                                   │
     │ @router.get("/reliability")   -> locked(svc, views.reliability, sd)     │
     │ @router.get("/thermal")       -> locked(svc, views.thermal_view, sd)    │
     │ @router.get("/power-quality") -> locked(svc, views.power_quality, sd)   │
     │ @router.get("/audit")         -> {"items": list(svc.audit)[:limit]}     │
     │ # limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500)                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # protocols.py  router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1",                    │
     │ tags=["protocols"])                                                     │
     │ @router.get("/protocols")     -> locked(svc, views.protocols, protocol, │
     │ limit)   # protocol: str | None = None, limit: int = Query(100, ge=1,   │
     │ le=300)                                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ # federation.py router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/federation",         │
     │ tags=["federation"])                                                    │
     │ @router.get("/nodes")         -> locked(svc, views.federation)          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Write each as a real function with the same parameter style as          │
     │ network.py (the arrows above are shorthand for the function body's      │
     │ return).                                                                │

     │     with svc.lock:                                                      │
     │         i = _position(svc, consumer_id)                                 │

     │         for run in svc.dispatcher.runs.values():                        │

     │             if len(where) and "notify" in run.done and "start" not in   │
     │ run.done:                                                               │
     │                 run.dr_accept[where[0]] = body.accept                   │
     │                 run.accepted = int(run.dr_accept.sum())                 │
     │                 applied.append(run.plan_id)                             │
     │         return {"ok": True, "applies_to": applied}                      │

     │ from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query                           │
     │ from pydantic import BaseModel                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.api.deps import get_grid_service                               │

     │ class LifeSupportBody(BaseModel):                                       │
     │     consumer_id: str                                                    │
     │     reason: str                                                         │
     │     consent: bool                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _position(svc: GridService, consumer_id: str) -> int:               │
     │     ids = svc.repo.consumers.ids                                        │
     │     if consumer_id not in ids:                                          │
     │         raise NotFoundError("Consumer", consumer_id)                    │
     │     return ids.index(consumer_id)                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.get("/life-support")                                            │
     │ def life_support(sd: str | None = Query(default=None,                   │
     │ alias="subdivision_id"), svc: GridService = Depends(get_grid_service))  │
     │ -> dict:                                                                │
     │     cons, world = svc.repo.consumers, svc.world                         │
     │     added = set(svc.state.life_support_added)                           │
     │     items = []                                                          │
     │     for i in range(cons.n):                                             │
     │         if not cons.life_support[i]:                                    │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         sd_id = world.sd_ids[int(world.cons_sd[i])]                     │
     │         if sd and sd_id != sd:                                          │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         items.append({"consumer_id": cons.ids[i], "dt_id":              │
     │ svc.repo.dt_ids[int(cons.dt_index[i])], "subdivision_id": sd_id,        │
     │                       "registered": cons.ids[i] in added, "consent":    │
     │ svc.state.consents.get(cons.ids[i])})                                   │
     │     return {"items": items}                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.post("/life-support")                                           │
     │ def register(body: LifeSupportBody, user: User =                        │
     │ Depends(require_roles(*FIELD_ROLES)),                                   │
     │              svc: GridService = Depends(get_grid_service)) -> dict:     │
     │     if not body.consent:                                                │
     │         raise ApiError(422, "Consent is required to register a          │
     │ life-support home.", "consent_required")                                │
     │     with svc.lock:                                                      │
     │         i = _position(svc, body.consumer_id)                            │
     │         if svc.repo.consumers.tier[i] != 1:                             │
     │             raise ApiError(422, "Only a household can be registered as  │
     │ a life-support home.", "not_a_household")                               │
     │         svc.repo.consumers.life_support[i] = True                       │
     │         if body.consumer_id not in svc.state.life_support_added:        │
     │             svc.state.life_support_added.append(body.consumer_id)       │
     │         if body.consumer_id in svc.state.life_support_removed:          │
     │             svc.state.life_support_removed.remove(body.consumer_id)     │
     │         svc.state.consents[body.consumer_id] = {"by": user.username,    │
     │ "reason": body.reason[:200], "purpose": "life-support exemption"}       │
     │         svc.record_audit(user.username, "life_support.register",        │
     │ body.consumer_id, body.reason[:200])                                    │
     │         return {"ok": True, "consumer_id": body.consumer_id}            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @router.delete("/life-support/{consumer_id}")                           │
     │ def unregister(consumer_id: str, user: User =                           │
     │ Depends(require_roles(*FIELD_ROLES)),                                   │
     │                svc: GridService = Depends(get_grid_service)) -> dict:   │
     │     with svc.lock:                                                      │
     │         i = _position(svc, consumer_id)                                 │
     │         svc.repo.consumers.life_support[i] = False                      │
     │         if consumer_id in svc.state.life_support_added:                 │
     │             svc.state.life_support_added.remove(consumer_id)            │
