     │                                                                         │
     │ Files:                                                                  │
     │ - Create: backend/app/grid/scenario_lab.py,                             │
     │ backend/app/services/economics_service.py,                              │
     │ backend/app/api/v1/scenario.py, backend/app/api/v1/economics.py,        │
     │ backend/scripts/calibrate_world.py                                      │
     │ - Create (generated, committed): backend/data/calibration.json          │
     │ - Modify: backend/app/main.py (two routers)                             │
     │ - Test: backend/tests/test_scenario_lab.py,                             │
     │ backend/tests/test_economics.py                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Interfaces:                                                             │
     │ - scenario_lab.py: run_scenario(settings, repo, scenario_id, days=3,    │
     │ autopilot=True, firm_base=None, seed=None, use_cache=True) -> dict with │
     │ keys scenario, days, autopilot, impact, by_subdivision[], by_kind[],    │
     │ levers[], plans, daily[], equity, runtime_ms; clear_cache()             │
     │ - economics_service.py: ASSUMPTIONS: dict[str, dict] (each {value,      │
     │ unit, source, kind} where kind is "sourced" or "assumption");           │
     │ national_impact(hoh_reduction_pct: float) -> dict;                      │
     │ unit_economics(consumers_per_dt, hoh_reduction_pct,                     │
     │ overload_reduction_pct, overrides: dict | None = None) -> dict          │
     │ - Endpoints: GET /api/v1/scenario/presets, POST /api/v1/scenario/run    │
     │ body {scenario, days, autopilot?}, GET /api/v1/economics/defaults, GET  │
     │ /api/v1/economics/national-impact                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Why calibration exists. The brief asks for a reliability improvement    │
     │ "against a clearly defined baseline". The baseline here is not          │
     │ invented: the shadow baseline's outage hours are calibrated to the CEEW │
     │ smart-meter study (1.3 h/day in district headquarters, 3.5 h/day in     │
     │ notified town areas) by tuning one number per sub-division kind, the    │
     │ firm supply share. The improvement is then measured on the same         │
     │ simulated days.                                                         │
     │                                                                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write backend/app/grid/scenario_lab.py                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Batch runs: a fresh world driven as fast as it can go, with no       │
     │ real-time clock.                                                        │
     │ Used by the Scenario Lab endpoint, the calibration script and the       │
     │ fixture export."""                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import time                                                             │
     │ from datetime import timedelta                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.core.config import Settings                                    │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid import views                                              │
     │ from app.grid.network import NetworkRepository                          │
     │ from app.grid.service import GridService, default_start                 │
     │ from app.grid.store import MemoryStateStore                             │
     │ from app.grid.world import STEP                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ _CACHE: dict[tuple, dict] = {}                                          │
     │ LEVERS = ("dr", "charging", "shift", "storage", "lifeline", "residual") │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def clear_cache() -> None:                                              │
     │     _CACHE.clear()                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def run_scenario(settings: Settings, repo: NetworkRepository,           │
     │ scenario_id: str, days: int = 3, autopilot: bool = True,                │
     │                  firm_base: dict[str, float] | None = None, seed: int | │
     │ None = None, use_cache: bool = True) -> dict:                           │
     │     key = (scenario_id, days, autopilot, seed, tuple(sorted((firm_base  │
     │ or {}).items())), id(repo))                                             │
     │     if use_cache and key in _CACHE:                                     │
     │         return _CACHE[key]                                              │
     │     started = time.perf_counter()                                       │
     │     svc = GridService(settings.model_copy(update={"lifeline_autopilot": │
     │ autopilot}), repo, firm_base=firm_base,                                 │
     │                       time_fn=lambda: 0.0, store=MemoryStateStore())    │
     │     start = default_start()                                             │
     │     svc.boot(scenario_id, start=start, seed=seed)                       │
     │     svc.world.power_flow = False  # voltage is not part of the lab's    │
     │ metrics; this makes a 7 day run take seconds                            │
     │     daily, prev = [], (0.0, 0.0)                                        │
     │     for day in range(days):                                             │
     │         end = start + timedelta(days=day + 1)                           │
     │         while svc.world.now < end:                                      │
     │             svc.tick(min(end - STEP, svc.world.now + 95 * STEP))        │
     │         sol, base = svc.world.solution.metrics["all"],                  │
     │ svc.world.baseline.metrics["all"]                                       │
     │         daily.append({"day": day + 1, "hoh": round(sol.hoh - prev[0],   │
     │ 1), "base_hoh": round(base.hoh - prev[1], 1)})                          │
     │         prev = (sol.hoh, base.hoh)                                      │
     │     rel = views.reliability(svc)                                        │
     │     plans = list(svc.planner.plans.values())                            │
     │     acted = [p for p in plans if p.status in ("scheduled", "active",    │
     │ "completed", "verified")]                                               │
     │     energy = {k: sum(lv.energy_kwh for p in acted for lv in p.levers if │
     │ lv.lever == k) for k in LEVERS}                                         │
     │     total = sum(energy.values()) or 1.0                                 │
     │     by_sd = [{"subdivision_id": r["subdivision_id"], "name": r["name"], │
     │ "kind": r["kind"],                                                      │
     │               "ceew_outage_h_per_day": r["ceew_outage_h_per_day"],      │
     │               "outage_h_per_day":                                       │
     │ round(r["solution"]["outage_h_per_consumer_day"], 2),                   │
     │               "base_outage_h_per_day":                                  │
     │ round(r["baseline"]["outage_h_per_consumer_day"], 2),                   │
     │               "hoh": round(r["solution"]["hoh"], 1), "base_hoh":        │
     │ round(r["baseline"]["hoh"], 1),                                         │
     │               "consumers":                                              │
     │ len(svc.world.sd_cons[svc.world.sd_ids.index(r["subdivision_id"])]),    │
     │               "lifeline_availability_pct":                              │
     │ round(r["solution"]["lifeline_availability_pct"], 1),                   │
     │               "base_lifeline_availability_pct":                         │
     │ round(r["baseline"]["lifeline_availability_pct"], 1)}                   │
     │              for r in rel["by_subdivision"]]                            │
     │     by_kind = []                                                        │
     │     for kind in ("district_hq", "nta"):                                 │
     │         rows = [r for r in by_sd if r["kind"] == kind]                  │
     │         n = sum(r["consumers"] for r in rows) or 1                      │
     │         by_kind.append({"kind": kind, "consumers": n,                   │
     │ "ceew_outage_h_per_day": rows[0]["ceew_outage_h_per_day"] if rows else  │
     │ 0.0,                                                                    │
     │                         "base_outage_h_per_day":                        │
     │ round(sum(r["base_outage_h_per_day"] * r["consumers"] for r in rows) /  │
     │ n, 2),                                                                  │
     │                         "outage_h_per_day":                             │
     │ round(sum(r["outage_h_per_day"] * r["consumers"] for r in rows) / n,    │
     │ 2)})                                                                    │
     │     fair = views.fairness_view(svc)                                     │
     │     capped_pct = [p.projection.low_income_capped_pct for p in acted]    │
     │     sc = svc.weather.scenario                                           │
     │     out = {                                                             │
     │         "scenario": {"id": sc.id, "label": sc.label, "description":     │
     │ sc.description, "re_share": sc.re_share,                                │
     │                      "source": sc.source, "firm_share":                 │
     │ svc.supply.firm_base},                                                  │
     │         "days": days, "autopilot": autopilot, "impact":                 │
     │ views.impact(svc), "by_subdivision": by_sd, "by_kind": by_kind,         │
     │         "levers": [{"lever": k, "energy_kwh": round(v, 1), "share_pct": │
     │ round(100 * v / total, 1)} for k, v in energy.items()],                 │
     │         "plans": {"proposed": len(plans), "approved": len(acted),       │
     │ "verified": sum(p.status == "verified" for p in plans),                 │
     │                   "expired": sum(p.status == "expired" for p in         │
     │ plans)},                                                                │
     │         "daily": daily,                                                 │
     │         "equity": {"jain": fair["jain"], "low_income_served_fraction":  │
     │ fair["low_income"]["served_fraction"],                                  │
     │                    "low_income_capped_pct": round(sum(capped_pct) /     │
     │ len(capped_pct), 1) if capped_pct else 0.0},                            │
     │         "forecast_mode": svc.forecaster.mode, "intervals": days *       │
     │ c.SLOTS_PER_DAY,                                                        │
     │         "runtime_ms": round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000),    │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │     if use_cache:                                                       │
     │         _CACHE[key] = out                                               │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │

     │                            "source": "Team assumption for augmenting a  │
     │ DT to the next rating"},                                                │
     │     "upgrade_deferrable_share": {"value": 0.20, "unit": "share",        │
     │ "kind": "assumption",                                                   │
     │                                  "source": "Team assumption: DTs whose  │
     │ upgrade can be deferred by peak relief"},                               │
     │     "carrying_cost_rate": {"value": 0.10, "unit": "per year", "kind":   │
     │ "assumption",                                                           │
     │                            "source": "Team assumption: annual value of  │
     │ deferring capital"},                                                    │
     │     "saas_fee_rs_per_meter_month": {"value": 3.0, "unit": "Rs", "kind": │
     │ "assumption",                                                           │
     │                                     "source": "Team pricing assumption, │
     │ paid by the DISCOM; consumers pay nothing"},                            │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ OUTAGE_ROWS = (("Urban average (MoP)", 0.6), ("District HQ (CEEW)",     │
     │ 1.3), ("Notified town (CEEW)", 3.5))                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _v(key: str, overrides: dict | None = None):                        │
     │     if overrides and key in overrides:                                  │
     │         return overrides[key]                                           │
     │     return ASSUMPTIONS[key]["value"]                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def national_impact(hoh_reduction_pct: float) -> dict:                  │
     │     """Full-blackout household-hours avoided a year across installed    │
     │ smart meters, in crore."""                                              │
     │     meters = _v("smart_meters_installed")                               │
     │     shares = _v("addressable_share")                                    │
     │     reduction = hoh_reduction_pct / 100.0                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def cell(hours: float, share: float) -> float:                      │
     │         return round(meters * hours * 365 * share * reduction / 1e7, 1) │
     │                                                                         │
     │     cols = list(shares.items())                                         │
     │     cells = [[cell(h, s) for _, s in cols] for _, h in OUTAGE_ROWS]     │
     │     case = {name: {"crore_household_hours": cell(0.6, share),           │
     │ "addressable_share": share} for name, share in cols}                    │
     │     return {"unit": "crore household-hours a year",                     │
     │ "hoh_reduction_pct": hoh_reduction_pct, "meters": meters,               │
     │             "rows": [{"label": label, "outage_h_per_day": h} for label, │
     │ h in OUTAGE_ROWS],                                                      │
     │             "cols": [{"label": name, "addressable_share": s} for name,  │
     │ s in cols], "cells": cells, **case,                                     │
     │             "method": "meters x outage hours a day x 365 x addressable  │
     │ share x measured reduction"}                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def unit_economics(consumers_per_dt: float, hoh_reduction_pct: float,   │
     │ overload_reduction_pct: float,                                          │
     │                    overrides: dict | None = None) -> dict:              │
     │     """One distribution transformer, one year, in rupees."""            │
     │     share = _v("addressable_share", overrides)                          │
     │     share = share["base"] if isinstance(share, dict) else share         │
     │     cost = consumers_per_dt * _v("saas_fee_rs_per_meter_month",         │
     │ overrides) * 12                                                         │
     │     energy = (consumers_per_dt * _v("urban_outage_h_per_day",           │
     │ overrides) * 365 * share * hoh_reduction_pct / 100.0                    │
     │               * _v("avg_served_kw_in_deficit", overrides) *             │
     │ _v("energy_margin_rs_per_kwh", overrides))                              │
     │     failures = (_v("dt_failure_rate", overrides) *                      │
     │ _v("overload_failure_share", overrides) * overload_reduction_pct /      │
     │ 100.0                                                                   │
     │                 * _v("dt_repair_cost_rs", overrides))                   │
     │     deferral = _v("upgrade_deferrable_share", overrides) *              │
     │ _v("dt_upgrade_cost_rs", overrides) * _v("carrying_cost_rate",          │
     │ overrides)                                                              │
     │     benefits = {"energy_margin_rs": energy, "failures_avoided_rs":      │
     │ failures, "deferral_rs": deferral}                                      │
     │     benefit = sum(benefits.values())                                    │
     │     return {"consumers_per_dt": consumers_per_dt, "cost_rs": cost,      │
     │ "consumer_cost_rs": 0, "benefits": benefits,                            │
     │             "benefit_rs": benefit, "net_rs": benefit - cost,            │
     │             "benefit_cost_ratio": round(benefit / cost, 2) if cost else │
     │ 0.0,                                                                    │
     │             "payback_months": round(12 * cost / benefit, 1) if benefit  │
     │ else 0.0,                                                               │
     │             "cost_per_consumer_month_rs":                               │
     │ _v("saas_fee_rs_per_meter_month", overrides)}                           │
     │                                                                         │

     │ - [ ] Step 7: Write backend/scripts/calibrate_world.py                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Calibrates the firm supply share per sub-division kind so the shadow │
     │ baseline reproduces the                                                 │
     │ CEEW-measured outage hours on the heatwave scenario, then writes        │
     │ data/calibration.json.                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Bisection on one scalar per kind. Lower firm share means more shortfall │
     │ and more outage hours.                                                  │
     │ Both kinds are updated from the same run, so eight runs are enough.     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Run from backend/:  .venv/Scripts/python scripts/calibrate_world.py     │
     │ """                                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import sys                                                              │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]                              │
     │ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.core.config import get_settings                                │
     │ from app.grid.network import get_network_repository                     │
     │ from app.grid.scenario_lab import run_scenario                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ TARGET = {"district_hq": 1.3, "nta": 3.5}                               │
     │ DAYS, ROUNDS = 3, 8                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def main() -> int:                                                      │
     │     settings, repo = get_settings(), get_network_repository()           │
     │     lo = {k: 0.45 for k in TARGET}                                      │
     │     hi = {k: 0.99 for k in TARGET}                                      │
     │     firm, measured = {}, {}                                             │
     │     for r in range(ROUNDS):                                             │
     │         firm = {k: (lo[k] + hi[k]) / 2 for k in TARGET}                 │
     │         out = run_scenario(settings, repo, "heatwave_evening",          │
     │ days=DAYS, autopilot=False, firm_base=firm, use_cache=False)            │
     │         measured = {row["kind"]: row["base_outage_h_per_day"] for row   │
     │ in out["by_kind"]}                                                      │
     │         print(f"round {r + 1}: firm {firm}  baseline outage h/day       │
     │ {measured}")                                                            │
     │         for k in TARGET:                                                │
     │             if measured[k] > TARGET[k]:                                 │
     │                 lo[k] = firm[k]  # too many outages: raise the firm     │
     │ share                                                                   │
     │             else:                                                       │
     │                 hi[k] = firm[k]                                         │
     │     result = {"firm_share": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in firm.items()},  │
     │ "target_h_per_day": TARGET,                                             │
     │               "measured_h_per_day": measured, "scenario":               │
     │ "heatwave_evening", "days": DAYS,                                       │
     │               "source": "CEEW, What Smart Meters Can Tell Us (Mathura   │
     │ and Bareilly), 2020"}                                                   │
     │     (ROOT / "data" / "calibration.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,  │
     │ indent=1), encoding="utf-8")                                            │
     │     print("wrote calibration.json:", result["firm_share"])              │
     │     return 0                                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ if __name__ == "__main__":                                              │
     │     raise SystemExit(main())                                            │

     │ """Spoken-name resolvers for sub-divisions and transformers (pure, no   │
     │ network).                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ A speech recogniser hands the model things like "Faridpur ka            │
     │ transformer teen" or                                                    │
     │ "सुभाष नगर डीटी दो". `normalize` reduces those to a comparable Latin token   │
     │ string."""                                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import unicodedata                                                      │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass, field                                │
     │ from typing import Any                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from rapidfuzz import fuzz, process                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ _DEVANAGARI_DIGITS = {ord(ch): str(i) for i, ch in                      │
     │ enumerate("०१२३४५६७८९")}                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ _HINDI_NUMBERS = {                                                      │
     │     "ek": "1", "do": "2", "teen": "3", "char": "4", "chaar": "4",       │
     │ "paanch": "5", "panch": "5", "chhe": "6", "chah": "6",                  │
     │     "saat": "7", "aath": "8", "nau": "9", "das": "10", "gyarah": "11",  │
     │ "barah": "12",                                                          │
     │     "एक": "1", "दो": "2", "तीन": "3", "चार": "4", "पांच": "5", "पाँच": "5",    │
     │ "छह": "6", "सात": "7", "आठ": "8", "नौ": "9",                              │
     │     "दस": "10", "ग्यारह": "11", "बारह": "12",                              │
     │ }  # fmt: skip                                                          │
     │ _ENGLISH_NUMBERS = {w: str(i) for i, w in enumerate(                    │
     │     ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven",     │
     │ "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"]) if i > 0}                  │
     │ _ALIASES = {                                                            │
     │     "transformer": "dt", "transformers": "dt", "ट्रांसफार्मर": "dt",         │
     │ "ट्रांसफॉर्मर": "dt", "डीटी": "dt",                                            │
     │     "फीडर": "feeder", "सुभाष": "subhash", "नगर": "nagar", "इज्जतनगर":       │
     │ "izzatnagar", "इज़्ज़तनगर": "izzatnagar",                                  │
     │     "इज्जत": "izzat", "फरीदपुर": "faridpur", "कृष्णा": "krishna", "कृष्ण":      │
     │ "krishna", "कोसी": "kosi", "कलां": "kalan",                                 │
     │     "कलाँ": "kalan", "बरेली": "bareilly", "मथुरा": "mathura",                 │
     │ }  # fmt: skip                                                          │
     │ _FILLERS = frozenset(["ka", "ki", "ke", "wala", "wali", "wale", "the",  │
     │ "of", "का", "की", "के", "वाला", "sub", "division",                           │
     │                       "subdivision", "upkhand", "उपखंड", "number", "no", │
     │ "नंबर"])                                                                 │
     │ _TOKEN_MAP = {**_HINDI_NUMBERS, **_ENGLISH_NUMBERS, **_ALIASES}         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ _SUBDIVISION_ALIASES = {                                                │
     │     "subhash nagar": "sd_subhashnagar", "subhashnagar":                 │
     │ "sd_subhashnagar", "sn": "sd_subhashnagar",                             │
     │     "izzatnagar": "sd_izzatnagar", "izatnagar": "sd_izzatnagar", "izzat │
     │ nagar": "sd_izzatnagar", "iz": "sd_izzatnagar",                         │
     │     "faridpur": "sd_faridpur", "fp": "sd_faridpur",                     │
     │     "krishna nagar": "sd_krishnanagar", "krishnanagar":                 │
     │ "sd_krishnanagar", "kn": "sd_krishnanagar",                             │
     │     "kosi kalan": "sd_kosikalan", "kosikalan": "sd_kosikalan", "kosi":  │
     │ "sd_kosikalan", "kk": "sd_kosikalan",                                   │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def normalize(text: str) -> str:                                        │
     │     """Lowercase; punctuation to spaces; number words and Devanagari    │
     │ spellings to Latin and digits;                                          │
     │     leading zeros dropped; filler words removed."""                     │
     │     text = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", text or                         │
     │ "").lower().translate(_DEVANAGARI_DIGITS)                               │
     │     text = "".join(ch if unicodedata.category(ch)[0] in "LNM" else " "  │
     │ for ch in text)                                                         │
     │     tokens = []                                                         │
     │     for tok in text.split():                                            │
     │         if tok in _FILLERS:                                             │
     │             continue                                                    │
     │         tok = _TOKEN_MAP.get(tok, tok)                                  │
     │         if tok.isdigit():                                               │
     │             tok = tok.lstrip("0") or "0"                                │
     │         tokens.append(tok)                                              │
     │     return " ".join(tokens)                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _repo_data() -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:  │
     │     from app.grid.network import get_network_repository                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │     net = get_network_repository().network                              │
     │     return [s.model_dump() for s in net.subdivisions], [d.model_dump()  │
     │ for d in net.transformers]                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def resolve_subdivision(text: str | None, subdivisions: list[dict[str,  │
     │ Any]] | None = None) -> str | None:                                     │
     │     if not text or not text.strip():                                    │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │     if subdivisions is None:                                            │
     │         subdivisions, _ = _repo_data()                                  │
     │     ids = {s["id"] for s in subdivisions}                               │
     │     raw = text.strip()                                                  │
     │     if raw in ids:                                                      │
     │         return raw                                                      │
     │     choices: dict[str, str] = {}                                        │
     │     for alias, sid in _SUBDIVISION_ALIASES.items():                     │
     │         if sid in ids:                                                  │
     │             choices[normalize(alias)] = sid                             │
     │     for s in subdivisions:                                              │
     │         choices.setdefault(normalize(s["name"]), s["id"])               │
     │         choices.setdefault(normalize(s["name_hi"]), s["id"])            │
     │     query = normalize(raw)                                              │
     │     if not query:                                                       │
     │         return None                                                     │
     │     if query in choices:                                                │
     │         return choices[query]                                           │
     │     # Plain ratio, not the default WRatio: WRatio's partial matching    │
     │ would let the two-letter code                                           │
     │     # aliases ("fp", "sn") capture a transformer name such as "dt fp    │
     │ 2".                                                                     │
     │     hit = process.extractOne(query, list(choices), scorer=fuzz.ratio,   │
     │ score_cutoff=78)                                                        │
     │     return choices[hit[0]] if hit else None                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class TransformerMatch:                                                 │
     │     id: str                                                             │
     │     name: str                                                           │
     │     subdivision_id: str                                                 │
     │     score: float                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ @dataclass                                                              │
     │ class TransformerResolution:                                            │
     │     matches: list[TransformerMatch] = field(default_factory=list)       │
     │     ambiguous: bool = False                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     @property                                                           │
     │     def best(self) -> TransformerMatch | None:                          │
     │         return self.matches[0] if self.matches else None                │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _variants(dt: dict[str, Any], sd_name: str) -> list[str]:           │
     │     """ "dt sn 2", "dt subhash nagar 2", "subhash nagar dt 2", "subhash │
     │ nagar 2", and the id."""                                                │
     │     code = normalize(dt["name"])  # dt sn 2                             │
     │     number = code.split()[-1]                                           │
     │     sd = normalize(sd_name)                                             │
     │     return [code, f"dt {sd} {number}", f"{sd} dt {number}", f"{sd}      │
     │ {number}", normalize(dt["id"])]                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def resolve_transformer(text: str | None, subdivision: str | None =     │
     │ None, *, transformers: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,              │
     │                         subdivisions: list[dict[str, Any]] | None =     │
     │ None) -> TransformerResolution:                                         │
     │     """Up to three fuzzy matches, best first. `ambiguous` when the top  │
     │ two are within 4 points."""                                             │
     │     if not text or not text.strip():                                    │
     │         return TransformerResolution()                                  │
     │     if transformers is None or subdivisions is None:                    │
     │         s, t = _repo_data()                                             │
     │         subdivisions = subdivisions if subdivisions is not None else s  │
     │         transformers = transformers if transformers is not None else t  │
     │     raw = text.strip()                                                  │
     │     for dt in transformers:                                             │
     │         if dt["id"] == raw:                                             │
     │             return TransformerResolution([TransformerMatch(dt["id"],    │
     │ dt["name"], dt["subdivision_id"], 100.0)])                              │
     │     sd_name = {s["id"]: s["name"] for s in subdivisions}                │
     │     scope = resolve_subdivision(subdivision, subdivisions) if           │
     │ subdivision else None                                                   │
     │     pool = [d for d in transformers if scope is None or                 │
     │ d["subdivision_id"] == scope]                                           │
     │     query = normalize(raw)                                              │
     │     if not query:                                                       │
     │         return TransformerResolution()                                  │
     │     if scope and not any(tok in query for tok in                        │
     │ normalize(sd_name[scope]).split()):                                     │
     │         query = f"{normalize(sd_name[scope])} {query}"                  │
     │     scored = []                                                         │
     │     for dt in pool:                                                     │
     │         best = max(fuzz.token_sort_ratio(query, v) for v in             │
     │ _variants(dt, sd_name[dt["subdivision_id"]]))                           │
     │         if best >= 72:                                                  │
     │             scored.append((best, dt))                                   │
     │     scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]["id"]))                      │
     │     matches = [TransformerMatch(d["id"], d["name"],                     │
     │ d["subdivision_id"], round(float(s), 1)) for s, d in scored[:3]]        │
     │     return TransformerResolution(matches, len(matches) > 1 and          │
     │ matches[0].score - matches[1].score <= 4)                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 4: Write backend/app/tools/grid_tools.py                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Fifteen read-only tools shared by the Gemini typed agent and the     │
     │ Sarvam voice agent.                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Only `ToolResult.llm` is shown to the model: compact, names instead of  │
     │ ids, rounded numbers, lists                                             │
     │ capped at 8 with a `more` count. `ToolResult.card` is an optional fact  │
     │ card for the UI.                                                        │
     │ Every fact comes from `app.grid.views`, so a spoken answer and a        │
     │ dashboard card can never disagree."""                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import inspect                                                          │
     │ from collections.abc import Callable                                    │
     │ from dataclasses import dataclass                                       │
     │ from datetime import timedelta                                          │
     │ from typing import Any                                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.grid import constants as c                                     │
     │ from app.grid import views                                              │
     │ from app.grid.clock import parse_iso                                    │
     │ from app.tools.resolve import resolve_subdivision, resolve_transformer  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ LIST_CAP = 8                                                            │
     │ IST = timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)                                    │
     │ ALL_WORDS = {"", "all", "circle", "everything", "none", "null", "all    │
     │ subdivisions", "sab", "poora", "सब"}                                    │

     │ TOOL_LABELS = {                                                         │
     │     "get_circle_briefing": "Reviewing all five sub-divisions",          │
     │     "get_subdivision_briefing": "Checking {subdivision} sub-division",  │
     │     "find_transformer": "Looking up the transformer",                   │
     │     "get_transformer_status": "Checking {transformer}",                 │
     │     "get_deficits": "Checking forecast shortfalls",                     │
     │     "compare_subdivisions": "Comparing sub-divisions",                  │
     │     "get_flex_plans": "Checking Flex Plans",                            │
     │     "get_flex_plan": "Opening the Flex Plan",                           │
     │     "get_lever_status": "Checking flexibility levers",                  │
     │     "get_critical_loads": "Checking critical loads",                    │
     │     "get_reliability": "Checking reliability",                          │
     │     "get_load_forecast": "Checking the load forecast",                  │
     │     "get_thermal_risks": "Checking transformer temperatures",           │
     │     "get_voltage_issues": "Checking voltages",                          │
     │     "get_fairness": "Checking the fairness ledger",                     │

     │ COMPARE_METRICS = {                                                     │
     │     "risk_index": ("risk_index", "index", True),                        │
     │     "outage_hours": ("outage_h_per_day", "hours a day", True),          │
     │     "baseline_outage_hours": ("base_outage_h_per_day", "hours a day",   │

     │     "outage_hours_avoided": ("hoh_avoided", "household-hours", True),   │

     │ def clock(iso_text: str | None) -> str | None:                          │
     │     """IST HH:MM for an ISO UTC timestamp."""                           │
     │     return (parse_iso(iso_text) + IST).strftime("%H:%M") if iso_text    │
     │ else None                                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def _cap(key: str, items: list[Any], n: int = LIST_CAP) -> dict[str,    │
     │ Any]:                                                                   │
     │     out: dict[str, Any] = {key: items[:n]}                              │
     │     if len(items) > n:                                                  │
     │         out["more"] = len(items) - n                                    │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def tool_label(name: str, args: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:   │
     │     args = args or {}                                                   │
     │     template = TOOL_LABELS.get(name, "Checking the data")               │
     │     if "{subdivision}" in template:                                     │
     │         sid = resolve_subdivision(str(args.get("subdivision") or ""))   │
     │         return template.format(subdivision=_SD_NAMES.get(sid, "the"))   │
     │ if sid else "Checking the sub-division"                                 │
     │     if "{transformer}" in template:                                     │
     │         res = resolve_transformer(str(args.get("transformer") or ""))   │
     │         return template.format(transformer=res.best.name) if res.best   │
     │ else "Checking the transformer"                                         │
     │     return template                                                     │

     │                                                                         │
     │ _SD_NAMES = {"sd_subhashnagar": "Subhash Nagar", "sd_izzatnagar":       │
     │ "Izzatnagar", "sd_faridpur": "Faridpur",                                │
     │              "sd_krishnanagar": "Krishna Nagar", "sd_kosikalan": "Kosi  │
     │ Kalan"}                                                                 │

     │ def build_tool_functions(service) -> dict[str, Callable[...,            │
     │ ToolResult]]:                                                           │
     │     net = service.repo.network                                          │
     │     sd_rows = [s.model_dump() for s in net.subdivisions]                │
     │     dt_rows = [d.model_dump() for d in net.transformers]                │
     │     sd_name = {s.id: s.name for s in net.subdivisions}                  │
     │     dt_name = {d.id: d.name for d in net.transformers}                  │
     │     known = [s.name for s in net.subdivisions]                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def view(fn, *args):                                                │
     │         with service.lock:                                              │
     │             return fn(service, *args)                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def sd_arg(text: Any) -> tuple[str | None, ToolResult | None]:      │
     │         """(sub-division id or None for all, error result)."""          │
     │         raw = str(text or "").strip()                                   │
     │         if raw.lower() in ALL_WORDS:                                    │
     │             return None, None                                           │
     │         sid = resolve_subdivision(raw, sd_rows)                         │
     │         if sid is None:                                                 │
     │             return None, ToolResult({"error": f"No sub-division matches │
     │ '{raw}'.", "known_subdivisions": known})                                │
     │         return sid, None                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def dt_arg(text: Any, subdivision: Any = None) -> tuple[str | None, │
     │ ToolResult | None]:                                                     │
     │         res = resolve_transformer(str(text or ""), str(subdivision) if  │
     │ subdivision else None, transformers=dt_rows, subdivisions=sd_rows)      │
     │         if res.best is None:                                            │
     │             return None, ToolResult({"error": f"No transformer matches  │
     │ '{text}'. Names look like DT-SN-03 or 'Faridpur transformer 2'."})      │
     │         if res.ambiguous:                                               │
     │             return None, ToolResult({"error": "More than one            │
     │ transformer matches. Ask which one.",                                   │
     │                                      "matches": [f"{m.name} in          │
     │ {sd_name[m.subdivision_id]}" for m in res.matches]})                    │
     │         return res.best.id, None                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def plan_line(p: dict) -> dict:                                     │
     │         levers = {lv["lever"]: lv["share_pct"] for lv in p["levers"] if │
     │ lv["share_pct"] > 0}                                                    │
     │         return {"subdivision": sd_name[p["subdivision_id"]], "status":  │
     │ p["status"], "priority": p["priority"],                                 │
     │                 "window": f"{clock(p['window']['start'])} to            │
     │ {clock(p['window']['end'])}",                                           │
     │                 "peak_gap_kw": round(p["window"]["peak_gap_kw"]),       │
     │ "confidence_pct": p["confidence"],                                      │
     │                 "homes_on_lifeline_limit":                              │
     │ p["projection"]["households_capped"],                                   │
     │                 "blackout_avoided_for_consumers":                       │
     │ p["projection"]["households_blackout_baseline"],                        │
     │                 "approve_before": clock(p["approval_deadline"]),        │
     │ "lever_share_pct": levers}                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_circle_briefing() -> ToolResult:                            │
     │         """Overview of all five sub-divisions together: risk, supply    │
     │ against demand, outages now, plans waiting, and the                     │
     │         reliability gain against rotational shedding. Use when no       │
     │ single sub-division is named."""                                        │
     │         s = view(views.circle_summary)                                  │
     │         t = s["totals"]                                                 │
     │         ranked = sorted(s["subdivisions"], key=lambda r:                │
     │ -r["risk_index"])                                                       │
     │         llm = {                                                         │
     │             "subdivisions": len(ranked), "transformers": t["dts"],      │
     │ "consumers": t["consumers"],                                            │
     │             "transformers_by_risk": t["risk_counts"],                   │
     │ "supply_short_now": t["deficit_now"],                                   │
     │             "demand_kw": round(t["natural_kw"]), "available_kw":        │
     │ round(t["avail_kw"]), "gap_kw": round(t["gap_kw"]),                     │
     │             "consumers_without_power_now": t["out_now"],                │
     │ "without_power_under_rotational_shedding": t["base_out_now"],           │
     │             "meters_on_lifeline_limit_now": t["capped_now"],            │
     │ "plans_waiting_for_approval": t["pending_plans"],                       │
     │             "plans_active": t["active_plans"], "next_shortfall_starts": │
     │ clock(t["next_deficit_at"]),                                            │
     │             "household_outage_hours_avoided": round(t["hoh_avoided"]),  │
     │             "lifeline_availability_pct":                                │
     │ t["lifeline_availability_pct"],                                         │
     │             "ranking_by_risk": [{"subdivision": r["name"],              │
     │ "risk_index": r["risk_index"],                                          │
     │                                  "critical_transformers":               │
     │ r["risk_counts"]["critical"], "gap_kw": round(r["gap_kw"])} for r in    │
     │ ranked],                                                                │
     │         }                                                               │
     │         card = {"type": "circle_summary", "risk_counts":                │
     │ t["risk_counts"], "out_now": t["out_now"], "base_out_now":              │
     │ t["base_out_now"],                                                      │
     │                 "capped_now": t["capped_now"], "hoh_avoided":           │
     │ t["hoh_avoided"],                                                       │
     │                 "rows": [{"id": r["subdivision_id"], "name": r["name"], │
     │ "risk_index": r["risk_index"]} for r in ranked]}                        │
     │         return ToolResult(llm, card)                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_subdivision_briefing(subdivision: str) -> ToolResult:       │
     │         """Full briefing for one named sub-division (Subhash Nagar,     │
     │ Izzatnagar, Faridpur, Krishna Nagar or Kosi Kalan):                     │
     │         supply against demand, its worst transformers, plans, critical  │
     │ loads and reliability. Use whenever one is named."""                    │
     │         sid, err = sd_arg(subdivision)                                  │
     │         if err or sid is None:                                          │
     │             return err or ToolResult({"error": "Name a sub-division.",  │
     │ "known_subdivisions": known})                                           │
     │         r = view(views.circle_summary, sid)["subdivisions"][0]          │
     │         dts = sorted(view(views.transformers, sid)["items"], key=lambda │
     │ d: -d["risk_index"])                                                    │
     │         plans = view(views.plans, None, sid)["plans"]                   │
     │         crit = view(views.critical, sid)                                │
     │         live = [p for p in plans if p["status"] in ("pending",          │
     │ "approved", "scheduled", "active")]                                     │
     │         llm = {                                                         │
     │             "subdivision": r["name"], "discom": r["discom"], "type":    │
     │ "notified town area" if r["kind"] == "nta" else "district               │
     │ headquarters",                                                          │
     │             "consumers": r["consumers"], "transformers": r["dts"],      │
     │ "risk_index": r["risk_index"],                                          │
     │             "transformers_by_risk": r["risk_counts"], "demand_kw":      │
     │ round(r["natural_kw"]), "available_kw": round(r["avail_kw"]),           │
     │             "gap_kw": round(r["gap_kw"]),                               │
     │ "consumers_without_power_now": r["out_now"],                            │
     │             "without_power_under_rotational_shedding":                  │
     │ r["base_out_now"], "meters_on_lifeline_limit_now": r["capped_now"],     │
     │             "outage_hours_per_day": r["outage_h_per_day"],              │
     │ "outage_hours_per_day_under_rotational_shedding":                       │
     │ r["base_outage_h_per_day"],                                             │
     │             "lifeline_availability_pct":                                │
     │ r["lifeline_availability_pct"],                                         │
     │             **_cap("worst_transformers", [{"name": d["name"], "risk":   │
     │ d["risk_level"], "loading_pct": round(d["loading_pct"]),                │
     │                                            "hotspot_c":                 │
     │ round(d["hotspot_c"])} for d in dts], 4),                               │
     │             "plans": [plan_line(p) for p in live[:3]],                  │
     │             "critical_loads": len(crit["items"]),                       │
     │ "critical_loads_without_power": sum(not f["powered"] for f in           │
     │ crit["items"]),                                                         │
     │             "life_support_homes": crit["life_support"]["count"],        │
     │         }                                                               │
     │         card = {"type": "subdivision", "id": sid, "name": r["name"],    │
     │ "risk_index": r["risk_index"], "risk_counts": r["risk_counts"],         │
     │                 "gap_kw": r["gap_kw"], "out_now": r["out_now"],         │
     │ "base_out_now": r["base_out_now"], "capped_now": r["capped_now"],       │
     │                 "worst": [{"id": d["id"], "name": d["name"],            │
     │ "risk_level": d["risk_level"], "loading_pct": d["loading_pct"]} for d   │
     │ in dts[:4]]}                                                            │
     │         return ToolResult(llm, card)                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def find_transformer(query: str, subdivision: str | None = None) -> │
     │ ToolResult:                                                             │
     │         """Find or disambiguate a transformer by an uncertain spoken    │
     │ name. Returns up to three matches with risk and score.                  │
     │         If the engineer asked for a transformer's status, call          │
     │ get_transformer_status directly instead."""                             │
     │         res = resolve_transformer(query, subdivision,                   │
     │ transformers=dt_rows, subdivisions=sd_rows)                             │
     │         if not res.matches:                                             │
     │             return ToolResult({"matches": [], "note": "No transformer   │
     │ matches. Names look like DT-SN-03."})                                   │
     │         risk = {d["id"]: d["risk_level"] for d in                       │
     │ view(views.transformers)["items"]}                                      │
     │         return ToolResult({"ambiguous": res.ambiguous,                  │
     │                            "matches": [{"name": m.name, "subdivision":  │
     │ sd_name[m.subdivision_id], "risk": risk[m.id],                          │
     │                                         "match_score": m.score} for m   │
     │ in res.matches]})                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_transformer_status(transformer: str) -> ToolResult:         │
     │         """Status of one distribution transformer: loading against its  │
     │ thermal limit, hot-spot temperature, voltage,                           │
     │         risk and its drivers, consumers on a lifeline limit, and the    │
     │ forecast peak for the next 24 hours."""                                 │
     │         did, err = dt_arg(transformer)                                  │
     │         if err or did is None:                                          │
     │             return err                                                  │
     │         d = view(views.transformer_profile, did)                        │
     │         top = max(d["drivers"], key=d["drivers"].get)                   │
     │         llm = {                                                         │
     │             "transformer": d["name"], "subdivision":                    │
     │ sd_name[d["subdivision_id"]], "rating_kva": d["rating_kva"],            │
     │             "consumers": d["n_consumers"], "supply_on": d["on"],        │
     │ "loading_pct": round(d["loading_pct"]),                                 │
     │             "thermal_limit_pct": round(d["limit_pct"]), "hotspot_c":    │
     │ round(d["hotspot_c"]),                                                  │
     │             "ageing_speed_vs_normal": d["thermal"]["ageing_factor"],    │
     │ "lowest_voltage_pu": d["v_min_pu"],                                     │
     │             "risk": d["risk_level"], "risk_index": d["risk_index"],     │
     │ "main_risk_driver": top,                                                │
     │             "forecast_peak_loading_pct_24h":                            │
     │ round(d["peak_loading_pct_24h"]), "shortfall_slots_24h":                │
     │ d["deficit_slots_24h"],                                                 │
     │             "lifeline_level_now": c.CAP_LEVELS[d["cap_level"]].name,    │
     │ "meters_on_lifeline_limit_now": d["capped_now"],                        │
     │             "consumers_without_power_now": d["out_now"],                │
     │ "critical_loads_here": [f["name"] for f in d["critical"]],              │
     │             "life_support_homes": d["life_support_count"],              │
     │ "income_band": d["income_band"],                                        │
     │         }                                                               │
     │         card = {"type": "transformer", "id": d["id"], "name":           │
     │ d["name"], "subdivision_id": d["subdivision_id"],                       │
     │                 "risk_level": d["risk_level"], "loading_pct":           │
     │ d["loading_pct"], "limit_pct": d["limit_pct"],                          │
     │                 "hotspot_c": d["hotspot_c"], "v_min_pu": d["v_min_pu"], │
     │ "cap_level": d["cap_level"], "capped_now": d["capped_now"]}             │
     │         return ToolResult(llm, card)                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_deficits(subdivision: str | None = None) -> ToolResult:     │
     │         """Forecast shortfall windows: when demand will exceed          │
     │ available supply or a transformer will overload,                        │
     │         with start and end times, the gap, and whether a Flex Plan is   │
     │ pending or approved."""                                                 │
     │         sid, err = sd_arg(subdivision)                                  │
     │         if err:                                                         │
     │             return err                                                  │
     │         rows = view(views.deficits, sid)["items"]                       │
     │         items = [{"subdivision": sd_name[r["subdivision_id"]], "from":  │
     │ clock(r["start"]), "to": clock(r["end"]),                               │
     │                   "cause": r["cause"].replace("_", " "), "peak_gap_kw": │
     │ round(r["peak_gap_kw"]),                                                │
     │                   "energy_gap_kwh": round(r["energy_gap_kwh"]),         │
     │ "confidence_pct": r["confidence"], "plan_status": r["plan_status"]}     │
     │                  for r in rows]                                         │
     │         llm = {"scope": sd_name.get(sid, "all sub-divisions"), "count": │
     │ len(items), **_cap("windows", items)}                                   │
     │         return ToolResult(llm, {"type": "deficits", "rows": [{**i,      │
     │ "id": r["plan_id"]} for i, r in zip(items[:LIST_CAP], rows,             │
     │ strict=False)]})                                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def compare_subdivisions(metric: str) -> ToolResult:                │
     │         """Rank the five sub-divisions on one metric: risk_index,       │
     │ outage_hours, baseline_outage_hours,                                    │
     │         outage_hours_avoided, lifeline_availability, peak_loading or    │
     │ pending_plans."""                                                       │
     │         if metric not in COMPARE_METRICS:                               │
     │             return ToolResult({"error": f"Unknown metric '{metric}'.",  │
     │ "metrics": list(COMPARE_METRICS)})                                      │
     │         key, unit, worst_high = COMPARE_METRICS[metric]                 │
     │         rows = sorted(view(views.circle_summary)["subdivisions"],       │
     │ key=lambda r: r[key], reverse=worst_high)                               │
     │         ranking = [{"rank": i + 1, "subdivision": r["name"], "value":   │
     │ r[key]} for i, r in enumerate(rows)]                                    │
     │         return ToolResult({"metric": metric, "unit": unit,              │
     │ "worst_first": True, "ranking": ranking},                               │
     │                           {"type": "ranking", "metric": metric, "unit": │
     │ unit,                                                                   │
     │                            "rows": [{"id": r["subdivision_id"], "name": │
     │ r["name"], "value": r[key]} for r in rows]})                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_flex_plans(subdivision: str | None = None, status: str |    │
     │ None = None) -> ToolResult:                                             │
     │         """List Flex Plans. status is pending (default), approved,      │
     │ scheduled, active, verified, expired or all."""                         │
     │         sid, err = sd_arg(subdivision)                                  │
     │         if err:                                                         │
     │             return err                                                  │
     │         wanted = None if status in ("all", "any") else (status or       │
     │ "pending")                                                              │
     │         rows = view(views.plans, wanted, sid)["plans"]                  │
     │         llm = {"scope": sd_name.get(sid, "all sub-divisions"),          │
     │ "status": wanted or "all", "count": len(rows),                          │
     │                **_cap("plans", [plan_line(p) for p in rows])}           │
     │         return ToolResult(llm, {"type": "plans", "rows": [{"id":        │
     │ p["id"], **plan_line(p)} for p in rows[:LIST_CAP]]})                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_flex_plan(plan: str) -> ToolResult:                         │
     │         """One Flex Plan in detail: the reasons, which levers cover the │
     │ gap, how many homes get a lifeline limit, and how it                    │
     │         compares with rotational shedding. `plan` is a plan id or the   │
     │ name of a sub-division (its most urgent live plan)."""                  │
     │         raw = str(plan or "").strip()                                   │
     │         with service.lock:                                              │
     │             found = service.planner.plans.get(raw)                      │
     │         if found is None:                                               │
     │             sid, err = sd_arg(raw)                                      │
     │             if err or sid is None:                                      │
     │                 return err or ToolResult({"error": "Name a sub-division │
     │ or give a plan id."})                                                   │
     │             live = [p for p in view(views.plans, None, sid)["plans"] if │
     │ p["status"] in ("pending", "approved", "scheduled", "active")]          │
     │             if not live:                                                │
     │                 return ToolResult({"subdivision": sd_name[sid], "note": │
     │ "No live Flex Plan for this sub-division."})                            │
     │             p = live[0]                                                 │
     │         else:                                                           │
     │             p = found.model_dump()                                      │
     │         options = {o["key"]: o for o in p["options"]}                   │
     │         llm = {**plan_line(p), "reasons": p["reasons"][:4],             │
     │                "households_unaffected":                                 │
     │ p["projection"]["households_unaffected"],                               │
     │                "low_income_homes_capped_pct":                           │
     │ p["projection"]["low_income_capped_pct"],                               │
     │                "critical_loads_and_life_support_protected":             │
     │ p["projection"]["critical_protected"],                                  │
     │                "household_outage_hours_avoided":                        │
     │ round(p["projection"]["hoh_avoided"]),                                  │
     │                "rebate_rupees": p["projection"]["rebate_rs"],           │

     │     def get_load_forecast(target: str) -> ToolResult:                   │
     │         """Load forecast for the next 24 hours for a sub-division or a  │

     │ def _llm_only(fn: Callable[..., ToolResult]) -> Callable[..., dict]:    │
     │     def wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict:                     │
     │         return fn(*args, **kwargs).llm                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     wrapper.__name__ = fn.__name__                                      │
     │     wrapper.__qualname__ = fn.__qualname__                              │
     │     wrapper.__doc__ = fn.__doc__                                        │
     │     wrapper.__signature__ =                                             │
     │ inspect.signature(fn).replace(return_annotation=dict)  # type:          │
     │ ignore[attr-defined]                                                    │
     │     return wrapper                                                      │

     │ may rephrase them, and its output is accepted only if every number in   │

     │ _NUM = re.compile(r"\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?")                                │

     │ briefing. Keep every number, time and place name exactly "              │
     │           "as given. Do not add facts. One sentence each, plain         │
     │ English, no markdown. Return exactly three lines.\n\n{lines}")          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def numbers_in(text: str) -> set[str]:                                  │
     │     out = set()                                                         │
     │     for m in _NUM.findall(text):                                        │
     │         token = m.replace(",", "").rstrip(".")                          │
     │         out.add(token)                                                  │
     │     return out                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ class BriefingService:                                                  │
     │     def __init__(self, settings: Settings, service, phrase:             │
     │ Callable[[dict], list[str]] | None = None):                             │
     │         self.settings = settings                                        │
     │         self.service = service                                          │
     │         self._phrase = phrase or self._default_phrase()                 │
     │         self._cache: dict[tuple, dict] = {}                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def _default_phrase(self) -> Callable[[dict], list[str]] | None:    │
     │         key = self.settings.gemini_api_key                              │
     │         if not key:                                                     │
     │             return None                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │         def phrase(facts: dict) -> list[str]:                           │
     │             from google import genai                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │             client = genai.Client(api_key=key)                          │
     │             text = client.models.generate_content(                      │
     │                 model=self.settings.gemini_model,                       │
     │ contents=PROMPT.format(lines="\n".join(line["text"] for line in         │
     │ facts["lines"]))).text                                                  │
     │             return [ln.strip(" -*\t") for ln in (text or                │
     │ "").splitlines() if ln.strip()]                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │         return phrase                                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def briefing(self, sd_id: str | None = None) -> dict:               │
     │         with self.service.lock:                                         │
     │             facts = views.briefing_facts(self.service, sd_id)           │
     │             hour = self.service.world.now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H")          │
     │         key = (sd_id, hour)                                             │
     │         if key in self._cache:                                          │
     │             return {**facts, **self._cache[key]}                        │
     │         result: dict = {"source": "template"}                           │
     │         if self._phrase is not None:                                    │
     │             try:                                                        │
     │                 lines = self._phrase(facts)                             │
     │                 allowed = set().union(*(numbers_in(line["text"]) for    │
     │ line in facts["lines"]))                                                │
     │                 grounded = len(lines) == 3 and all(numbers_in(text) <=  │
     │ allowed for text in lines)                                              │
     │                 if grounded:                                            │
     │                     result = {"source": "llm", "lines": [{"tone":       │
     │ f["tone"], "text": t} for f, t in zip(facts["lines"], lines,            │
     │ strict=True)]}                                                          │
     │                 else:                                                   │
     │                     logger.warning("Briefing rephrase rejected: it      │
     │ introduced a number that is not in the facts")                          │
     │             except Exception:                                           │
     │                 logger.exception("Briefing rephrase failed; using the   │
     │ template")                                                              │
     │         self._cache[key] = result                                       │
     │         return {**facts, **result}                                      │

     │ def build_consumer_tools(service, consumer_id: str) ->                  │
     │ list[Callable[..., dict]]:                                              │
     │     def home() -> dict:                                                 │
     │         with service.lock:                                              │
     │             return views.consumer_home(service, consumer_id)            │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_my_supply() -> dict:                                        │
     │         """This home's supply right now: on or off, any lifeline limit  │
     │ in watts, and whether it is on the protected list."""                   │
     │         h = home()                                                      │
     │         return {"state": h["supply"]["state"], "limit_watts":           │
     │ h["supply"]["cap_w"], "protected": h["consumer"]["life_support"],       │
     │                 "guaranteed_watts": h["guarantee_w"]}                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_my_power_weather() -> dict:                                 │
     │         """The next 24 hours for this home: the hours with normal       │
     │ supply, hours where saving earns a rebate,                              │
     │         and hours with a lifeline limit."""                             │
     │         h = home()                                                      │
     │         changes = [{"from": clock(p["at"]), "status":                   │
     │ p["status"].replace("_", " "), "limit_watts": p["cap_w"]}               │
     │                    for i, p in enumerate(h["power_weather"]) if i == 0  │
     │ or p["status"] != h["power_weather"][i - 1]["status"]]                  │
     │         return {"hours": changes[:8], "all_normal": all(p["status"] ==  │
     │ "normal" for p in h["power_weather"])}                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_my_rebate() -> dict:                                        │
     │         """The bill rebate offered for keeping heavy appliances off     │
     │ during a shortfall."""                                                  │
     │         return {"rupees_per_unit": c.DR_REBATE_RS_PER_KWH, "how":       │
     │ "Reply 1 to the message, then keep AC, geyser and motor off in the      │
     │ stated hours."}                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │     def get_my_messages() -> dict:                                      │
     │         """The most recent notices sent to this home."""                │
     │         return {"messages": [{"at": clock(m["at"]), "text": m["text"]}  │
     │ for m in home()["messages"][:3]]}                                       │

     │ get_my_messages]                                                        │
