     │ // src/lib/auth.ts                                                      │
     │ "use client";                                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";                           │
     │ import { fetchJson } from "@/lib/api/base";                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export type SessionUser = { username: string; name: string; role:       │
     │ string; title: string; subdivision_id: string | null };                 │
     │ export type Session = { token: string; user: SessionUser };             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ const KEY = "lg-token";                                                 │
     │ const listeners = new Set<() => void>();                                │
     │ let cached: Session | null | undefined;                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ function read(): Session | null {                                       │
     │   if (cached !== undefined) return cached;                              │
     │   try {                                                                 │
     │     const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);                              │
     │     cached = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Session) : null;                 │
     │   } catch {                                                             │
     │     cached = null;                                                      │
     │   }                                                                     │
     │   return cached;                                                        │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function getSession(): Session | null {                          │
     │   return typeof window === "undefined" ? null : read();                 │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function setSession(s: Session | null): void {                   │
     │   cached = s;                                                           │
     │   try {                                                                 │
     │     if (s) localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(s));                │
     │     else localStorage.removeItem(KEY);                                  │
     │   } catch {                                                             │
     │     /* storage unavailable: the session lives in memory for this tab */ │
     │   }                                                                     │
     │   listeners.forEach((l) => l());                                        │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function clearSession(): void {                                  │
     │   setSession(null);                                                     │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function useSession(): Session | null {                          │
     │   return useSyncExternalStore(                                          │
     │     (cb) => {                                                           │
     │       listeners.add(cb);                                                │
     │       return () => {                                                    │
     │         listeners.delete(cb);                                           │
     │       };                                                                │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     getSession,                                                         │
     │     () => null,                                                         │
     │   );                                                                    │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function authHeaders(): Record<string, string> {                 │
     │   const s = getSession();                                               │
     │   return s ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${s.token}` } : {};               │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export async function demoLogin(role: string, subdivisionId?: string):  │
     │ Promise<Session> {                                                      │
     │   const s = await fetchJson<Session>("/api/v1/auth/demo-login", {       │
     │     method: "POST",                                                     │
     │     body: JSON.stringify({ role, subdivision_id: subdivisionId ?? null  │
     │ }),                                                                     │
     │   });                                                                   │
     │   setSession(s);                                                        │
     │   return s;                                                             │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export async function login(username: string, password: string):        │
     │ Promise<Session> {                                                      │
     │   const s = await fetchJson<Session>("/api/v1/auth/login", { method:    │
     │ "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }) });                │
     │   setSession(s);                                                        │
     │   return s;                                                             │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │

     │ // src/lib/api/mutations.ts                                             │
     │ "use client";                                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import { mutate } from "swr";                                           │
     │ import { toast } from "@/components/ds/toast-store";                    │
     │ import { authHeaders } from "@/lib/auth";                               │
     │ import { ApiError, fetchJson } from "./base";                           │
     │ import type { Complaint, FlexPlan, PlanOverrides, ScenarioResult } from │
     │ "./types";                                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ const P = "/api/v1";                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /** Revalidate every cached SWR key whose path starts with one of       │
     │ `prefixes`. */                                                          │
     │ export function invalidate(prefixes: readonly string[]):                │
     │ Promise<unknown> {                                                      │
     │   return mutate((key) => typeof key === "string" && prefixes.some((p)   │
     │ => key.startsWith(`${P}${p}`)));                                        │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export const AFTER_DECISION = ["/plans", "/deficits", "/insights",      │
     │ "/flex", "/audit", "/consumers/outbox", "/protocols"] as const;         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ function message(e: unknown): string {                                  │
     │   if (e instanceof ApiError) {                                          │
     │     if (e.isNetwork) return "Backend unreachable";                      │
     │     if (e.status === 401) return "Sign in as a Junior or Assistant      │
     │ Engineer to do this";                                                   │
     │     return e.detail;                                                    │
     │   }                                                                     │
     │   return e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unexpected error";           │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ async function run<T>(action: () => Promise<T>, ok: string | ((r: T) => │
     │ string), fail: string): Promise<T | null> {                             │
     │   try {                                                                 │
     │     const result = await action();                                      │
     │     toast({ title: typeof ok === "function" ? ok(result) : ok, tone:    │
     │ "success" });                                                           │
     │     return result;                                                      │
     │   } catch (e) {                                                         │
     │     toast({ title: fail, body: message(e), tone: "critical" });         │
     │     return null;                                                        │
     │   }                                                                     │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ function post<T>(path: string, body: unknown, auth = true): Promise<T>  │
     │ {                                                                       │
     │   return fetchJson<T>(`${P}${path}`, { method: "POST", body:            │
     │ JSON.stringify(body), headers: auth ? authHeaders() : {} });            │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function approvePlan(id: string, note?: string, overrides?:      │
     │ Partial<PlanOverrides>) {                                               │
     │   return run(                                                           │
     │     async () => {                                                       │
     │       const r = await post<FlexPlan>(`/plans/${id}/approve`, { note:    │
     │ note ?? null, overrides: overrides ?? null });                          │
     │       await invalidate(AFTER_DECISION);                                 │
     │       return r;                                                         │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     (r) => (r.modified ? "Plan modified and approved" : "Plan approved. │
     │ Notices go out now."),                                                  │
     │     "Could not approve the plan",                                       │
     │   );                                                                    │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function rejectPlan(id: string, note?: string) {                 │
     │   return run(                                                           │
     │     async () => {                                                       │
     │       const r = await post<FlexPlan>(`/plans/${id}/reject`, { note:     │
     │ note ?? null });                                                        │
     │       await invalidate(AFTER_DECISION);                                 │
     │       return r;                                                         │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     "Plan rejected. Rotational shedding applies for this window.",      │
     │     "Could not reject the plan",                                        │
     │   );                                                                    │
     │ }                                                                       │

     │ // src/lib/live/telemetry-store.ts                                      │
     │ import type { DtTelemetry, Telemetry } from "./types";                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export type TelemetrySnapshot = { receivedAt: number; telemetry:        │
     │ Telemetry | null; byDt: Map<string, DtTelemetry> };                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /** Read side, used by map layers. Updates never touch React state. */  │
     │ export interface TelemetryStore {                                       │
     │   getSnapshot(): TelemetrySnapshot;                                     │
     │   subscribe(listener: (s: TelemetrySnapshot) => void): () => void;      │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export interface TelemetryPublisher extends TelemetryStore {            │
     │   publish(t: Telemetry, receivedAt?: number): void;                     │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function createTelemetryStore(): TelemetryPublisher {            │
     │   let snapshot: TelemetrySnapshot = { receivedAt: 0, telemetry: null,   │
     │ byDt: new Map() };                                                      │
     │   const listeners = new Set<(s: TelemetrySnapshot) => void>();          │
     │   return {                                                              │
     │     getSnapshot: () => snapshot,                                        │
     │     subscribe(listener) {                                               │
     │       listeners.add(listener);                                          │
     │       return () => {                                                    │
     │         listeners.delete(listener);                                     │
     │       };                                                                │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │     publish(t, receivedAt = typeof performance !== "undefined" ?        │
     │ performance.now() : Date.now()) {                                       │
     │       snapshot = { receivedAt, telemetry: t, byDt: new                  │
     │ Map(t.dts.map((row) => [row[0], row])) };                               │
     │       listeners.forEach((l) => l(snapshot));                            │
     │     },                                                                  │
     │   };                                                                    │
     │ }                                                                       │

     │ - [ ] Step 2: Implement. The pure helpers the tests name:               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ // LeverWaterfall.tsx                                                   │
     │ export type WaterfallStep = { key: "gap" | LeverKey; label: string;     │
     │ from: number; to: number; value: number; color: string };               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function waterfallSteps(levers: LeverSummary[], gapKwh: number): │
     │ WaterfallStep[] {                                                       │
     │   const total = levers.reduce((a, l) => a + l.energy_kwh, 0);           │
     │   const top = Math.max(gapKwh, total);                                  │
     │   const steps: WaterfallStep[] = [{ key: "gap", label: "Shortfall",     │
     │ from: 0, to: top, value: top, color: "var(--text-muted)" }];            │
     │   let cursor = top;                                                     │
     │   for (const key of LEVER_ORDER) {                                      │
     │     const lever = levers.find((l) => l.lever === key);                  │
     │     if (!lever || lever.energy_kwh <= 0) continue;                      │
     │     const next = Math.max(0, cursor - lever.energy_kwh);                │
     │     steps.push({ key, label: LEVER_LABEL[key], from: next, to: cursor,  │
     │ value: lever.energy_kwh, color: leverVar(key) });                       │
     │     cursor = next;                                                      │
     │   }                                                                     │
     │   return steps;                                                         │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ // FanChart.tsx                                                         │
     │ export function fanRows(points: FanPoint[]) {                           │
     │   return points.map((p) => ({ x: fmtClock(p.at), at: p.at, band:        │
     │ [p.p10, p.p90] as [number, number], p50: p.p50, limit: p.limit ?? null, │
     │ actual: p.actual ?? null }));                                           │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ // SupplyDemandChart.tsx                                                │
     │ export function supplyRows(history: SdForecast["actual"], forecast:     │
     │ SdForecast["points"]) {                                                 │
     │   return [                                                              │
     │     ...history.map((h) => ({ x: fmtClock(h.at), at: h.at, demand:       │
     │ h.natural_kw, avail: h.avail_kw, gap: Math.max(0, h.natural_kw -        │
     │ h.avail_kw),                                                            │
     │                               served: h.supplied_kw as number | null,   │
     │ base: h.base_supplied_kw as number | null, forecast: false })),         │
     │     ...forecast.map((f) => ({ x: fmtClock(f.at), at: f.at, demand:      │
     │ f.p50, avail: f.avail_kw, gap: f.gap_kw,                                │
     │                                served: null as number | null, base:     │
     │ null as number | null, forecast: true })),                              │
     │   ];                                                                    │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ // LorenzCurve.tsx                                                      │
     │ export function lorenzPath(points: [number, number][], w: number, h:    │
     │ number): string {                                                       │
     │   return points.map(([x, y], i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" :                   │
     │ "L"}${Math.round(x * w)},${Math.round(h - y * h)}`).join(" ");          │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ // GaugeArc.tsx                                                         │
     │ export function gaugeAngle(value: number, max: number): number {        │
     │   const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value / max));                      │
     │   return -120 + 240 * t;                                                │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Every chart sets isAnimationActive={false}, uses ChartFrame with a      │
     │ label, ChartTooltip for tooltips, AXIS_TICK and GRID_PROPS from         │
     │ common.tsx, and passes initialDimension to ResponsiveContainer as the   │
     │ copied charts do (jsdom has no layout). SVG charts set role="img" and   │
     │ an aria-label that states the value (Lorenz curve, Gini 0.31, Hot-spot  │
     │ 104 °C).                                                                │

     │ - [ ] Step 2: Write src/components/map/lens.ts                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import type { DtRow } from "@/lib/api/types";                           │
     │ import { DT_STATE_VAR } from "@/lib/domain";                            │
     │ import { heatColor, type HeatScale } from "@/lib/heat";                 │
     │ import type { DtTelemetry } from "@/lib/live/types";                    │
     │ import { HOTSPOT_SCALE, LOADING_SCALE, RISK_INDEX_SCALE, SERVED_SCALE,  │
     │ VOLTAGE_SCALE } from "@/components/ds/kit";                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export type MapLens = "state" | "loading" | "hotspot" | "voltage" |     │
     │ "risk" | "served";                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export const LENS_LABEL: Record<MapLens, string> = {                    │
     │   state: "Live state", loading: "Loading, percent of rating", hotspot:  │
     │ "Hot-spot temperature", voltage: "Lowest voltage",                      │
     │   risk: "Risk index", served: "Share of demand served",                 │
     │ };                                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export const LENS_SCALE: Record<Exclude<MapLens, "state">, HeatScale> = │
     │ {                                                                       │
     │   loading: LOADING_SCALE, hotspot: HOTSPOT_SCALE, voltage:              │
     │ VOLTAGE_SCALE, risk: RISK_INDEX_SCALE, served: SERVED_SCALE,            │
     │ };                                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /** The value a lens shows for one DT. Live telemetry wins for fast     │
     │ metrics; slow metrics come from the polled row. */                      │
     │ export function lensValue(lens: MapLens, live: DtTelemetry | undefined, │
     │ row: DtRow | undefined): number | null {                                │
     │   switch (lens) {                                                       │
     │     case "state": return live ? live[3] : row ? (row.on ?               │
     │ (row.capped_now > 0 ? 1 : 0) : 3) : null;                               │
     │     case "loading": return live ? live[2] : (row?.loading_pct ?? null); │
     │     case "hotspot": return live ? live[4] : (row?.hotspot_c ?? null);   │
     │     case "voltage": {                                                   │
     │       const v = live ? live[5] : (row?.v_min_pu ?? null);               │
     │       return v !== null && v > 0 ? v : null;                            │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │     case "risk": return row?.risk_index ?? null;                        │
     │     case "served": return row?.served_fraction ?? null;                 │
     │   }                                                                     │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function lensColor(lens: MapLens, value: number | null): string  │
     │ {                                                                       │
     │   if (lens === "state") return value === null ? "var(--heat-empty)" :   │
     │ DT_STATE_VAR[value as 0 | 1 | 2 | 3];                                   │
     │   return heatColor(value, LENS_SCALE[lens]);                            │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write src/components/map/ServiceAreaLayer.tsx             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ "use client";                                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";                              │
     │ import { useMap } from "react-leaflet";                                 │
     │ import L from "leaflet";                                                │
     │ import type { DtRow } from "@/lib/api/types";                           │
     │ import type { TelemetryStore } from "@/lib/live/telemetry-store";       │
     │ import { lensColor, lensValue, type MapLens } from "./lens";            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export type ServiceAreaLayerProps = {                                   │
     │   areas: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection;                                     │
     │   lens: MapLens;                                                        │
     │   rows: readonly DtRow[];                                               │
     │   store: TelemetryStore;                                                │
     │   selectedId?: string | null;                                           │
     │   onSelect?: (dtId: string) => void;                                    │
     │   fillOpacity?: number;                                                 │
     │ };                                                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ function esc(s: string): string {                                       │
     │   return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;",     │
     │ ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[c]!);                       │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /**                                                                     │
     │  * One polygon per transformer (its Voronoi service area). The polygons │
     │ are created once; colours are                                           │
     │  * restyled imperatively on every telemetry frame, so a tick never      │
     │ re-renders React.                                                       │
     │  */                                                                     │
     │ export function ServiceAreaLayer({ areas, lens, rows, store, selectedId │
     │ = null, onSelect, fillOpacity = 0.55 }: ServiceAreaLayerProps) {        │
     │   const map = useMap();                                                 │
     │   const layersRef = useRef(new Map<string, L.Path>());                  │
     │   const rowsRef = useRef(new Map<string, DtRow>());                     │
     │   const lensRef = useRef(lens);                                         │
     │   const selectedRef = useRef(selectedId);                               │
     │   const onSelectRef = useRef(onSelect);                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │   useEffect(() => {                                                     │
     │     onSelectRef.current = onSelect;                                     │
     │   }, [onSelect]);                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │   // Build the polygons once per geometry.                              │
     │   useEffect(() => {                                                     │
     │     const layers = layersRef.current;                                   │
     │     const group = L.geoJSON(areas, {                                    │
     │       style: () => ({ color: "var(--border-strong)", weight: 1,         │
     │ fillColor: "var(--heat-empty)", fillOpacity }),                         │
     │       onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {                              │
     │         const id = String(feature.properties?.dt_id);                   │
     │         layers.set(id, layer as L.Path);                                │
     │         layer.on("click", () => onSelectRef.current?.(id));             │
     │         layer.bindTooltip(esc(String(feature.properties?.name ?? id)),  │
     │ { sticky: true });                                                      │
     │       },                                                                │
     │     }).addTo(map);                                                      │
     │     return () => {                                                      │
     │       group.remove();                                                   │
     │       layers.clear();                                                   │
     │     };                                                                  │
     │   }, [map, areas, fillOpacity]);                                        │
     │                                                                         │
     │   // Restyle on telemetry, lens, rows or selection changes.             │
     │   useEffect(() => {                                                     │
     │     rowsRef.current = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));              │
     │     lensRef.current = lens;                                             │
     │     selectedRef.current = selectedId;                                   │
     │     const paint = () => {                                               │
     │       const byDt = store.getSnapshot().byDt;                            │
     │       layersRef.current.forEach((layer, id) => {                        │
     │         const row = rowsRef.current.get(id);                            │
     │         const value = lensValue(lensRef.current, byDt.get(id), row);    │
     │         const selected = id === selectedRef.current;                    │
     │         layer.setStyle({ fillColor: lensColor(lensRef.current, value),  │
     │ color: selected ? "var(--brand)" : "var(--border-strong)", weight:      │
     │ selected ? 2.5 : 1 });                                                  │
     │         const text = value === null ? "no data" : lensRef.current ===   │
     │ "voltage" ? value.toFixed(3) : String(Math.round(value));               │
     │         layer.setTooltipContent(`<strong>${esc(row?.name ??             │
     │ id)}</strong><br/>${esc(text)}`);                                       │
     │       });                                                               │
     │     };                                                                  │
     │     paint();                                                            │
     │     return store.subscribe(paint);                                      │
     │   }, [store, lens, rows, selectedId]);                                  │
     │                                                                         │
     │   return null;                                                          │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │

     │                                                                         │

     │ import type { FlexPlan, MeterRow } from "@/lib/api/types";              │
     │ import type { StepState } from "@/components/ds/Stepper";               │
     │ import { fmtClock } from "@/lib/format";                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function windowLabel(plan: Pick<FlexPlan, "window">): string {   │
     │   return `${fmtClock(plan.window.start)} to                             │
     │ ${fmtClock(plan.window.end)}`;                                          │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function deadlineMinutes(plan: Pick<FlexPlan,                    │
     │ "approval_deadline">, nowIso: string): number {                         │
     │   return Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.parse(plan.approval_deadline) -   │
     │ Date.parse(nowIso)) / 60000));                                          │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ const STEP_DEFS = [                                                     │
     │   { key: "approved", label: "Approved", event: "approved" },            │
     │   { key: "scheduled", label: "Consumers notified", event: "scheduled"   │
     │ },                                                                      │
     │   { key: "signal", label: "Chargers signalled", event: null },          │
     │   { key: "hes", label: "Meter limits sent", event: null },              │
     │   { key: "active", label: "Window active", event: "active" },           │
     │   { key: "completed", label: "Window ended", event: "completed" },      │
     │   { key: "verified", label: "Verified", event: "verified" },            │
     │ ] as const;                                                             │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export type DispatchStep = { key: (typeof STEP_DEFS)[number]["key"];    │
     │ label: string; at: string | null; state: StepState };                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /** Steps of an approved plan. `signal` and `hes` have no timeline      │
     │ event: they are done once the window is active. */                      │
     │ export function dispatchSteps(plan: Pick<FlexPlan, "status" |           │
     │ "timeline">): DispatchStep[] {                                          │
     │   const at = (type: string) => plan.timeline.find((e) => e.type ===     │
     │ type)?.at ?? null;                                                      │
     │   const reached = new Set(plan.timeline.map((e) => e.type));            │
     │   const active = reached.has("active");                                 │
     │   const done = (key: string, event: string | null) => (event ?          │
     │ reached.has(event) : active);                                           │
     │   let currentAssigned = false;                                          │
     │   return STEP_DEFS.map((d) => {                                         │
     │     const isDone = done(d.key, d.event);                                │
     │     let state: StepState = isDone ? "done" : "upcoming";                │
     │     if (!isDone && !currentAssigned && reached.has("approved") &&       │
     │ !["rejected", "expired", "cancelled"].includes(plan.status)) {          │
     │       state = "current";                                                │
     │       currentAssigned = true;                                           │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │     if (!isDone && ["rejected", "expired",                              │
     │ "cancelled"].includes(plan.status)) state = "skipped";                  │
     │     return { key: d.key, label: d.label, at: d.event ? at(d.event) :    │
     │ null, state };                                                          │
     │   });                                                                   │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function planHeadline(plan: Pick<FlexPlan, "projection">,        │
     │ subdivisionName: string): string {                                      │
     │   const p = plan.projection;                                            │
     │   if (p.households_capped === 0) return `${subdivisionName}: voluntary  │
     │ response and shifted loads cover the shortfall with no limits`;         │
     │   return `${subdivisionName}: ${p.households_capped} homes on a         │
     │ lifeline limit keep ${p.households_blackout_baseline} consumers out of  │
     │ a blackout`;                                                            │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export type TreePos = { x: number; y: number; depth: number };          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /** Left-to-right tidy layout for a small tree given as a parent array  │
     │ (parent[0] === -1). */                                                  │
     │ export function treeLayout(parent: number[], width: number, height:     │
     │ number, pad = 28): TreePos[] {                                          │
     │   const n = parent.length;                                              │
     │   const depth = parent.map(() => 0);                                    │
     │   for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) depth[i] = depth[parent[i]] + 1;          │
     │   const children: number[][] = parent.map(() => []);                    │
     │   for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) children[parent[i]].push(i);              │
     │   const leafY: number[] = new Array(n).fill(0);                         │
     │   let nextLeaf = 0;                                                     │
     │   const place = (i: number): number => {                                │
     │     if (children[i].length === 0) {                                     │
     │       leafY[i] = nextLeaf++;                                            │
     │       return leafY[i];                                                  │
     │     }                                                                   │
     │     const ys = children[i].map(place);                                  │
     │     leafY[i] = (Math.min(...ys) + Math.max(...ys)) / 2;                 │
     │     return leafY[i];                                                    │
     │   };                                                                    │
     │   place(0);                                                             │
     │   const maxDepth = Math.max(1, ...depth);                               │
     │   const leaves = Math.max(1, nextLeaf - 1);                             │
     │   return parent.map((_, i) => ({                                        │
     │     depth: depth[i],                                                    │
     │     x: pad + ((width - 2 * pad) * depth[i]) / maxDepth,                 │
     │     y: pad + ((height - 2 * pad) * leafY[i]) / leaves,                  │
     │   }));                                                                  │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function meterOrder<T extends Pick<MeterRow, "id" |              │
     │ "node">>(meters: T[]): T[] {                                            │
     │   return [...meters].sort((a, b) => a.node - b.node ||                  │
     │ a.id.localeCompare(b.id));                                              │
     │ }                                                                       │

     │ 6.0 The page recipe (applies to every task D1 to D26)                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Each page task produces the same five things:                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ 1. src/app/(dashboard)/<route>/page.tsx: five lines that render one     │
     │ view component.                                                         │
     │ import { CommandCentre } from "@/components/command/CommandCentre";     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export default function Page() {                                        │
     │   return <CommandCentre />;                                             │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │ 2. src/components/<area>/<Name>.tsx: the view. It reads useScope(),     │
     │ calls hooks from lib/api/hooks.ts only, and lays out Panel cards on a   │
     │ 12-column grid (grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-12). While a hook's │
     │ data is undefined it renders PanelSkeleton with the same column span,   │
     │ so nothing shifts.                                                      │
     │ 3. src/components/<area>/titles.ts: one pure function per card that     │
     │ returns the card's action title from data. No numbers are hard-coded.   │
     │ 4. src/components/<area>/titles.test.ts: at least one test per title    │
     │ function, including the "nothing wrong" branch.                         │
     │ 5. A screenshot pair at 1440 by 900 (light and dark) saved to           │
     │ docs/shots/<route-slug>-{light,dark}.png.                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Every card is a Panel with: eyebrow (the metric name), title (from      │
     │ titles.ts), a body, read (one sentence starting "Read:"), source and    │
     │ section. Source strings: SOURCE_SIM for simulated operations,           │
     │ SOURCE_FORECAST for forecasts, and for sourced facts the citation       │
     │ itself (for example "Source: CEEW, What Smart Meters Can Tell Us,       │
     │ 2020").                                                                 │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Solution-against-baseline numbers always use CompareStat or             │
     │ CompareBars, with the phrase "rotational shedding" for the baseline.    │
     │ Never write "without us".                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Acceptance for every page task:                                         │
     │ - [ ] npm run test -- src/components/<area> passes, npm run typecheck   │
     │ and npm run lint are clean.                                             │
     │ - [ ] With the backend stopped, the page renders the same layout from   │
     │ fixtures and shows the offline banner.                                  │

     │ at least one heatmap or matrix, exactly one moneyshot, and a silhouette │

     │ - [ ] Step 2: Write src/components/command/titles.ts                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import type { CircleSummary, CriticalView, FlexLive, FlexPlan,          │
     │ HourMatrix, SdForecast, SubdivisionSummaryRow } from "@/lib/api/types"; │
     │ import { LEVER_LABEL } from "@/lib/domain";                             │
     │ import { fmtClock } from "@/lib/format";                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ const plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => (n === 1 ? one │
     │ : many);                                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function mapTitle(s: CircleSummary): string {                    │
     │   const worst = [...s.subdivisions].sort((a, b) => b.risk_index -       │
     │ a.risk_index)[0];                                                       │
     │   const critical = worst.risk_counts.critical;                          │
     │   if (critical === 0 && worst.risk_index < 45) return `No sub-division  │
     │ is above monitor level; ${worst.name} is highest at                     │
     │ ${worst.risk_index}`;                                                   │
     │   return `${worst.name} carries the highest risk: index                 │
     │ ${worst.risk_index}, ${critical} ${plural(critical, "transformer",      │
     │ "transformers")} critical`;                                             │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function leagueTitle(rows: SubdivisionSummaryRow[]): string {    │
     │   const risk = [...rows].sort((a, b) => b.risk_index -                  │
     │ a.risk_index)[0];                                                       │
     │   const gap = [...rows].sort((a, b) => b.gap_kw - a.gap_kw)[0];         │
     │   if (gap.gap_kw <= 0) return `${risk.name} leads on risk; supply       │
     │ covers demand everywhere`;                                              │
     │   return `${risk.name} leads on risk; ${gap.name} has the largest gap   │
     │ at ${Math.round(gap.gap_kw)} kW`;                                       │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ /** IST hour label, for example 19:00, for an ISO instant that starts   │
     │ an hour column. */                                                      │
     │ const hourLabel = (iso: string) => `${fmtClock(iso).slice(0, 2)}:00`;   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function heatmapTitle(m: HourMatrix): string {                   │
     │   const over = m.rows.filter((r) => r.values.some((v) => v !== null &&  │
     │ v > 100));                                                              │
     │   if (over.length === 0) return "No transformer is forecast above 100   │
     │ percent in the next 24 hours";                                          │
     │   const cols = m.hours.map((_, i) => m.rows.some((r) => (r.values[i] ?? │
     │ 0) > 100));                                                             │
     │   const first = cols.indexOf(true);                                     │
     │   const last = cols.lastIndexOf(true);                                  │
     │   const end = new Date(Date.parse(m.hours[last]) +                      │
     │ 3600_000).toISOString();                                                │
     │   return `${over.length} ${plural(over.length, "transformer exceeds",   │
     │ "transformers exceed")} 100 percent between                             │
     │ ${hourLabel(m.hours[first])} and ${hourLabel(end)}`;                    │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function supplyTitle(f: SdForecast): string {                    │
     │   const peak = [...f.points].sort((a, b) => b.gap_kw - a.gap_kw)[0];    │
     │   if (!peak || peak.gap_kw <= 0) return "Supply covers demand for the   │
     │ next 36 hours";                                                         │
     │   return `Demand exceeds supply by ${Math.round(peak.gap_kw)} kW at     │
     │ ${fmtClock(peak.at)}`;                                                  │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function pendingTitle(plans: FlexPlan[]): string {               │
     │   if (plans.length === 0) return "No plan is waiting for a decision";   │
     │   const first = [...plans].sort((a, b) =>                               │
     │ a.approval_deadline.localeCompare(b.approval_deadline))[0];             │
     │   return `${plans.length} Flex ${plural(plans.length, "Plan needs",     │
     │ "Plans need")} a decision; the first deadline is                        │
     │ ${fmtClock(first.approval_deadline)}`;                                  │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function leverTitle(live: FlexLive): string {                    │
     │   const top = [...live.levers].sort((a, b) => b.kw_now - a.kw_now)[0];  │
     │   if (!top || top.kw_now <= 0) return "No lever is active: supply       │
     │ covers demand";                                                         │
     │   const label = LEVER_LABEL[top.lever];                                 │
     │   return `${label} ${label.endsWith("s") ? "give" : "gives"} the most   │
     │ relief now: ${Math.round(top.kw_now)} kW`;                              │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function criticalTitle(c: CriticalView): string {                │
     │   const down = c.items.filter((f) => !f.powered).length;                │
     │   if (down === 0) return `All ${c.items.length} critical loads have     │
     │ power`;                                                                 │
     │   return `${down} of ${c.items.length} critical loads ${plural(down,    │
     │ "is", "are")} without power`;                                           │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function impactTitle(reductionPct: number, days: number): string │
     │ {                                                                       │
     │   if (reductionPct <= 0) return "No blackout hours yet under either     │
     │ approach";                                                              │
     │   return `${Math.round(reductionPct)} percent fewer blackout hours than │
     │ rotational shedding over ${days} simulated days`;                       │
     │ }                                                                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ In the heat-map test the hours are 12:30Z, 13:30Z and 14:30Z, which are │
     │ 18:00, 19:00 and 20:00 IST; columns 2 and 3 are over 100, so the title  │
     │ reads "between 19:00 and 21:00" (the end of the last hour).             │
     │                                                                         │

     │ import { Panel, PanelSkeleton, SOURCE_SIM, ToggleChip } from            │
     │ "@/components/ds/Panel";                                                │
     │ import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ds/SegmentedControl";    │
     │ import { useCritical, useGeoFeeders, useServiceAreas, useTransformers } │
     │ from "@/lib/api/hooks";                                                 │
     │ import type { CircleSummary } from "@/lib/api/types";                   │
     │ import { BRAND } from "@/lib/brand";                                    │
     │ import { useTelemetryStore } from "@/lib/live/LiveProvider";            │
     │ import type { Scope } from "@/lib/scope";                               │

     │                                                                         │
     │ const LENSES = [{ value: "state", label: "State" }, { value: "loading", │
     │ label: "Loading" }, { value: "risk", label: "Risk" }] as const;         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ export function GridMapCard({ summary, scope }: { summary:              │
     │ CircleSummary | undefined; scope: Scope }) {                            │
     │   const router = useRouter();                                           │
     │   const store = useTelemetryStore();                                    │
     │   const areas = useServiceAreas().data;                                 │
     │   const geo = useGeoFeeders().data;                                     │
     │   const rows = useTransformers("all").data?.items;                      │
     │   const critical = useCritical("all").data;                             │
     │   const [lens, setLens] = useState<MapLens>("state");                   │
     │   const [showCritical, setShowCritical] = useState(true);               │
     │   const [showBaseline, setShowBaseline] = useState(false);              │
     │                                                                         │
     │   const fit = useMemo(                                                  │
     │     () => (rows ?? []).filter((r) => scope === "all" ||                 │
     │ r.subdivision_id === scope).map((r) => [r.lat, r.lng] as [number,       │
     │ number]),                                                               │
     │     [rows, scope],                                                      │
     │   );                                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │   if (!summary || !areas || !geo || !rows) return <PanelSkeleton        │
     │ className="lg:col-span-8" lines={10} />;                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │   return (                                                              │
     │     <Panel                                                              │
     │       className="lg:col-span-8"                                         │
     │       eyebrow="Live network"                                            │
     │       title={mapTitle(summary)}                                         │
     │       live                                                              │
     │       testId="card-map"                                                 │
     │       actions={                                                         │
     │         <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">                     │
     │           <SegmentedControl value={lens as "state" | "loading" |        │
     │ "risk"} onChange={setLens} options={[...LENSES]} ariaLabel="Map lens"   │
     │ />                                                                      │
     │           <ToggleChip pressed={showCritical} onClick={() =>             │
     │ setShowCritical((v) => !v)}>Critical loads</ToggleChip>                 │
     │           <ToggleChip pressed={showBaseline} onClick={() =>             │
     │ setShowBaseline((v) => !v)}>Baseline overlay</ToggleChip>               │
     │         </div>                                                          │
     │       }                                                                 │
     │       read="Read: each area is one transformer's consumers. Amber means │
     │ homes are on a lifeline limit, red means no supply. The baseline        │
     │ overlay outlines feeders that rotational shedding would have switched   │
     │ off."                                                                   │
     │       source={`${SOURCE_SIM}. ${BRAND.simNote}`}                        │
     │       section="Command / Network"                                       │
     │       bodyClassName="pb-2"                                              │
     │     >                                                                   │
     │       <div className="relative">                                        │
     │         <BaseMapClient height={420} fitPoints={fit}>                    │
     │           <ServiceAreaLayerClient areas={areas} lens={lens} rows={rows} │
     │ store={store} onSelect={(id) => router.push(`/transformers/${id}`)} />  │
     │           <FeederLayerClient geo={geo} store={store}                    │
     │ showBaseline={showBaseline} />                                          │
     │           <DtLayerClient rows={rows} store={store} onSelect={(id) =>    │
     │ router.push(`/transformers/${id}`)} />                                  │
     │           {showCritical && critical && <AssetLayerClient                │
     │ critical={critical.items} substations={geo.substations} />}             │
     │         </BaseMapClient>                                                │
     │         <MapLegend lens={lens} />                                       │
     │       </div>                                                            │
     │     </Panel>                                                            │
     │   );                                                                    │
     │ }                                                                       │

     │ CommandCentre.tsx composes the cards in the table order, passing data   │
     │ from the hooks; kpiTiles(summary, live) is a pure exported function     │
     │ returning the six tiles and is unit-tested (six keys, the out_now tone  │
     │ rule).                                                                  │

     │ Task E3: The quantified reliability improvement                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Files: deliverables/impact-model.md, backend/scripts/run_impact.py,     │
     │ deliverables/impact-runs.json                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 1: Write backend/scripts/run_impact.py                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ """Runs the three headline scenarios for seven simulated days each,     │
     │ with and without LifelineGrid,                                          │
     │ and writes deliverables/impact-runs.json. Every figure in the write-up  │
     │ and the deck comes from this file.                                      │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Run from backend/:  .venv/Scripts/python scripts/run_impact.py          │
     │ """                                                                     │
     │                                                                         │
     │ import json                                                             │
     │ import sys                                                              │
     │ from pathlib import Path                                                │
     │                                                                         │
     │ ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]                              │
     │ sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))                                           │
     │                                                                         │
     │ from app.core.config import get_settings                                │
     │ from app.grid.network import get_network_repository                     │
     │ from app.grid.scenario_lab import run_scenario                          │
     │ from app.services.economics_service import national_impact,             │
     │ unit_economics                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ SCENARIOS = ("heatwave_evening", "monsoon_cloud", "re_2047")            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ def main() -> int:                                                      │
     │     settings, repo = get_settings(), get_network_repository()           │
     │     out = {"consumers": repo.consumers.n, "transformers":               │
     │ len(repo.dt_ids), "runs": {}}                                           │
     │     for sid in SCENARIOS:                                               │
     │         run = run_scenario(settings, repo, sid, days=7,                 │
     │ use_cache=False)                                                        │
     │         imp = run["impact"]                                             │
     │         out["runs"][sid] = run                                          │
     │         print(f"{sid}: blackout household-hours                         │
     │ {imp['baseline']['hoh']:.0f} -> {imp['solution']['hoh']:.0f} "          │
     │               f"({imp['hoh_reduction_pct']:.1f}% fewer); lifeline       │
     │ availability "                                                          │
     │               f"{imp['baseline']['lifeline_availability_pct']:.1f}% ->  │
     │ {imp['solution']['lifeline_availability_pct']:.1f}%")                   │
     │     head = out["runs"]["heatwave_evening"]["impact"]                    │
     │     base_over = head["baseline"]["dt_overload_slots"]                   │
     │     overload_cut = 100.0 * (1 - head["solution"]["dt_overload_slots"] / │
     │ base_over) if base_over else 0.0                                        │
     │     out["national"] = national_impact(head["hoh_reduction_pct"])        │
     │     out["unit_economics"] = unit_economics(repo.consumers.n /           │
     │ len(repo.dt_ids), head["hoh_reduction_pct"], overload_cut)              │
     │     target = ROOT.parent / "deliverables" / "impact-runs.json"          │
     │     target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                    │
     │     target.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")      │
     │     print("wrote", target)                                              │
     │     return 0                                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │                                                                         │
     │ if __name__ == "__main__":                                              │
     │     raise SystemExit(main())                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ - [ ] Step 2: Run it after calibration (Task B10 Step 8) and model      │
     │ training (Task A9 Step 7). Expected: three lines, each showing fewer    │
     │ blackout hours with LifelineGrid.                                       │
     │ - [ ] Step 3: Write deliverables/impact-model.md with these sections,   │

     │ Task E4: Solution write-up                                              │
     │                                                                         │
     │ File: deliverables/writeup.md (target 2,500 to 3,000 words; export to   │
     │ PDF)                                                                    │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Outline, in this order, each heading a finding sentence:                │
     │ 1. India records every unit but cannot ration a shortfall gracefully.   │
     │ The problem in three numbers (5.28 crore smart meters; 1.3 to 3.5       │
     │ outage hours a day measured by CEEW; about 13 lakh DT failures a year), │
     │ and why renewable growth makes evenings tighter.                        │
     │ 2. Why the obvious answers stall. A table: more grid storage (capital,  │
     │ years); rotational shedding (blacks out everyone on a feeder, including │
     │ the health centre); smart prepaid control (Uttar Pradesh rolled it      │
     │ back in May 2026 over grievances); voluntary appeals (no feedback, no   │
     │ verification).                                                          │
     │ 3. The answer: a lifeline instead of a blackout. The loop, the lever    │
     │ order, the tiers and cap levels.                                        │
     │ 4. How it works. One paragraph per engine in plain words, with the      │
     │ formula for the dynamic thermal rating and the optimiser's objective in │
     │ one line each.                                                          │
     │ 5. Why it fits Indian distribution-grid conditions. The control point   │
     │ already exists (RDSS meter specification); it reads existing HES and    │
     │ MDM data; a JE approves, which mirrors today's load-regulation          │
     │ instruction; Hindi notices over WhatsApp and IVR; it aligns with the    │
     │ India Energy Stack and the P2P pilots.                                  │
     │ 6. Key assumptions. A table with each assumption, its value, its source │
     │ or "team assumption", and what changes if it is wrong.                  │
     │ 7. What is built today. The status matrix with LIVE, WIRED and PILOT    │
     │ tags, test counts, endpoint count and p95 latency, voice eval score.    │
     │ 8. Measured improvement. The headline table from the impact model.      │
     │ 9. Ownership, operations and unit economics. A summary of Task E6.      │
     │ 10. Risks and guardrails. Five risks, each with its mitigation; the     │
     │ five invariants.                                                        │
     │ 11. Six weeks from agreement to a live sub-division. The pilot plan.    │
     │                                                                         │

     │ Task E6: Ownership, operations and unit economics                       │
     │                                                                         │
     │ File: deliverables/economics.md, all figures from impact-runs.json and  │
     │ ASSUMPTIONS.                                                            │
     │                                                                         │
     │ 1. Who owns what. The DISCOM owns the service and the data. The AMISP   │
     │ (the smart-metering operator) runs the head-end integration. The        │
     │ LifelineGrid team provides the software as a per-meter service. No      │
     │ community asset is bought, so there is nothing for a low-income         │
     │ community to finance or maintain.                                       │
     │ 2. Who operates it day to day. A table: role, action, time needed. JE:  │
     │ reviews and approves plans, about five minutes per plan. AE: oversight, │
     │ cancels when supply returns early. Field worker (a self-help-group      │
     │ member engaged by the DISCOM): registers life-support homes and         │
     │ critical facilities with consent, verifies complaints. Control room:    │
     │ watches Live Grid Ops. 1912 helpline: complaints are matched to meter   │
     │ state automatically.                                                    │
     │ 3. What the consumer pays. Nothing. A lifeline limit costs nothing. A   │
     │ consumer who shifts load earns a bill rebate of Rs 2 per kWh. State     │
     │ this first because the brief's test is affordability for low-income     │
     │ users.                                                                  │
     │ 4. Unit economics per transformer per year. The cost and the three      │
     │ benefit lines with their formulas, the benefit-cost ratio and the       │
     │ payback, each rupee value tagged sourced or assumption.                 │
     │ 5. Sensitivity. The same table at the bear and bull addressable shares  │
     │ and at half and double the fee.                                         │
     │ 6. Maintenance. Software only: model retraining monthly on new meter    │
     │ history; the registry reviewed quarterly; an annual audit of the        │
     │ fairness ledger published to the regulator.                             │
     │ 7. Scale-up path. Wave 1: two sub-divisions in Bareilly and Mathura in  │
     │ shadow mode, then live. Wave 2: the remaining sub-divisions of MVVNL    │
     │ and DVVNL. Wave 3: RDSS states with the highest smart-meter coverage.   │
     │ Each wave needs only a head-end integration and a data agreement.       │

     │ Part 10: Risks                                                          │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Risk: The world or optimiser is slower than a 1 second tick on Cloud    │
     │ Run                                                                     │
     │ Likelihood: Medium                                                      │
     │ Impact: High                                                            │
     │ Mitigation: Power flow is the cost; GridWorld(power_flow=False) in      │
     │ batch runs;                                                             │
     │ a tick above 500 ms logs a warning; if needed, run power flow every     │
     │ fourth                                                                  │
     │ interval                                                                │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: The forecaster misses, so a plan under-covers the gap             │
     │ Likelihood: Medium                                                      │
     │ Impact: Medium                                                          │
     │ Mitigation: Plans cover P50 plus half the P50 to P90 spread; a 3        │
     │ percent                                                                 │
     │ over-drawal tolerance; residual shedding is visible and counted, never  │
     │ hidden                                                                  │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: Calibration cannot hit the CEEW values                            │
     │ Likelihood: Low                                                         │
     │ Impact: Medium                                                          │
     │ Mitigation: Widen the bisection bracket; if still off, report the       │
     │ measured                                                                │
     │ baseline honestly and keep the comparison relative                      │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: Open-Meteo, OSRM, Nominatim or the CEEW download is unreachable   │
     │ Likelihood: Medium                                                      │
     │ Impact: Low                                                             │
     │ Mitigation: Every script has a synthetic fallback; the UI source line   │
     │ switches                                                                │
     │ automatically                                                           │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: Sarvam or Gemini quota or outage during the demo                  │
     │ Likelihood: Medium                                                      │
     │ Impact: Medium                                                          │
     │ Mitigation: Template briefing, typed fallbacks and fact cards work      │
     │ without                                                                 │
     │ either; rehearse the demo once with both keys unset                     │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: Judges read the lifeline limit as "the DISCOM throttling the      │
     │ poor"                                                                   │
     │ Likelihood: Medium                                                      │
     │ Impact: High                                                            │
     │ Mitigation: Lead with the equity result (share of low-income homes      │
     │ limited),                                                               │
     │ the floor, the protected register, the expiry, the named approver, the  │
     │ rebate; the Lifeline and Fairness page exists for this question         │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: A regulator would need to approve meter-side limits               │
     │ Likelihood: High in reality                                             │
     │ Impact: Out of scope for the prototype                                  │
     │ Mitigation: State it: pilot under the state commission's approval;      │
     │ prepaid                                                                 │
     │ meters already enforce sanctioned load; the guardrails page is written  │
     │ for                                                                     │
     │ that conversation                                                       │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Risk: Scope creep across 26 pages                                       │
     │ Likelihood: High                                                        │
     │ Impact: High                                                            │
     │ Mitigation: The recipe and acceptance list in 6.0; pages D12 to D14 and │
     │ D23 to                                                                  │
     │ D26 are the first to simplify if days run short, never D1, D3, D4, D8,  │
     │ D11,                                                                    │
     │ D15, D17, D22                                                           │

     │ Appendix A: Why PS3 (decision record)                                   │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Four problem statements were scored against the SwasthyaGrid shape      │
     │ (decision layer on existing rails, closed loop with a human approver,   │
     │ engines decide and models phrase, role hierarchy, vernacular voice,     │
     │ live map and simulation, quantified national impact, federation) plus   │
     │ Schneider fit, crowding, demo data, buildability and software-only      │
     │ deployability, out of 65.                                               │
     │                                                                         │
     │ Score                                                                   │
     │ PS3 Grid: 59                                                            │
     │ PS1 Agriculture: 50                                                     │
     │ PS4 Manufacturing: 47                                                   │
     │ PS2 Buildings: 36                                                       │
     │ ────────────────────────────────────────                                │
     │ Decisive factor                                                         │
     │ PS3 Grid: The control point (smart-meter load limit) is already         │
     │ installed;                                                              │
     │ approval is legally necessary; least crowded                            │
     │ PS1 Agriculture: Advisory only without hardware; most crowded           │
     │ PS4 Manufacturing: ADEETIE needs measurement and verification, but      │
     │ equipment                                                               │
     │ insight needs clamp meters                                              │
     │ PS2 Buildings: Needs a building management system that most Indian      │
     │ buildings                                                               │
     │ lack                                                                    │
